semantics: Scheduled positive RPM-drop class. Scheduler FUN 00020dfe copies current publication byte ffff1072 here; DFCO and other consumers classify it at breakpoints 4, 8, and 12.
note: The fourth adjacent ROM byte 32 is not compared by the four-class loops. FUN 00050018 uses class indices 0..3 to select RPM/25 floors 36, 48, 54, and 62.

semantics: Current publication byte for high8 of the filtered positive four-sample RPM drop. FUN 0003e1da publishes it only through the 0001202e, ffff2459.bit5, and ffff2451.bit7 gate; otherwise it writes zero.
note: Scheduler FUN 00020dfe copies this byte to ffff106a.

semantics: Current RPM/12.5 word. FUN 0003deec normally derives it from captured engine-event interval ffff22bc and can directly copy independently established RPM/12.5 word ffff11f4.
note: The normal expression is floor(0xA2C2/uint16[ffff22bc]); runtime gates can instead copy ffff11f4 or write zero.

semantics: Exhaust-VTC target byte after the standstill override stage of FUN 000bfe88, stored at 000c01f4: ROM8[00008e36]+128=168 while ffff246c bit 1 is set and cancel latch ffff2478 bit 4 is clear; 128 on the pass after the predicate falls (prior-cycle copy ffff246f bit 1) or while the latch is being set; the previous value while the latch holds; otherwise the coolant-selected map byte from ffff137a. It feeds the 190-count limiter and the slew stage before ffff1c90.
note: On the 2026-09-17 captures of a Map 3 image with neutral surfaces the byte reached 168 in eight standstill excursions, each starting as the engine passed 1800 RPM at rest.

semantics: Current Q8 filtered positive four-sample RPM drop written by FUN 0003e1da. On the normal path it is min(65535,64*max(uint16[ffff1f76]-uint16[ffff114a],0)+floor(192*uint16[ffff1e58]/256)).
note: Separate initialization and disabled branches write 0xff00 or zero. Its high byte is the publication candidate for ffff1072.

semantics: Preceding eight-byte snapshot of the current RPM-drop filter block. Dispatcher FUN 000209d8 copies ffff1e50..ffff1e57 to ffff1e58..ffff1e5f through block-copy helper 00022558.
note: FUN 0003e1da uses this preceding snapshot as the 0.75 history term of its stock filter.

semantics: Engine-speed window flags of exhaust-VTC conditioner FUN 000bfe88. Bit 0 sets when engine-speed byte ffff11ae reaches ROM8[00008e3b]=36 (1800 RPM) and holds until the byte plus ROM8[000086e1]=4 falls below 36 (1600 RPM), stored at 000bfee4. Bit 1 follows hysteresis comparator 000259d0: it sets when the byte is at or below ROM8[00008e3a]=80 (4000 RPM) and clears above 80+ROM8[000086e1]=84 (4200 RPM), stored at 000bff14. Both bits are inputs of standstill override predicate ffff246c bit 1.
note: Bit 2 is written later in the same function from diagnostic state and is not described here.

semantics: Retained Boolean lookup result from calibration 0001202e. FUN 0003e1da updates it while ffff2459.bit5 is clear and tests only zero versus nonzero after that bit sets.
note: All four stock cells are 200. Any nonzero value is operationally equivalent; zero bypasses the PH9-derived ffff2451.bit7 requirement for RPM-drop publication.

semantics: First-channel Q16 zero-surface crossfade scratch written by FUN 00070e4c as floor((ffff133a*(65536-ffff190e)+ffff133c*ffff190e)/65536).
note: Both endpoint surfaces are all zero, so the stock value is always zero. Its only reader is inside FUN 00070e4c; ROM8[000089fb].bit3 clear prevents the processed branch from reaching ffff1332.

semantics: Second-channel Q16 zero-surface crossfade scratch written by FUN 000720c4 as floor((ffff1cba*(65536-ffff190e)+ffff1cbc*ffff190e)/65536).
note: Both endpoint surfaces are all zero, so the stock value is always zero. Whole-program exact references contain this write and no reader; FUN 000720c4 keeps the same value in a register for its local processing.

semantics: First-channel published word from FUN 00070e4c. The configurable path can select processed word ffff1330, but stock ROM8[000089fb]=0x20 has bit 3 clear and therefore always copies source ffff1210.
note: The zero-surface crossfade and local rate-processing result do not reach this word in unmodified JK08A. Its physical interpretation remains unresolved.

semantics: Second-channel published word from FUN 000720c4. The configurable path can select processed word ffff1cb4, but stock ROM8[000089fb]=0x20 has bit 3 clear and therefore always copies source ffff1248.
note: The zero-surface crossfade and local rate-processing result do not reach this word in unmodified JK08A. Monitor 0008d10a compares it with ffff1332; the physical interpretation remains unresolved.

semantics: First normalized output of FUN 0007af78. It equals 800 when endpoint span max(0,U-L) is zero; otherwise it is min(800,floor(max(0,32768+int16[ffff338c]-L)*800/span)).
note: Both stock endpoint curves are zero, so span is zero and this word is exactly 800. FUN 0007ae80 applies it as one lower bound of ffff2a7a.

semantics: Second normalized output of FUN 0007af78. It equals 800 when endpoint span max(0,U-L) is zero; otherwise it is min(800,floor(max(0,32768+int16[ffff338e]-L)*800/span)).
note: Both stock endpoint curves are zero, so span is zero and this word is exactly 800. FUN 0007ae80 applies it as another lower bound of ffff2a7a.

semantics: Third normalized output of FUN 0007af78. It equals 800 when endpoint span max(0,U-L) is zero; otherwise it is min(800,floor(max(0,32768+int16[ffff3396]-L)*800/span)).
note: Both stock endpoint curves are zero, so span is zero and this word is exactly 800. FUN 0007ae80 applies it as the upper bound after the two lower bounds.

semantics: Signed centered correction scratch in the stock-disabled branch of FUN 0007b3f4. The branch writes int16(interpolate_u16(00016948,ffff35ce,ffff11b6)-32768).
note: Stock ROM8[000083c1].bit1 is clear, so this word is not written by the function. Every map cell is 0x8000 and would produce zero if the branch were enabled.

semantics: Final signed word published by FUN 0007b3f4. Stock ROM8[000083c1].bit1 clear directly copies ffff1d26; the disabled alternate branch can select or calculate a bounded value using centered correction ffff35d0.
note: FUN 000771f4 includes this word in a signed minimum and upper-bound chain. Monitor 0009b110 measures the absolute difference between ffff2c6c and this word. The physical quantity remains unresolved.

semantics: Captured EVAP pressure-sample baseline. FUN 000af72e and FUN 000b0362 copy the exact uint16 value from shared EVAP sample word ffff10c4 into this word for subsequent baseline-relative calculations.
note: Additional EVAP state-machine paths update the same word. The physical pressure conversion, polarity, and engineering units of ffff10c4 remain unresolved.

semantics: Baseline-relative EVAP pressure-depression coordinate used for the first 000152d6 lookup. Direct producer paths call FUN 000abb84 with baseline ffff2abc and current sample ffff10c4, clamp a negative result to zero, and store the resulting uint16 here.
note: On those direct paths the stored value is max(0, floor((uint16[ffff2abc]-uint16[ffff10c4])*112/32)). Other state-machine paths can retain or update the same coordinate. Its physical pressure scale remains unresolved.

semantics: Corrected and uint16-saturated companion coordinate assembled by FUN 000b29b8 immediately before the second 000152d6 lookup. The stored word and the lookup argument are the same value.
note: The upstream correction combines several leak-monitor state words and saturating branches. The complete physical formula and engineering units remain unresolved.

semantics: Saturated intermediate base of the EVAP leak-result calculation. FUN 000b2096 writes zero when the transformed 000152d6 difference is nonpositive, writes a normalized positive result on the admitted division path, or writes 0xffff on zero-divisor and saturation paths. The word is then multiplied by byte coefficients ffff2f8d and ffff2f94.
note: Normalization parameter ffff2c86 and the two byte coefficients have unresolved physical scales, so this intermediate remains raw.

semantics: First 000152d6 lookup result in the EVAP leak calculation. FUN 000b2096 indexes the curve by baseline-relative coordinate ffff2c92 and stores the returned uint16 here before comparing it with the corrected-coordinate result.
note: The transformed quantity is code-proven, but its physical pressure or leak-area conversion is unresolved.

semantics: Stored copy of the second 000152d6 lookup result in the EVAP leak calculation. FUN 000b29b8 indexes the curve by corrected coordinate ffff2c98, stores the returned uint16 here, and passes the same register value to FUN 000b2096 for comparison with ffff3240.
note: The physical pressure or leak-area conversion is unresolved.

semantics: First-channel scaled publication from FUN 0007a592. The function calculates floor(S*727/800) with signed division and writes the uint16 result here; S is the locally bounded value or override source ffff3026. Under stock ROM8[000083c1].bit0=0, the selected source also reaches final channel word ffff2a7a. Direct surface evaluators 00074028 and 0007604c use this word on byte-identical 0..727 axes; inverse evaluator 00076ad0 restores the corresponding 0..800 domain.
note: The exact 727/800 relationship is code-proven. The physical interpretation of the common first-channel raw quantity is not assigned.

semantics: Second-channel scaled publication from FUN 0007a804. The function calculates floor(ffff35cc*727/800) with unsigned division and writes the uint16 result here.
note: FUN 000720c4 reads this word as the parallel counterpart of ffff1210. The physical interpretation is unresolved.

semantics: Final bounded first-channel raw output from FUN 0007a592. It follows the endpoint crossfade, optional Q15 trim 0001484a, common Q15 coefficient ffff31e2, 800 transition, upper bound ffff3024, and bit-gated override from ffff3026.
note: Monitor 0008d194 compares it with parallel final word ffff35cc. The physical quantity is unresolved.

semantics: First-channel raw endpoint-crossfade result before multiplicative trims. FUN 0007a592 writes floor((A*(32768-w)+B*w)/32768), saturated to uint16, where A/B are the selected endpoint curves and w is ffff31c8.
note: Q15 trim 0001484a is applied after this write when ffff245e.bit6 is set. The physical quantity is unresolved.

semantics: Absolute disagreement between final channel words ffff2a7a and ffff35cc. FUN 0008d194 writes abs(uint16(ffff2a7a)-uint16(ffff35cc)) and tests whether it exceeds 26.
note: The physical unit is the unresolved common raw domain of the two channels.

semantics: Common uint16 upper bound used by both raw-output channels. FUN 00079a98 writes 1000 when two service gates pass and ROM16[000092ea]=150 otherwise; FUN 0007a592 and FUN 0007a804 take the minimum with their local candidate before any final override.
note: The physical quantity and meanings of the service gates are unresolved.

semantics: First-channel override source coordinated by FUN 00079a98. The admitted path copies ffff2698 here; fallback paths select ffff2a6a, zero, or ROM16[000092ec]=43. ffff41f3.bit0 selects this word in FUN 0007a592 and FUN 0007ae80.
note: The physical quantity is unresolved.

semantics: Common Q15 multiplier used by both raw-output channels after their channel-specific trim stage. FUN 0007a4de writes max(0x8000, min(ffff31e6, lookup(00014fa2))); both consumers multiply by this word and shift right by 15.
note: Stock map 00014fa2 is flat 0x8000, so this coefficient is unity in the stock image. Its physical purpose is unresolved.

semantics: First-channel Q15 trim scratch. When ffff245e.bit6 is set, FUN 0007a592 writes the interpolation result of map 0001484a here and immediately multiplies ffff2a7c by the same value; the bypass substitutes 0x8000 without writing this word.
note: Map 0001484a is flat unity in stock JK08A.

semantics: Second-channel raw endpoint-crossfade result before trim 00018d36 and common coefficient ffff31e2. FUN 0007a804 writes floor((A*(32768-w)+B*w)/32768), saturated to uint16.
note: The physical quantity is unresolved.

semantics: Final bounded second-channel raw output from FUN 0007a804. It follows the endpoint crossfade, optional Q15 trim 00018d36, common Q15 coefficient ffff31e2, local bounds, and ffff4214.bit6 override from ffff35ea.
note: Monitor 0008d194 compares it with parallel final word ffff2a7a. The physical quantity is unresolved.

semantics: Second-channel Q15 trim scratch. FUN 0007a804 always writes the interpolation result of map 00018d36 here; ffff245e.bit6 selects multiplication of ffff35ca by this value or bypass of the trim.
note: Map 00018d36 is flat unity in stock JK08A.

semantics: Current Base Fuel Schedule sample. Its high byte serves as the load-axis input of the 16x16 accessor families 00082c8a and 000befb0 and enters the five-level rotational-irregularity classifier. The full unsigned word is the numerator of calculated-load producer 0008083c: floor((ffff1024<<8)/lookup(0x1491a)). Scheduler 00020dfe copies the previous value to ffff1028 before refreshing ffff1024 from ffff1026.
note: Exact DID 0x1208 returns producer word ffff1026 as Base Fuel Schedule. The homologous structured Nissan profile defines raw/2048 ms, making the high byte raw/8 ms; this engineering conversion remains candidate and is nearest unity against the established raw/100 ms injection-pulse scale.

semantics: Newest Base Fuel Schedule word. Init routine 0002c648 and runtime producer 0003b75c are its only whole-program p-code writers; scheduler 00020dfe copies it to current sample ffff1024. UDS DID 0x1208 returns this word in big-endian order.
note: A whole-program p-code scan found no other resolved or computed-address writers. The diagnostic identity is exact; raw/2048 ms comes from a homologous structured Nissan profile. Against the established raw/100 ms injection-pulse scale the recorded ratio of pulse to schedule is 0.88 under raw/2048 ms and 0.44 or 1.76 under the adjacent power-of-two scales, so only this candidate is near unity; no ROM constant fixes the chain gain, and hardware validation remains required.

semantics: Previous Base Fuel Schedule sample. Scheduler 00020dfe copies ffff1024 here immediately before refreshing ffff1024 from ffff1026. In the ROM8[00008d92].bit3-clear branch of 00051a98, current minus previous is compared with ROM8[000087fd]<<3.
note: Stock JK08A has ROM8[00008d92].bit3 set, so the positive Base Fuel Schedule delta comparison and its ffff1220 writer do not execute. The raw/2048 ms conversion remains a hardware-validation target.

semantics: Scheduler snapshot of the Q7 normalized Base Fuel Schedule byte ffff1048. FUN 00020dfe copies ffff1048..ffff1063 to ffff102c..ffff1047 before periodic tasks produce the next values. The exact representation is min(255,floor(uint16[ffff1026]*128/ROM16[00009534])), with stock reference 0x6a5a; normalized percentage is raw*100/128. It is the column coordinate for ignition and intake-cam target maps, the shifted coordinate and threshold input in FUN 0004d2a6, and the normal Y input for exhaust-CVTC target accessor 000bfdc0.
note: The fixed-reference ratio, Q7 encoding, snapshot direction, and operational consumers are exact. The HR catalog calls the ratio Cylinder Filling Up Efficiency; that physical name remains a candidate and is not required for the normalized-BFS percentage. J1979 Calculated Load ffff413e uses a different RPM-dependent denominator and 100*A/255 encoding.

semantics: Live Q7 normalized Base Fuel Schedule byte produced by FUN 0003b75c as min(255,floor(uint16[ffff1026]*128/ROM16[00009534])). Stock ROM16[00009534]=0x6a5a. FUN 00020dfe snapshots this byte to ffff102c before the next periodic task pass; FUN 0004bbee and FUN 0004dbe8 also read the live value directly.
note: A whole-program p-code census found site 0003bd5a as the only direct writer. Raw 128 means Base Fuel Schedule equals the 0x9534 reference, and raw*100/128 is the exact normalized percentage. The physical Cylinder Filling name remains a catalog candidate.

semantics: Bank 1 MAF transfer output A from 1D-64 curve 0x14274. FUN 0003a982 copies it to working value ffff1058; FUN 0003b520 combines it with B=ffff1056 to calculate byte contribution wA=uint8(trunc0((A<<8)/(A+B))).
note: Exact DID 0x1204 and the continuous AN4-to-DID-to-map-to-DID 0x1209 trace establish the MAF and bank-1 identity.

semantics: Bank 2 MAF transfer output B from 1D-64 curve 0x141f4. FUN 0003a982 copies it to working value ffff105a; FUN 0003b520 combines it with A=ffff1054 to calculate byte contribution wB=uint8(trunc0((B<<8)/(A+B))).
note: Exact DID 0x1205 and the continuous AN15-to-DID-to-map-to-DID 0x1209 trace establish the MAF and bank-2 identity.

semantics: Scheduler snapshot of TCM gear-phase index ffff1066 decoded from CAN 0x177 payload byte 2 bits 0..2. Rotational-speed request limiter 0007584e advances recovery envelope ffff19dc by the 30-count calibration 0x943a when target gear index ffff1083 is greater than this phase index and by the 50-count calibration 0x943c otherwise.
note: In the 2026-08-17 target capture this index equals current gear minus one in stable 1st through 4th gear and changes after the 0x174 target field but before the 0x174 current field during shifts. The operational phase role is verified; a direct mechanical engagement boundary is not claimed.

semantics: Live TCM gear-phase index decoded by FUN 000c4ace as CAN 0x177 payload byte 2 masked with 0x07. Scheduler 00020dfe copies it to limiter snapshot ffff1064.
note: The target capture correlates values 0 through 3 with transmission operation in gears 1 through 4. Payload bit 3 and higher bits are independent status flags.

semantics: Previous-cycle normalized engine-coolant-temperature index. Scheduler 00020dfe copies ffff1077 to ffff106f. In the linear range it is floor(1.6*(DID 0x1101 raw-10)), so lookup nodes 0,16,...240 represent -40,-30,...110 deg C.
note: DID 0x1101 returns ffff1079 and homologous diagnostic definitions identify it as engine coolant temperature with deg C = raw-50. FUN 00039634 performs the exact normalization and saturation.

semantics: Scheduler snapshot of selected normalized-temperature byte ffff1078, the normalized coolant index latched at engine start together with raw byte ffff1076. It indexes map 0x12026 directly and map 0x12DE2 through q=min(2*A,255).
note: The scale is the normalized coolant scale of FUN 00039634: 1.6 counts per deg C from -40 deg C, saturated to 255 from 120 deg C.

semantics: Scheduler snapshot of exact raw engine-coolant-temperature byte ffff1079. FUN 0004afdc maintains timing-transition warm latch ffff41de.bit5; FUN 0007584e maintains its independent alternate-threshold latch ffff249e.bit0; additional consumers implement misfire readiness, ignition correction hysteresis, and diagnostic warm latches.
note: Exact DID 0x1101 uses deg C = raw-50. The limiter latch sets at raw 255, retains through raw 239, and clears at 238, corresponding to theoretical 205, 189, and 188 deg C boundaries rather than an ordinary warm-engine transition. Other consumer thresholds remain independently documented.

semantics: Exact one-byte response source for UDS DID 0x1104 and published fuel-temperature transfer code. Initialization path 0002c4f8 stores lookup(00012dea, uint8(ffff100a >> 2)) at 0002c56e, where ffff100a is the AN0 external-mux sample of selector code 111. Periodic publisher 00039788 stores at 000397c4 either service-0x30 value byte ffff992d while active bit ffff99c5 bit 1 is set or the output of limiter 00039874 over transfer code ffff1f89, which FUN 000397e8 forms from filtered sample ffff1fa8 through the same table. FUN 000398b0 reads the byte to form normalized index ffff117a, and the service 0x22 pointer table publishes it directly.
note: The byte is the output of shared thermistor table 00012dea, whose code the ECU declares as deg C+50 through J1979 Mode 01 PIDs 0x05 and 0x0F, so deg C = raw-50 is established by code. The factory fuel tank temperature sensor reference of 3.5 V at 20 deg C and 2.2 V at 50 deg C gives 20.5 and 52 deg C through the table at 20 mV per input count. The limiter keeps the published byte between the converted sample and the sample plus two counts while the temperature falls. The identification of DID 0x1104 as fuel temperature is a diagnostic-binding claim in JK08A.diagnostic-bindings.csv.

semantics: Current normalized engine-coolant-temperature index produced from ffff1079 by FUN 00039634: raw below 10 gives 0, raw from 10 through 169 gives floor(240*(raw-10)/150), and raw at least 170 gives 255.
note: The linear range maps -40 through 110 deg C to 0 through 240 in steps of 1.6 counts per deg C. Values at and above 120 deg C saturate to 255.

semantics: Exact one-byte response source for UDS DID 0x1101. FUN 0002c4f8 writes the converted sensor byte and then calls FUN 00039634 to form the normalized coolant lookup index. J1979 Mode 01 PID 0x05 in FUN 00035856 returns snapshot ffff3fa4, the same 00012dea lookup minus 10.
note: Homologous diagnostic definitions identify DID 0x1101 as engine coolant temperature and define deg C = raw-50; J1979 defines PID 0x05 as A-40 deg C and the PID byte is this lookup result minus 10, so raw-50 is the conversion the ECU declares. The exact JK08A response pointer is ROM32[0x226b0] = ffff1079. The ECM terminal and sensor hardware remain hardware items.

semantics: Scheduler snapshot of current gear index ffff1086 decoded from the low nibble of CAN 0x174 payload byte 3. Values 1 through 7 become zero-based indices 0 through 6; zero and values above 7 become zero. Rotational-speed request limiter 0007584e uses target > current to admit immediate recovery tracking and auxiliary output.
note: Passive target transitions 0x44 -> 0x34 -> 0x33 and 0x22 -> 0x32 -> 0x33 establish that the low nibble changes after the target nibble and represents current gear.

semantics: Scheduler snapshot of target gear index ffff1087 decoded from the high nibble of CAN 0x174 payload byte 3. Values 1 through 7 become zero-based indices 0 through 6; zero and values above 7 become zero. Rotational-speed request limiter 0007584e uses target > current for recovery tracking and auxiliary output, target > gear-phase index ffff1064 for the 30-count recovery rate, and min(target,4) for table 0x14384.
note: Passive target transitions show the high nibble changing before the low nibble for both upshifts and downshifts, which establishes the target role.

semantics: Live current gear index decoded by FUN 000c47ea from the low nibble of CAN 0x174 payload byte 3. Input values 1 through 7 are decremented; zero and values above 7 publish zero. Scheduler 00020dfe copies the byte to ffff1082.
note: CAN 0x174 is the exact standard identifier represented by dispatcher key 0x2e80 and stock mailbox record 0x9786.

semantics: Live target gear index decoded by FUN 000c47ea from the high nibble of CAN 0x174 payload byte 3. Input values 1 through 7 are decremented; zero and values above 7 publish zero. Scheduler 00020dfe copies the byte to ffff1083.
note: CAN 0x174 is the exact standard identifier represented by dispatcher key 0x2e80 and stock mailbox record 0x9786.

semantics: Signed load slope: the condition short[ffff10b8] < -byte[0x86AE] in 0005185c detects throttle release. With byte[0x86AE]=0, the threshold is zero, so any negative slope triggers detection.
Source of latch ffff1a78 (Q16 blend-weight input for 0x1488a in 00070e4c); in 00074c82 the same byte selects one of two component maps.
note: The axis claim for a physical quantity is refuted: the value comes from callers outside the component, while the axis unit is based on shape and catalog evidence (P6).

semantics: Previous-cycle raw byte used as the second implicit coordinate of maps 0000a8ea/00009eda and as the explicit coordinate for coefficient map 000124f2. Scheduler 00020dfe copies it from current byte ffff1170.
note: The current-byte producer traces to the high byte of map 00015042 output. Its physical quantity and engineering scale remain unresolved.

semantics: Previous-cycle snapshot of battery-voltage response byte ffff1188. Scheduler 00020dfe copies it through the 128-byte ffff1114..ffff1193 -> ffff1094..ffff1113 block. Misfire coordinator 00082c8a requires the unsigned value to be at least 0x89 before setting ffff4251.bits6/7. The DTC monitors read this snapshot for their battery-voltage windows: FUN 000995c4 (P0011, P0021) accepts ROM8[0x8e0a]=125 < byte <= ROM8[0x8e07]=200, FUN 00093c40 (P0031, P0051, P0052) accepts ROM8[0x82b4]=131 <= byte < 200, and FUN 0009426e (P0130, P0150), FUN 0009678c (P2A00), and FUN 000ac0d4 (P0462, P0463) accept 137 <= byte < 200.
note: At 0.08 V per count the windows are 10.00..16.00 V, 10.48..16.00 V, and 10.96..16.00 V against factory test conditions of between 10 V and 16 V, between 10.5 V and 16 V, and more than 11 V; raw 0x89 is 10.96 V. A scale of 20 V over 255 counts puts the same limits at 9.80, 10.27, 10.75, and 15.69 V. The scale is established from ROM constants and factory specifications, not from firmware arithmetic; JK08A.diagnostics.md derives it.

semantics: Previous-cycle coarse vehicle-speed byte. Scheduler 00020dfe copies ffff118e here. FUN 00050018 uses stock boundary 4 to separate the low-speed three-class DFCO restore classifier from moving branches; FUN 0004f324 requires zero before the stationary rev-limiter state can advance. P0128 model functions also use boundaries 2 and shifted coordinates.
note: Exact firmware decodes CAN 0x280 bytes 4 and 5, filters the value through ffff113c/ffff115e, and FUN 0003a254 divides it by 20 into ffff118e. Homologous Z34 CAN data identifies this field as vehicle speed; the resulting byte uses approximately 2 km/h per count. The DFCO boundary is therefore approximately 8 km/h, while the physical scale remains a hardware-validation item.

semantics: Packed hardware and computed-input state. FUN 00038618 writes bit 2 from SH7058 PHDR bit 4 with active-low polarity. FUN 00038d44 mirrors computed START SIGNAL ffff4185.bit6 into bit 1.
note: The bit-1 identity follows from the exact DID 0x1302 START SIGNAL chain. PHDR bit 4 is MCU pin 67/B19; its ECM terminal and physical switch name remain unresolved.

semantics: Coolant-conversion input byte. FUN 0002c4f8 obtains a 16-bit analog result through FUN 00028668(0), stores it at ffff1d60, shifts it right by two, and writes the low byte here. Calibration 00012dea converts this value into exact raw coolant response byte ffff1079; FUN 0008092e repeats the lookup for coolant snapshot byte ffff3fa4.
note: The coolant identity follows from the exact ffff1079 diagnostic response path, not from table shape.

semantics: Exact one-byte response source for UDS DID 0x1103 and current battery-voltage byte. FUN 00039a9e copies phase-2 AN0 mux sample ffff1d6e to ffff1fc4, stores uint8(sample >> 2) in ffff1fc6, scales that byte through guard 00067188 and Q1.15 scaler 000671d8 with shared coefficient ffff4970, saturates the result to 255, and writes it here at 00039ae2. FUN 00038618 and selected-temperature gate 0003967a compare it with raw 100; scheduler 00020dfe snapshots it to ffff1108.
note: One count is 0.08 V: the ROM limits that the DTC monitors apply to snapshot ffff1108 reproduce the factory battery-voltage test conditions of 10, 10.5, 11, and 16 V; that row carries the constants and JK08A.diagnostics.md derives the scale. With stock coefficient 0x8000 the byte equals the ten-bit sample shifted right by two, so one count is 20 mV at the converter input and the terminal divider is 4:1. Raw 100 is 8.00 V. Target recordings hold 157..180 counts, or 12.56..14.40 V, around a diagnostic reading of 13.92 V.

semantics: Current coarse vehicle-speed byte written by FUN 0003a254 as min(255, ffff115e/20) and copied by scheduler 00020dfe to ffff110e. FUN 00035856 returns min(255, 2*ffff118e) for J1979 Mode 01 PID 0x0D at 00035d44.
note: J1979 defines PID 0x0D as km/h, so one count is 2 km/h. The exact firmware source is CAN 0x280 bytes 4 and 5 through ffff113c and ffff115e: the receive path divides the km/h*100 word by 10, the filter keeps km/h*10, and this producer divides by 20. Homologous Z34 CAN data identifies the field as vehicle speed.

semantics: Shared 16-bit input of the 0x76xxx group (base ffff1114 + 0x3e): used as the lookup index in 000763e2 (shifted by >>3), 0007654c, and 00076770. FUN 00076ad0 uses it as the secondary coordinate for signed surfaces 0000de8e and 0000e28e when ffff4255.bit7 is clear, or as one input to the maximum selector when the bit is set.
note: The operational coordinate role is exact. Its physical quantity and engineering unit remain unresolved.

semantics: Conditional companion of ffff1152 in inverse signed-surface evaluator 00076ad0. When ffff4255.bit7 is set, the evaluator uses max(uint16[ffff1152],uint16[ffff1162]) as the 00013d34 coordinate; when the bit is clear, this word is not read by that path.
note: The operational maximum-selector role is exact. Its physical quantity, producer, and engineering unit remain unresolved.

semantics: Absolutely addressed byte adjacent to structure ffff119c: its writer resolves through an xref, while no resolved writes exist anywhere in ffff119c..11b7 because that structure is populated by a handler through a pointer argument. The physical quantity is unresolved.
Base of the sensor structure populated through a pointer argument: no resolved write exists anywhere in ffff119c..ffff11b7, while adjacent absolutely addressed sensors are written normally.
note: 56,224 peripheral references versus 0 writes into the structure (ExportXrefs) explain why reference analysis cannot find the engine-speed writer.

semantics: Current engine speed. FUN 000384fe forms current byte ffff11e6 as min(255, ffff1196>>8), and scheduler 00020dfe copies it to ffff11ae. It is the shared axis input of the X-wrapper for the ignition, AFR-power, and lambda 16x16 families.
note: The rpm/50 unit converges across three independent RPM axes and the 7500 RPM cut. The common ffff1196 producer also establishes the exact relative RPM/25 and RPM/12.5 representations at ffff11b3 and ffff11f4.

semantics: Current saturated engine-speed byte in RPM/12.5 representation. FUN 0003846e forms source ffff11ea as min(255, ffff1196>>6), and scheduler 00020dfe copies it here. The byte indexes multiple implicit-axis maps and supplies the hysteretic P030 speed gate in FUN 0007c4e0.
note: It has the same count scale as engine-speed word ffff11f4 and saturates at 255. For 1D-8 implicit grids, nodes 0,32,...224 correspond to 0,400,...2800 RPM, with the last cell selected at and above 2800 RPM.

semantics: Current engine-speed byte in RPM/25 representation. FUN 000384cc forms current byte ffff11eb as min(255, ffff1196>>7), and scheduler 00020dfe copies it to ffff11b3. FUN 0004fbe2 and FUN 00050018 compare it with the Over Run Fuel Cut and Restore table outputs.
note: The scale is code-derived relative to ffff11ae: both bytes originate at ffff1196, with shifts of 7 and 8 respectively.

semantics: Current rotational-speed coordinate used by the throttle-rev limiter. FUN 0007584e multiplies it by four and compares/rate-limits the result in the same raw domain as ROM16[0x942c].
note: The HR A2L scale for 0x942c implies 3.125 RPM per ffff11b6 count because the code multiplies the coordinate by four before comparison with a 0.78125 RPM/count scalar. Hardware validation remains required.

semantics: Current engine-speed word in RPM/12.5 representation. FUN 000384fe writes source ffff11f4 = ffff1196>>6, and scheduler 00020dfe copies it here through the 56-byte snapshot block. Fuel-cut state machine 0004f282 compares it with calibrated activation/release words; misfire reporter 00084cd0 retains it in three operating-point snapshots, and matcher 000847dc applies a -30/+30 count window.
note: The source word and destination word occupy matching offsets in the exact snapshot-copy blocks. The matcher tolerance of 30 counts corresponds to 375 RPM.

semantics: Final signed timing coordinate in degBTDC written by 0004dbe8 after mode-dependent limits and overrides. Before the rate limiter and bounds it is ffff11da=clamp(ffff12d6+gated ffff564c, ROM8[0x8221]=-7, ROM8[0x821e]=50), and the full chain is ffff23f1 + (low7-64) + (ffff1a7d-64) - ffff23c5 - ffff12dc - ffff15ea + ffff134a - ffff11af + ffff2356 - ffff11f9 - ffff1ff6 + ffff564c with every coefficient 1. FUN 0004df82 transforms the result into ffff2022 and passes it to APC scheduler 0002a892. J1979 Mode 01 PID 0x0E in FUN 00035856 returns clamp((ROM8[0x83d5]-ffff2022)*2, -128..127)+128, which is 2*ffff11d4+128 on the normal path.
note: The normal transform is uint8(110-uint8(ffff11d4)). In the instrumented 1.11 target capture, this identity holds outside the Rolling Launch late override. During that override ffff11d4 remains the upstream stock coordinate while ffff2022 carries the effective command. The -7 bound is not universal across diagnostic and fallback modes; physical degree scale and pulse polarity remain hardware boundaries. J1979 defines PID 0x0E as A/2-64 degrees before TDC, so the ECU declares one count of this coordinate as one crank degree of advance; the physical spark angle remains a hardware item.

semantics: Current high-resolution engine-speed count written by FUN 000384fe as ffff1196>>3. Runtime Base Fuel Schedule producer 0003b75c selects this word or ffff11dc in its normal mode, clamps the selected value to at least 64, and uses it as denominator N in the primary MAF calculation.
note: The scale follows exactly from companion word ffff11f4=ffff1196>>6 at RPM/12.5: ffff11e8 has eight times as many counts, so one count is 1.5625 RPM. The stock normal-path minimum of 64 counts is 100 RPM.

semantics: Current pre-snapshot saturated engine-speed byte. FUN 000384fe writes ffff11e8 = ffff1196>>3, and FUN 0003846e writes this byte as min(255, ffff11e8>>3), equivalent to min(255, ffff1196>>6). Scheduler 00020dfe copies it to ffff11b2.
note: The unsaturated companion word ffff11f4 uses the same ffff1196>>6 expression, which establishes the count scale.

semantics: Current engine-speed word in RPM/12.5 representation. FUN 000384fe writes ffff1196>>6 here. It is returned by UDS DID 0x1201 and is also an interpolation input for Fuel Compensation Map 0xA29A and the per-cylinder Knock Slice Map accessor 0x1108E.
note: The scale follows exactly from the common ffff1196 source: ffff11f4 is twice the RPM/25 value at ffff11b3 and four times the RPM/50 value at ffff11ae. This selects the x*12.5 community definition for DID 0x1201 over the conflicting x*10 definition.

semantics: Base of the RAM group containing six-channel pulse/update eligibility mask byte[ffff120e+0x12] at ffff1220.
note: The stock-mode writer is 00052034. FUN 00051a98 writes the mask only in the alternate ROM8[00008d92].bit3=0 path.

semantics: Six-channel pulse/update eligibility mask, addressed as ffff120e+0x12. In stock ROM8[00008d92].bit3=1 mode, 00052034 sets or clears each channel from ffff22e0, signed difference ffff142e, calibration 000087fe, and ffff16ff. FUN 00051a98 reads the prepared bit for a per-channel calculation, and 00051f1e passes the mask to one-shot scheduler 0002c13c.
note: This mask is not a standalone global fuel-enable state. Its exact physical pulse or update event remains unresolved.

semantics: Air/throttle target-calculation quantity (opening-area multipliers) in 000474a4, to which the lower bound max(uVar4, ffff171a<<3) is applied.
Gate enabling one term of the sum in 00054ee0.
Alternate unsigned 16-bit source selected by ffff245d bit 5 in per-channel difference producer 0005727a; when the bit is clear, ffff1024 is selected instead.
note: The physical quantity is unresolved.

semantics: One of the RAM sensor inputs of dual-channel interpolation accessor 0004bbee, alongside ffff119c/ffff2466; in 00051a98, byte[ffff128c+off] is a per-cylinder mask in the fuel-cut AND condition.

Signed timing correction written by 0004d99c as clamp_s8(ffff1ff8+ffff2356-ffff1ff6), where ffff1ff8=ffff2378+ffff11d6 on the normal path, and combined by 0004dbe8 with the gated snapshot ffff564c while forming ffff11da and ffff11d4. Its terms are the previous-pass timing state ffff2378, the negated retard request ffff11d6, the bounded correction ffff2356, and the scaled 0x147da subtraction ffff1ff6.
note: All terms are crank degrees with coefficient 1 relative to the J1979 PID 0x0E coordinate. The operating qualifier of map 0x147da remains unresolved.

semantics: Compensation sum of the angle summation: output of maps 0x11f0a/0x11f12/0x11f1a/0x11f22 indexed by ffff106f.
Base of the six-element signed 16-bit difference array written by 0005727a and compared by stock-mode mask writer 00052034 against ROM8[000087fe]<<7.
note: The physical unit is unresolved. ROM8[000087fe]=5 gives a comparison threshold of 640 raw counts.

semantics: Per-channel curve selector in FUN 000c0d90. For channel param_1, a set bit in mask param_1+1 selects 00015ad0; a clear bit selects 00015b10.
note: The two curves are byte-identical in stock JK08A, so the selector cannot change the stock output. The condition that controls these bits is unresolved.

semantics: Signed timing-state addend written by 0004afdc after an exact x-128 transform. The selector chooses stock-inert feature map 000121a6 first, warm DFCO-transition map 0001219e second, a +30 constant bypass third, and default/post-transition map 00012196 otherwise.
note: Map 0001219e is limited to the warm nonzero-timer transition window. Map 000121a6 cannot be selected in the stock lifecycle. Target-vehicle evidence establishes one-for-one propagation from default map 00012196 to the final software timing coordinate during matched warm deceleration, and the coefficient-1 chain to J1979 PID 0x0E makes one count one crank degree.

semantics: Gated signed state derived from ffff2404 by 0004afdc and moved one count toward zero by 0004e112.
note: A whole-program reference check finds no connection from this byte to ffff11d4 or an APC compare. Its adaptive-learning interpretation remains unproven.

semantics: Angle-sum term from 2D surface 0x9dba: two-bank read (ffff2442/ffff2443) through wrapper 0x26140, folded as (r1+r2-256)/2-128.
note: The double -128 offset (one -128 per bank) is the code evidence for an x-128 element.

semantics: Saturated composite output of FUN 00055098: min(65535,u16(ffff2ff0)+((u8(ffff1680)*u8(ffff193d)*u8(ffff1955)*u8(ffff1b14))>>12)). FUN 000532ae consumes it together with ffff15fe and state ffff1426; FUN 00058740 also publishes whether it is zero.
note: The exact physical quantity and global fixed-point normalization are unresolved.

semantics: Selected byte factor for the 00012ede path. FUN 00055098 writes interpolate(00012ede,00011bfb,min(u8[ffff2442],u8[ffff2443])) when ffff246b.bit6 is set and writes bypass constant 64 otherwise. The same factor enters FUN 00055098 and FUN 00054ee0.
note: Raw 64 is the bypass-relative identity. Coordinator 00057608 calls 00055098 before 00054ee0, so both consumers use the current invocation's selected factor.

semantics: Derived 32-bit state written by FUN 00052f00 from the return of FUN 000532ae after that function consumes ffff15ce, signed ffff15fe, and state ffff1426. FUN 0004afdc uses it as a coordinate between ROM thresholds; FUN 000554ae adds it to 0x4000, ffff230c, and ffff15da before saturation into ffff231a.
note: The exact arithmetic branches in FUN 000532ae are code-visible, but their physical subsystem and engineering scale remain unresolved.

semantics: Current target mixture byte, Q7 fuel-multiplier command with 128 = closed-loop stoichiometric target. Stage 0005594a writes the 0000a9aa lookup, scaled around 128 by 00012552 when ffff2466 bit 6 selects the high-detonation surface, then forces 128 unless enrichment latch ffff24a2 bit 7 holds (set at value >= ROM8[00008b9b] = 130, held while value + ROM8[00008b9b] - ROM8[00008b9f] >= 130). The same stage ramps ffff123a toward this byte << 7 and reports the arrival in ffff2485 bit 5. 0004bbee and 000659ae also read it.
note: Stock bytes 128..149 of 0000a9aa give 1.00..1.16 commanded equivalence ratio.

semantics: Output of dual-channel interpolation accessor 0004bbee.
Bits 0/1 form the combined condition enabling a sum term in 00054ee0 (0x4000 < ...).

Three-byte response-curve result group ffff1635..ffff1638 in FUN 0004d2a6. Curve 000125ca produces T0 at ffff1636, T1 at ffff1635, and T2 at ffff1638; coefficient 0000a4aa produces W at ffff1637. Code forms c0=max(0,64+trunc0(W*(T0-T2)/512)) and c1=max(0,64+trunc0(W*(T1-T2)/512)).
note: The engineering scale of the response values is unresolved.

semantics: Unsigned stationary-limiter readiness accumulator. Every expiry of ffff258a adds lookup(000124d2)-128 with saturation to 0..65535. Readiness bit 4 of ffff247f is set at accumulator >= ROM16[0000911c] when its secondary gate passes.
note: The stock threshold is 381. The high-RPM table step is 127, so three timer expiries reach readiness. At or below 2000 RPM the stock step is zero and readiness cannot build from reset.

semantics: Measured signal compared with the diagnostic lower limit (map 0x12870) in a DTC monitor: while below the limit, debounce counter ffff1846 accumulates. The physical quantity is unknown.
Six-channel inhibit mask read by stock-mode ffff1220 writer 00052034. A set channel bit prevents the corresponding ffff1220 bit from being set.
note: The writer and physical origin of this mask are unresolved.

semantics: Output of floor curves 0x12908/0x12918 (00046938); consumer 000474a4 uses max(uVar4, ffff171a<<3) as the lower bound for ffff122a. The floor role is established by code, but the curve's own scale has not been derived.

Unsigned recursive speed-filter state in FUN 0007584e. First use stores min(65535,4*ffff11b6); later calls store min(65535,ffff11b6+floor(3*entry/4)). The blend calculation retains the entry value in a register while request-rate calculations reread the newly stored value.
note: Stable input converges to 4*N. Passive target-CAN timing establishes a 10.24 ms update period, giving a 35.6 ms exponential time constant. The x*0.78125 RPM interpretation of this expanded coordinate remains candidate evidence.

semantics: Dynamic rotational-speed threshold in FUN 0007584e. Init routine 0002c648 copies ROM16[0x942c]. Coolant latch ffff249e.bit0 selects min(0x942c,0x9434); ffff84c3.bit7 gates down/up rates 0x9430 and 0x9436; ffff4188.bit1 applies optional cap 0x942e. Equality holds the current value.
note: Stock rates are zero and both alternate caps are 0xffff, so the normal-path value remains 0x2580. The physical x*0.78125 RPM interpretation remains catalog-supported rather than code-proven.

semantics: Unsigned blended speed threshold written by FUN 0007584e as clamp_u16(S_entry+floor(ROM16[0x9424]*(ffff1796-S_entry)/1024)). First-pass initialization uses the newly initialized filter value; later passes use ffff1794 from function entry.
note: All request-rate terms subtract the newly stored ffff1794 from this word. At steady speed, stock gain 76 gives a 13-count lower-side deadband and an immediate one-count response above the threshold because negative arithmetic shifts round down.

semantics: DTC-monitor debounce counter associated with limit map 0x12870: incrementing is enabled by ffff84c3 bit 6 and compared with threshold 0x8b71; upon reaching it, fault bit 0x04 is set in ffff24a1 and response 000b4ef8(0x2f) is called.

Six-channel fallback-history mask shared by DFCO rotating release and ATU-II scheduler 0002c13c. A channel uses fallback word ffff23aa when its ffff22e0 bit or history bit is set. Injector-event handler 0002be40 clears the current event bit and can add it again while rotating-release count ffff1937 is nonzero.
note: This history makes the rotating release tail injector-event synchronized. Physical channel-to-cylinder order is unresolved.

semantics: Shared signed request coordinate written by FUN 00079030 in periodic-table index-21 dispatcher 00079dd8 after applying mode-controlled bounds to duplicated selection ffff2438/ffff19c2. Index-22 FUN 00073432 adds numeric bias 0x8000, inverse-searches the current-RPM 0xe98e row, and writes stock-active coordinate ffff198a.
note: The continuous 0x942c path continues through ffff198a, ffff183e, ffff19b2, per-channel targets, the feedback regulator, and ATU-II BFR6A-D. It remains separate from fuel mask ffff22e0; physical plate motion, channel-to-bank identity, and ECM terminals require hardware evidence.

semantics: Signed rotational-speed request-limit output written by FUN 0007584e under periodic-table index 11. ROM16[0x942c]=0xffff writes neutral 0x7fff and returns. Otherwise active/inactive ramp selection, the independent final rate, recovery envelope ffff19dc, and optional ffff4252.bit1 neutral override determine the value. Index-18 arbiter 00071508 takes its signed minimum with other controller limits.
note: Engagement requires previous signed output < APP request ffff243c; equality takes the inactive/reset path. This candidate reaches the throttle target chain but never enters independent six-channel fuel mask ffff22e0.

semantics: Signed ramp state of rotational-speed request limiter 0007584e. The active branch applies fast coefficient 0x9428 while ffff25b0 is nonzero and ffff24a3.bit2 is clear, or normal coefficient 0x9426 otherwise, then enforces the current-RPM first-column baseline from 0xe98e and upper saturation. The inactive branch copies APP request ffff243c when previous ffff19d8 is below neutral. A restrictive recovery envelope rolls this state back to its entry value; ffff4252.bit1 synchronizes it from ffff19c6.
note: Fast mode normally operates while the ramp is positive; a nonpositive entry value sets the latch before rate selection. The physical signed-request scale remains unresolved.

semantics: Signed recovery envelope of rotational-speed request limiter 0007584e. It tracks a lower request immediately only when that request is also below APP and ffff1083 > ffff1082. Otherwise it advances toward 0x7fff by 0x943a or 0x943c according to ffff1083 > ffff1064. Output is the signed minimum of the request and this envelope.
note: When this envelope is more restrictive, the function restores ramp ffff19da to its entry value. The physical context and request scale remain unresolved.

semantics: Signed limiter candidate written by adjacent calibrated branch 00075798 and selected by minimum arbiter 00071508.

Bank-1 exhaust-VTC duty word. FUN 000c2040 writes it at window offset 0x820 of base ffff128c with the bank index in r4, after copying the previous value to ffff1ab4+2*b. FUN 000c2152 converts it into ATU-II channel-7 buffer register fffff596. The exact service-0x22 pointer table publishes the same word as DID 0x122f.
note: Structured Nissan diagnostics name DID 0x122f VTC DTY EX B1. The output stage divides raw*ROM8[00008dfd]*125/1024 into a cycle register of 125*ROM8[00008dfd], so percent = raw*100/1024 is code-proven rather than homologous.

semantics: Bank-2 exhaust-VTC duty word. FUN 000c2040 writes it at window offset 0x820 of base ffff128c with the bank index in r4, after copying the previous value to ffff1ab4+2*b. FUN 000c2152 converts it into ATU-II channel-7 buffer register fffff594. The exact service-0x22 pointer table publishes the same word as DID 0x1230.
note: Structured Nissan diagnostics name DID 0x1230 VTC DTY EX B2. The output stage divides raw*ROM8[00008dfd]*125/1024 into a cycle register of 125*ROM8[00008dfd], so percent = raw*100/1024 is code-proven rather than homologous.

semantics: Unused slot of the four-slot exhaust-VTC duty word array at ffff1aac. FUN 000c2040 is the only writer of that array and indexes it with the bank argument in r4; dispatcher 000c2220 is its only caller and passes 0 and 1. No ROM code reads or writes this word.
note: The service-0x22 pointer table publishes the slot as DID 0x122d, named VTC DTY IN B1 by structured Nissan diagnostics, so the DID returns the RAM initialization value for the life of the image. The live intake duty command is ffff23b4/ffff23b5 and its diagnostic companion pair is ffff2440/ffff2441.

semantics: Unused slot of the four-slot exhaust-VTC duty word array at ffff1aac. FUN 000c2040 is the only writer of that array and indexes it with the bank argument in r4; dispatcher 000c2220 is its only caller and passes 0 and 1. No ROM code reads or writes this word.
note: The service-0x22 pointer table publishes the slot as DID 0x122e, named VTC DTY IN B2 by structured Nissan diagnostics, so the DID returns the RAM initialization value for the life of the image. The live intake duty command is ffff23b4/ffff23b5 and its diagnostic companion pair is ffff2440/ffff2441.

semantics: Axis input of Q16 blend weight 0x1488a in 00070e4c: ffff10d2 latched under gate ffff417e bit 3. The physical quantity is unresolved.

Centered cam-coordinate correction written by FUN 0004d2a6. Its normal value combines response-curve terms derived from intake target-minus-actual errors and target-versus-actual intake-plus-exhaust coordinates. Ignition-angle functions 0004afdc, 0004bdc2, and 00062fa4 consume the byte as value-64 or an algebraically equivalent centered term.
note: Code proves the centered cam-coordinate and ignition-angle path: 0004bdc2 subtracts 64 in the alternate branch and 128 for this term together with the low-seven map field in the normal branch, so the neutral value is 64 and one count is one crank degree of the final coordinate. The exact high-level calibration name remains unresolved.

semantics: Diagnostic scratch copy of the coolant-selected intake-cam target. FUN 000bdc66 writes cold target ffff1c5e at raw coolant <=106, warm/main target ffff1c5c above 131, or their signed linear blend with division truncated toward zero between the thresholds.
note: The same selected value continues in a register and stack slot through later conditioning; no external reader of ffff1bee is present. The exact DID raw-50 conversion maps the raw thresholds to 56 and 81 degC.

semantics: Warm/main intake-cam target byte. FUN 000bda64 writes the output of 0000b43a or clamp_u8(output_0000b43a-output_0000ab5a+128) when ffff2466.bit6 is set. FUN 000bdc66 selects or blends this value by coolant before the target enters ffff2326.
note: The centered representation and intake CVTC target path are exact. The engineering conversion raw*0.5-64 crank degrees follows the intake edge-phase unit of the actual bytes ffff2442/ffff2443 that the target is compared with.

semantics: Warm/main exhaust-CVTC target byte. FUN 000bfdc0 writes output 0000b33a directly or clamp_u8(output_0000b33a-output_0000ab4a+128) when ffff2466 bit 6 is set. FUN 000bfe88 selects or blends it by coolant before downstream exhaust-target conditioning.
note: The centered representation and exhaust-target path are exact. The candidate engineering conversion is raw*0.5-64 degCA.

semantics: Cold intake-cam target byte written directly from 8x8 surface 0000b53a. FUN 000bdc66 selects it at raw coolant <=106 and blends it with warm/main target ffff1c5c between raw coolant 106 and 131 before the target enters ffff2326.
note: The centered representation and cold intake CVTC target path are exact. The engineering conversion raw*0.5-64 crank degrees follows the intake edge-phase unit of the actual bytes ffff2442/ffff2443 that the target is compared with.

semantics: Cold/fallback exhaust-CVTC target byte written from 8x8 surface 0000b2fa. FUN 000bfe88 selects it below the cold coolant threshold and blends it with warm/main target ffff1c5d through the transition band before downstream conditioning into ffff2327.
note: The centered representation and exhaust-target path are exact. Stock 0000b2fa is neutral 128 throughout. The candidate engineering conversion is raw*0.5-64 degCA.

semantics: Bank-1 actual exhaust-cam timing byte. FUN 000bfc2e writes it at 000bfdae as 128 plus the filtered deviation of the three edge-phase snapshots ffff11c8, ffff11ca, and ffff11cc from learned rest edge ffff479b (mean of the three deviations while ROM8[00008615] bit 1 is set, first-order filter with coefficient curve 00012f7e against previous-pass copy ffff232a), skipping the update while driver status ffff850c bit 5 is set. The exact service-0x22 pointer table publishes it as DID 0x1164, and exhaust-VTC monitor 0008f168 compares it with common exhaust target ffff2327.
note: The exact response binding proves the target-firmware quantity and bank. Homologous diagnostics name DID 0x1164 EXH/V TIM B1. One count is 0.5 crank degrees of the exhaust-cam edge relative to the learned rest edge, which is the community definition raw*0.5-64 degCA; the unit follows the 3.2 us capture clock and the 120-degree event interval.

semantics: Bank-2 actual exhaust-cam timing byte. FUN 000bfc2e writes it at 000bfdae as 128 plus the filtered deviation of the three edge-phase snapshots ffff11c9, ffff11cb, and ffff11cd from learned rest edge ffff479c (mean of the three deviations while ROM8[00008615] bit 1 is set, first-order filter with coefficient curve 00012f7e against previous-pass copy ffff232b), skipping the update while driver status ffff850c bit 6 is set. The exact service-0x22 pointer table publishes it as DID 0x1165, and exhaust-VTC monitor 0008f168 compares it with common exhaust target ffff2327.
note: The exact response binding proves the target-firmware quantity and bank. Homologous diagnostics name DID 0x1165 EXH/V TIM B2. One count is 0.5 crank degrees of the exhaust-cam edge relative to the learned rest edge, which is the community definition raw*0.5-64 degCA; the unit follows the 3.2 us capture clock and the 120-degree event interval.

semantics: Common conditioned intake-cam target byte. FUN 000bdc66 starts from the coolant-selected main/cold target, applies mode, rate, and offset logic, and writes this byte. FUN 0004d2a6 compares the same target with actual intake-cam bytes ffff2442 and ffff2443 for both banks.
note: The target role, centered arithmetic, and common use for both intake banks are exact. Target-vehicle replay confirms the warm main-map path and identifies 1,968 samples in 51 runs where downstream logic forces neutral 128 despite an active reconstructed map result.

semantics: Common conditioned exhaust-cam target byte. FUN 000bfe88 selects or blends cold/fallback ffff1c5f and warm/main ffff1c5d, applies mode, rate, and offset constraints, and writes this byte. The exact service-0x22 pointer table publishes it as target-exhaust-angle DID 0x1166.
note: The exact DID and exhaust-VTC DTC paths prove the physical subsystem. Warm-path replay converges to this byte after downstream conditioning. Homologous HR definitions support candidate raw*0.5-64 degCA.

semantics: One of three RAM inputs of reciprocal-transfer-pair component 0x72f1e (pairs {0x18e86,0x18fd6} and {0x18e46,0x18f96}); the write source is unidentified.
note: The missing source is why the pair members are downgraded to candidate: their reciprocal role is confirmed by the trace, but the physical quantity is not.

semantics: One of three RAM inputs of reciprocal-transfer-pair component 0x72f1e; the write source is unidentified.
Closed-loop throttle/airflow/torque variable: when ffff4246 bit 6 is clear, 0003b468 writes ffff3a76; when set, it writes ROM word 0x916c. FUN_0003b498 reads the result.
note: Eight component consumers confirm the loop, but they do not establish physical units.

semantics: Raw uint16 interpolation result of map 0x147da, written by FUN 0004d99c before coefficient multiplication and division by 100.
note: This transient value is an intermediate in the conditional correction that ends at ffff12d6; it is not the diagnostic response.

semantics: Primary APC command byte and common UDS response source for exact JK08A DIDs 0x1107, 0x1108, 0x1109, and 0x110A. FUN 0004df82 normally writes uint8(110-uint8(ffff11d4)), passes the byte to 0002a892 for GR11A scheduling, and 0004e080 adds the bounded reset offset before calling 0002acba. J1979 Mode 01 PID 0x0E in FUN 00035856 reports ROM8[0x83d5]-ffff2022 as the timing advance.
note: The byte is a computed actuator command rather than a physical-angle measurement. Instrumented target-vehicle telemetry confirms that a late Rolling Launch adapter updates this byte before the APC scheduler while ffff11d4 retains the upstream stock coordinate. The normal-path formula 110-raw has the expected software-command direction; gated transforms and physical crank angle remain separate hardware boundaries. J1979 defines PID 0x0E as A/2-64 degrees before TDC, so the ECU declares 110-raw as crank degrees of advance.

semantics: Bank 1 short-term fuel-trim word in Q8.8 percent representation. FUN 0005c910 normally copies working word ffff40ac here; an alternate control path forces a whole-percent value. UDS DID 0x1123 returns the high byte, while J1979 PID 0x06 returns min(255, floor(ffff22dc/200)).
note: Neutral is 0x6400 = 100 percent. The UDS community conversion raw-100 exposes signed correction percent from the high byte; fractional content is not returned by DID 0x1123.

semantics: Bank 2 short-term fuel-trim word in Q8.8 percent representation. FUN 0005c910 normally copies working word ffff40ae here; UDS DID 0x1124 returns the high byte and J1979 PID 0x08 converts the complete word by division by 200.
note: Neutral is 0x6400 = 100 percent. The bank mapping is established independently by standard PID 0x08 and exact UDS pointer data.

semantics: Bank 1 long-term fuel-trim diagnostic word in Q8.8 percent representation. FUN 00057b26 combines selected learned cell ffff2306 with adjustment ffff5648 around neutral 0x6400, applies limits and fail-safe neutralization, and writes this word. UDS DID 0x1125 returns its high byte; J1979 PID 0x07 converts the complete word.
note: The stock normal-path clamp is 90..110 percent from ROM bytes 0x8e5b and 0x8e5a. Other gates may bypass this clamp or force 100 percent.

semantics: Bank 2 long-term fuel-trim diagnostic word in Q8.8 percent representation. FUN 00057b26 combines selected learned cell ffff2308 with adjustment ffff564a and publishes the result to UDS DID 0x1126 and J1979 PID 0x09.
note: The representation, limits, and neutralization paths mirror bank 1 exactly.

semantics: Selected bank 1 cell from the 64-word learned-fuel-trim grid at ffff4b90. FUN 0005796c writes the selected Q8.8-percent value; FUN 00057d1e adapts the selected grid cell and FUN 00057b26 consumes this word when forming diagnostic LTFT.
note: Selection uses an 8x8 operating-region index whose ffff1024 dimension is current Base Fuel Schedule.

semantics: Selected bank 2 cell from the 64-word learned-fuel-trim grid at ffff4b10. It is the bank-indexed companion of ffff2306 and enters the bank 2 LTFT diagnostic word.
note: The selector, update, bounds, and reset behavior mirror bank 1.

semantics: Multipurpose bitfield. Bit 7 is the hysteretic engine-speed readiness state for P030 qualification. FUN 0007c4e0 sets it when saturated RPM/12.5 byte ffff11b2 is at least stock ROM8[00008bda] = 32 and, once set, retains it while the byte is at least 28. FUN 000593ac writes the same byte only to OR bit 6.
note: The thresholds correspond to setting at 400 RPM and clearing below 350 RPM. A whole-program p-code pass over all 2315 functions found four exact accesses, no unresolved candidates, and no other bit-7 writer.

semantics: Saturating count of consecutive qualified rotational-reference interval samples for the misfire monitor. FUN 0003cf24 consumes ffff84f2.bit7, shifts the interval history, and increments this byte only when the speed/prior-reference checks pass and ffff4247.bit6 is set. Invalid qualification or a clear configuration bit resets it. Detection core 00085a70 requires at least 19 samples; revolution-window producer 000872d0 requires at least 31.
note: The counter saturates at 255. Static code does not establish the physical cadence of one accepted sample, so the 19- and 31-sample gates are not converted to revolutions or time.

semantics: Saturating count of consecutive speed-qualified revolution services for the P030 monitor. Once-per-revolution FUN 0007c4e0 increments it while ffff24c4.bit7 is set and resets it when the hysteresis state is clear. FUN 0003cf24 and coordinator 00082c8a both require it to reach stock ROM8[000083b8] = 1.
note: The counter saturates at 255. A whole-program p-code pass over all 2315 functions found four exact accesses, no unresolved candidates, and FUN 0007c4e0 as the only writer. Below the stock threshold, FUN 00082c8a clears ffff4251.bits6/7.

semantics: First admitted-revolution counter in the misfire monitor. FUN 000872d0 compares it with 200*ROM8[00008354], which is 200 in stock JK08A, resets it on completion, and sets ffff4241 bit 5. It increments with ffff40a0 when the common readiness gates pass and ffff444d is zero.
note: Failure of ffff4251.bit7 or ffff41d2.bits0/1 resets the counter. Qualified rotational-reference sample count ffff3834 below 31 and nonzero ffff444d freeze it.

semantics: Long admitted-revolution counter in the misfire monitor. FUN 000872d0 compares it with the literal 1000, resets it on completion, and sets ffff4241 bit 7. It increments with ffff409e when the common readiness gates pass and ffff444d is zero.
note: Failure of ffff4251.bit7 or ffff41d2.bits0/1 resets the counter. Qualified rotational-reference sample count ffff3834 below 31 and nonzero ffff444d freeze it.

semantics: Second admitted-revolution counter in the misfire monitor. FUN 000872d0 compares it with 200*ROM8[00008656], which is 200 in stock JK08A, resets it on completion, and sets ffff4241 bit 6. It increments when the common readiness gates pass and ffff444c is zero.
note: Failure of ffff4251.bit7 or ffff41d2.bits0/1 resets the counter. Qualified rotational-reference sample count ffff3834 below 31 and nonzero ffff444c freeze it.

semantics: Working bank 1 closed-loop fuel-correction word written by FUN 0005cbec and copied by FUN 0005c910 to short-term fuel-trim diagnostic word ffff22dc on the normal path.
note: The output role and Q8.8-percent representation are exact; narrower names for the internal feedback terms in FUN 0005cbec remain unresolved.

semantics: Working bank 2 closed-loop fuel-correction word written by FUN 0005cbec and copied by FUN 0005c910 to ffff22de on the normal path.
note: The bank mapping follows the downstream standard PID and UDS paths.

semantics: Base of the 64-word bank 2 learned-fuel-trim RAM grid. FUN 0005796c selects one Q8.8-percent cell by an 8x8 operating-region index, and FUN 00057d1e updates selected cells with bounds 90..110 percent. Reset paths fill all cells with 0x6400.
note: This is adaptive RAM state, not a flash calibration table.

semantics: Base of the 64-word bank 1 learned-fuel-trim RAM grid. Its selection, update, bounds, and full-grid reset mirror bank 2.
note: This is adaptive RAM state, not a flash calibration table.

semantics: Bank 1 Q8.8-percent adjustment term maintained by FUN 00058168. FUN 00057b26 combines it with selected learned cell ffff2306 as ffff2306 + ffff5648 - 0x6400 when forming diagnostic LTFT ffff2302.
note: Fault paths force neutral 0x6400. The exact operating-mode name for this term remains unresolved.

semantics: Bank 2 companion of adjustment term ffff5648. It is maintained by the same bank-indexed function and combined with selected learned cell ffff2308 when forming ffff2304.
note: The arithmetic and neutral behavior mirror bank 1.

semantics: Final six-channel fuel-output inhibit/override mask written at periodic-table index 27 by 0004ed88. Exact order is P=global_3f|DFCO_mask|count_mask, R=runtime_replacement when active else P, then ffff22e0=(R|auxiliary_mask)&0x3f. FUN 00052034 blocks corresponding ffff1220 eligibility bits, FUN 0004eba2 selects override ffff2436, and 0002c13c substitutes fallback ffff23aa.
note: Main and stationary RPM cuts each make the global term 0x3f. Runtime replacement can substitute global/DFCO/count bits; the auxiliary mask is ORed afterward. The request limiter rooted at 0000942c is outside this formula.

semantics: Bits 0 and 1 form the combined gate for compensation 0x11f1a in the angle summation.

Published main-fuel control multiplier. FUN 000556ec writes working value ffff18e4 here unless aggregate six-channel inhibit mask ffff22e0 equals 0x3f, in which case it writes zero. FUN 0004e974 scales current BFS or alternate schedule by this word over 131072 before forming common and bank-specific pulse precursors; FUN 0005727a independently uses it with a right shift of 15.
note: Its exact arithmetic roles and full-inhibit zero publication are established. A single universal engineering scale and physical control name are not assigned.

semantics: Bits 0/1 gate sum terms in 00054ee0.
Bits 0 and 1 select the source for interpolation of inverse pair 0x13202/0x155a0 in wrapper 0003e548.
note: The selector role is established by code; the physical meaning of the selection is candidate.

semantics: Scheduler snapshot of injector opening time ffff2436, produced by the 140-byte ffff23bc -> ffff2330 copy in 00020dfe. ATU-II one-shot scheduler 0002c13c selects it per channel when ffff22e0 or ffff1935 contains the channel bit, and subtracts it from the selected word when the DSTR start bit is already set. FUN_00054d3e fills the whole duration array with it while the engine is stopped or fuel is inhibited.
note: One count is 10 us. Substituting the opening time for an inhibited channel commands a pulse that delivers no fuel.

semantics: First word of the six-channel compensated injection-pulse output written by FUN_0004eba2. UDS DID 0x1206 returns this word in big-endian order. Each element also passes through FUN_0005b7ec into transformed array ffff23d4, which reaches the ATU-II one-shot outputs through scheduler snapshot ffff2348 and duration array ffff224e.
note: The VQ35HR factory manual identifies the corresponding monitor as actual compensated injection pulse width for bank 1. One count is 10 us: scheduler 0002c13c adds 800*raw/256 steps to a channel-8 down-counter clocked at Pphi/64, so ms = raw/100 and full scale is 655.35 ms.

semantics: Second word of the six-channel compensated injection-pulse output written by FUN_0004eba2. UDS DID 0x1207 returns this word in big-endian order.
note: The VQ35HR factory manual identifies the corresponding monitor as actual compensated injection pulse width for bank 2. A homologous structured profile supplies scale raw/100 ms.

semantics: Signed timing-state byte written by 0004afdc as clamp_s8(s8(ffff1514)+u8(ffff12db)+s8(ffff1511)+u8(ffff1512)+u8(ffff1349)-128). The alternate branch of 0004bdc2 consumes it while forming ffff1830.
note: The value reaches the actuator through ffff1830 -> ffff2404 -> ffff2378 -> ffff12d6 -> ffff11da -> ffff11d4 with coefficient 1, so one count is one crank degree of the J1979 PID 0x0E coordinate. Exact source-selection predicates for ffff1511 are recorded in 0004afdc. A matched target-vehicle A/B capture shows that default map 00012196 propagates one-for-one into the final software timing coordinate during warm deceleration.

semantics: Signed auxiliary request written by rotational-speed request limiter 0007584e. When final limiter output is below APP request and ffff1083 > ffff1082, it receives offset-binary table 0x14384 at index min(ffff1083,4) minus 0x8000. Otherwise it receives neutral lower sentinel -0x8000.
note: The centered stock table values are [1000, 1300, 1300, 1000, 1000]. Its exact downstream consumer and physical request scale remain unresolved.

semantics: Selected signed request limit from periodic-table index-18 minimum arbiter 00071508. It includes 0000942c-derived ffff19d8, adjacent limiter candidate ffff19de, and other bounds, then enters index-20 controller calculation and final selector 00070d82.
note: The exact physical output unit of the request controller remains unresolved.

semantics: APP-derived signed request candidate written by 00075540 after pedal preprocessing and inverse conversion through 0xe98e. It enters the shared request-limit subsystem, including 0007584e, and 00073432 also inverse-searches it directly after adding numeric bias 0x8000.
note: The direct inverse result ffff1984 is not the stock actuator path because 000730fc gates that branch with stock-disabled 0x870c.bit7. The shared path continues through ffff19c6 and ffff198a.

semantics: First byte of the centered two-bank intake-cam timing pair. FUN_000bd9f0 writes clamp_u8(0x80 + ffff4799 - ffff22cc), or neutral 0x80 under the hardware-control mask. UDS DID 0x1135 returns this byte directly.
note: Homologous VQ35HR sources identify DID 0x1135 as intake valve timing bank 1. One count is 0.5 crank degrees: edge phase ffff22cc carries the intake edge-phase unit of capture handler 0002a5cc, and the difference is signed so that an edge earlier than the rest edge reads above 0x80 (advance positive). The conversion raw*0.5-64 degCA is exact in the code unit; the crank-wheel origin of the absolute angle remains open.

semantics: Second byte of the centered two-bank intake-cam timing pair. FUN_000bd9f0 writes clamp_u8(0x80 + ffff479a - ffff22cd), or neutral 0x80 under the hardware-control mask.
note: One count is 0.5 crank degrees through edge phase ffff22cd of capture handler 0002a36a, the same unit and sign as ffff2442; the crank-wheel origin of the absolute angle remains open.

semantics: Bit 5 is the projected phase of five-state machine ffff39d8: FUN 00027530 sets it for states 2..4 and clears it for states 0/1; scheduler 00020dfe also refreshes the byte from ffff2451. In the P030 count-readiness path, bit 5 controls whether ffff42a8 is refreshed or retained and is mandatory for setting ffff41d2.bit1. Bit 2 must be clear for 0004afdc to select warm transition timing table 0001219e; the same bit selects the 00011f0a versus 00011f12 correction and must be set for fuel-output inhibit state machine 0004f324. Bit 1 selects curve A or B in FUN 0004569c.
note: The bit-5 state relation, timing-table gate, P030 latch role, and bit-1 curve selection are exact. The physical mode represented by ffff39d8 and curve selection remains unresolved.

semantics: Bit 7 directly mirrors SH7058 PHDR.PH9DR and participates in the 0001202e RPM-drop publication gate; FUN 0002e0d4 publishes it as bit 2 of DID 0x1305 response byte ffff3345. Bit 5 is set by FUN 00027530 for state ffff39d8 values 2..4 and cleared for states 0/1; scheduler 00020dfe copies this current byte to ffff244f. Bit 1 gates the differential-term contribution in 000413cc and helps select the map-read path in 0003c4a0 and 0002c59c. FUN 00038618 sets bit 2 when battery-voltage raw ffff1188 is at most 100 or ffff1164 bit 2 is clear.
note: PH9 is MCU pin 74. A structured Nissan profile names DID 0x1305 bit 2 BRAKE SW, and the VQ35HR factory manual defines BRAKE SW as the condition of the stop lamp switch signal; the ECM terminal of PH9 remains unresolved. Exact DID 0x1103 identifies ffff1188 as battery voltage; the source-bound conversion maps raw 100 to 8.00 V. The physical mode represented by bit 5 remains unresolved.

semantics: Current periodic snapshot of producer byte ffff2459; scheduler 00020dfe first copies the old value to ffff245a and then copies ffff2459 here. Bit 5 is the upstream DFCO mode/eligibility input: 0004fbe2 requires it for cut request, 00050018 returns master-inhibit class 1 when clear, 000503e0 uses it in release/reset branches, and 0004afdc uses its clear-to-set interval to reload then consume timing-transition timer ffff2590. Bit 7 combines with ffff22ff state 3 to select the +30 timing constant bypass.
note: The bit-5 Boolean role in DFCO and timing-transition selection is code-proven. Bit 5 is the scheduled copy of ffff2459.bit5, which FUN 0002e0d4 publishes as DID 0x1302 bit 0; a structured Nissan profile names that bit CLSD THL POS.

semantics: Base of the decel/cut flag group: read by ten functions, with no resolved writes because the group is addressed by offsets from a loaded base (40 slots across the ROM). The angle-calculation range 0x82c8a..0x84436 contains none of these slots, ruling out a decel-gated branch in the angle summation.

Bit 5 selects the source used by per-channel difference producer 0005727a: set selects ffff123e, clear selects ffff1024. Bit 6 satisfies the secondary readiness clause of fuel-output inhibit state machine 0004f324 when ffff1071 is below ROM8[00008d0e]. The byte also participates in the ROM8[00008d92].bit3-clear calculation path of 00051a98.
note: Stock ROM8[00008d0e]=0 makes the unsigned ffff1071 comparison always true, so bit 6 cannot block readiness in JK08A. Bit 5 is a source selector in the stock per-channel path, not an identified Over Run Fuel Cut state.

semantics: Bit 6 gates channel-specific Q15 trim application in both parallel raw-output calculations: map 0001484a in FUN 0007a592 and map 00018d36 in FUN 0007a804.
note: Both trim maps are flat 0x8000, or unity, in stock JK08A. Both lookup branches remain reachable at runtime.

semantics: Bit 7 gates bypassing interpolation in 0004b790.
Source of a calibration limit in 00062c68 together with ffff24c2.

Multipurpose state byte. Bit 6 selects active hot timing surface 0x9A1A when clear and 0x9B1A when set in 0004e1c0; reference sample ffff1610 remains based on 0x9A1A. Coordinator 000493e8 updates the selector through several gates. One hysteresis branch sets it at signed Q8 ffff1382 <= -1792 and clears it only above 8192. Bit 6 also selects the high-detonation scaling of the target mixture in 0005594a: when set, the deviation of the 0000a9aa result from 128 is scaled by 00012552.
note: Bit-6 feedback forms the knock/high-detonation surface-selection loop. Other coordinator gates can force either state.

semantics: Bit 3 is the wide-open-throttle latch of stage 0005594a: set when throttle-opening byte ffff3528, plus 8 while already set, is >= the flat 200 of map 0001214e, which is about 70 degrees of throttle valve opening. While set, 0005594a and 000bfdc0 force 0xff onto the upper load axis instead of normal source ffff102c (000bfdc0 additionally requires ffff5773 bit 0), and request byte ffff1411 takes its wide-open branches. Bit 4 selects column 0 or 1 of engine-speed fuel-cut table 0000934e in 0004f282.
note: The 70-degree figure follows the candidate 0.0275-degree scale of axis 000155a0 through ffff40c6 and 00054eb8. The public HR A2L catalog labels the two fuel-cut columns Normal and Reverse; exact code proves the two-way selection but not those physical mode labels.

semantics: Current accelerator-pedal high-state byte. FUN 00047a56 sets or clears bit 7 after comparing normalized dual-channel sample ffff266e with the selected threshold at 00008fdc/00008fde.
Bit 6 selects the centered two-bank multiplier path in FUN 00055098. Set uses lookup 00012ede indexed by min(u8[ffff2442],u8[ffff2443]); clear substitutes raw 64 in the same factor slot.
note: Code proves the selection mechanism. The physical mode represented by bit 6 remains unresolved.

semantics: Previous-cycle snapshot of ffff246a. Scheduler 00020dfe copies three bytes from ffff246a..ffff246c to ffff246d..ffff246f; bit 7 selects the release threshold 00008fde when the preceding accelerator-pedal high state was set and activation threshold 00008fdc when it was clear.
note: The current-to-previous copy closes exact activation/release hysteresis. This byte is not a rev-limit mode selector.

semantics: Result of comparison against a map output in 0005651c together with ffff2493.

Multipurpose status byte. In stationary limiter 0004f324, bit 3 marks entered timer state, bit 4 marks readiness, and bit 5 is the active 1800/1500 RPM hysteresis cut. Failure of any stationary entry gate clears bits 3..5 together with ffff16a6. In the independent EVAP purge-control circuit monitor, FUN 000acc54 controls bits 6 and 7; FUN 000abca2 consumes bit 7 as the exact P0443 dispatch condition.
note: Bit 5 becomes global fuel mask 0x3f. The byte is shared by independent state machines; the stock P0443 producer branch is skipped because ROM8[0x186d7].bit2 is clear.

semantics: One of three factors in the map-read condition in 00052be8 together with ffff2458 and ffff249d.
Bit 4 selects special path 0x1230a in 00056bd0.

Multipurpose initialization byte. FUN 0007584e uses bit 0 as the speed-filter initialization latch: clear selects min(65535,4*N), then sets the bit; set selects the recursive N+floor(3*S/4) update. Bit 1 independently remains a one-time initialization latch in the second sum term of FUN 00054ee0.
note: The two bits belong to independent state machines and must be described separately.

semantics: Selector between a map path and constant 0x8000 in 0007173c. Bits 0 and 2 gate the exhaust-VTC control-mode state machine in FUN 000c1dec: both set permit mode 0->1 and 2->1 together with the bank bit of ffff1246, and a clear bit 0 forces mode 1->0 and 2->0. Enable coordinator 000bf630 writes bit 0 at 000bf852 as the electrical enable (battery snapshot ffff1108 in 126..200, edge-count anomaly flags ffff850c bits 5 and 6 clear, sensor-fault predicate 00025e4e zero, ffff244f bit 5 set, and record predicate 00025e20 clear for the P0014/P0024 extension slots 0x14f..0x152, the P0078/P0084 records 0x43 and 0x44, and, with ROM8[00008616] bit 0 set as in stock JK08A, the P0197/P0198/P0196 records 0xdd, 0xde, and 0xe4) and bit 2 at 000bf99a as the operating enable (bit 0 set, ffff2458 bit 5 clear, coolant window ffff246c bit 2 without latch ffff248c bit 6 or active-test request ffff249c bit 6 set, oil-temperature flag ffff246c bit 3 set with latch ffff248c bit 7 clear under the stock ROM8[00008616] bit 0, engine speed at least 900 RPM with release at 700 RPM, and ffff41be bit 6, ffff41d1 bit 7, ffff41d0 bit 0, ffff2f64 bits 0 and 1, and ffff14b8 bits 0 and 1 all clear). Bit 1 is written by 000bd20a, bit 4 by 0004efe0 and 0006378e, bit 5 by 0008c9fe, and bit 7 by 0007173c.
note: The tests of ROM8[00008616] bit 0 at 000bf80e and 000bf974 pass both extra terms while the bit is clear; stock JK08A holds 0x01, so both terms apply. ffff850c bits 5 and 6 are written by edge-count monitor 000c22dc and ffff249c bit 6 by active-test driver 0002e466. ffff2458 bit 5 is the scheduled CLSD THL POS status of DID 0x1302 bit 0. Of the inhibit terms, ffff41be bit 6 (0008c24e) and ffff41d1 bit 7 (0008c272) are stored-fault summaries of DTC attribute bits 8 and 10, ffff41d0 bit 0 has no setter, and ffff2f64 (00090d54) and ffff14b8 (00090bd2) stay clear under the stock masks ROM8[000186f2]=0x07 and ROM8[000186f1]=0xf0.

semantics: Multipurpose state byte. Bit 4 gates the ffff1513 update in 0004afdc and its one-count decay in 0004e112.
note: Code establishes the state gate, not an adaptive-learning meaning.

semantics: Threshold latch in 0005525a under master gate ffff2458.
Threshold latch in 0005525a under master gate ffff2458; in 0005651c, the same byte together with ffff2474 carries the result of comparison against a map output.

Shared fuel-inhibit state byte. FUN 0004f282 uses bit 1 for engine-speed cut delay arming and bit 2 for the active main RPM cut. FUN 0004f9c4 uses bit 7 for its transition-window low-speed RPM cut. FUN 00050b3c uses bit 0 for the P0011/P0021 3000/2800 RPM hysteresis state.
note: Each writer preserves the unrelated bits. Bits 0, 2, and 7 feed separate global contributors.

semantics: Combined enable in 00071448.
One of three factors in the map-read condition in 00052be8 together with ffff2458 and ffff2481.

Multipurpose state byte. FUN 0007584e uses bit 0 as coolant-indexed alternate-threshold hysteresis: clear sets at raw ffff1071 >= 255; set adds 16 before the same comparison, retaining through raw 239 and clearing at 238.
