note: Exact DID conversion raw-50 gives theoretical 205/189/188 deg C boundaries. The stock alternate threshold 0x9434 is 0xffff, so this latch does not change the normal stock limiter threshold. Other bits and consumers remain independent.

semantics: Multipurpose state byte. FUN 0004f662 uses bit 0 for a stock-inert BFS hysteresis contributor. FUN 000507ce uses bit 2 for a 6375 RPM high-speed contributor with 200 RPM hysteresis. Bit 1 independently selects endpoint pairs in both parallel raw-output channels.
note: The bit-set raw-output endpoints are pairwise identical in stock JK08A. These three bit roles belong to independent state machines.

semantics: Mode and override selector in 00056ea6.

Multipurpose DTC status byte. FUN 000aacc0 controls bit 2 in its calibrated complementary P0448 status path. FUN 000ad8fe sets bit 6 for the exact P0441 purge-flow result, and FUN 000abca2 consumes and clears bit 6 after dispatch.
note: The same byte also participates in hysteresis comparators in FUN 00071448. ROM8[0x18700].bit1 is clear, so the P0441 producer and exact dispatch branch are skipped in stock JK08A. Individual bit roles must not be generalized across those state machines.

semantics: Bit 7 is the enrichment latch of stage 0005594a: set when the target mixture byte, plus ROM8[00008b9b] - ROM8[00008b9f] = 1 while already set, is >= ROM8[00008b9b] = 130; while clear, ffff15eb is forced to 128, the closed-loop stoichiometric target.

Multipurpose state byte. FUN 0007584e uses bit 2 as the nonpositive-ramp latch. The inactive/reset branch clears it; an active pass sets it when entry ramp ffff19da is not greater than ROM16[0x8f2c]=0. A set bit selects normal rate 0x9426 instead of fast rate 0x9428.
note: The latch is checked before the ramp update, so one final fast step can cross zero before the next pass selects the normal rate. Other bits and consumers remain independent.

semantics: Participates in hysteresis comparators in 00071448 together with ffff24a1; the trace does not distinguish whether it is the input or state.

Multipurpose state byte. FUN 0004f050 maintains bit 5 as the 4500/5000 RPM gate for vehicle-speed fuel cut; FUN 0004f19c uses bit 7 as its speed-entry arming state. Bit 1 independently selects a branch in 000bdb66. FUN 000bfe88 maintains bit 3 as the exhaust-VTC demand flag: set while coolant-selected target ffff1c90, plus hysteresis ROM8[000086f4] once set, reaches ROM8[00008dcb]+128, and cleared otherwise. A set bit 3 ORs bits 0 and 1 into bank-enable byte ffff1246.
note: Bit 5 gates the ffff24a6.bit0 active state; bit 7 records speed-threshold entry while the stock activation delay runs.

semantics: State byte in FUN 0004d2a6. Bit 3 is coolant hysteresis: it sets at raw ffff1071>=107 from ROM8[00008e03]=106 and clears at ffff1071<=103 using offset 3. Bit 6 is inverse coolant hysteresis through FUN 000259d0: it sets at ffff1071<=170 from ROM8[00008e00]=170 and clears at ffff1071>=174 using the same offset.
note: The raw coolant thresholds are exact. Conversion of ffff1071 to an engineering temperature remains outside this claim.

semantics: Bit 6 is a one-shot init latch that gates the single baseline lookup of map 0x18766 in 00073824 through test-then-set. Bit 7 is the standstill flag of exhaust-VTC conditioner FUN 000bfe88: hysteresis comparator 000259d0 sets it while coarse vehicle-speed byte ffff110e is at or below ROM8[00008e3c]=2 and clears it above 2+ROM8[000086e8]=3, stored at 000bff4e; it is one input of standstill override predicate ffff246c bit 1.
note: The claim for bit 4 of the same byte, threshold 'clamp activated', has no verdict because its refutation failed; confidence remains candidate.

semantics: Monitor condition in 00047a56 within the rev-limiter component.
Bit 2 is an init-once latch for the one-time read of flat maps 0x120be/0x12c3a in 0003995a (tst 0x4 / or 0x4).
Gate for the entire calculation branch in 00068cb8.

Multipurpose state byte. FUN 0004a238 writes bit 6 as the current selected-channel knock-threshold comparison result; set means the calculated uint32 metric exceeds the selected uint16 threshold. Other bits and consumers belong to independent calculations.
note: Bit 6 describes the current evaluator result and is not an interval-latched event flag.

semantics: Monitor aggregate in 00047a56 within the rev-limiter component.
Mask 0x2 gates map recalculation in 0004d99c.

Base of the decel/cut flag group and the flag cell itself: throttle-release detection output byte[ffff24d2] is addressed as ffff24ce+4. The angle-calculation range 0x82c8a..0x84436 contains none of the group's 59 slots found across the ROM, ruling out a decel-gated branch in the angle summation.
Bit 1 selects path 2 that bypasses maps in 00056bd0.
Bit 0x10 is the throttle-release detector output in 0005185c; addressed as ffff24ce+4.
note: The complete ROM reference scan finds no direct test of bit 0x10; consumers of this byte test other bits. A direct link from this detector to the aggregate fuel-output inhibit path is therefore not established.

semantics: Optional activation-delay countdown for engine-speed fuel-cut state machine 0004f282. On a new activation request it is loaded from ROM8[00008c69]; state bit 2 in ffff2497 is set when the countdown is zero.
note: Stock ROM8[00008c69]=0, so the working fuel cut activates without a calibrated delay.

semantics: Fast-ramp mode byte of rotational-speed request limiter 0007584e. Initializer 0002c648 and the limiter inactive/reset branch both load ROM8[0x8a9b]=100. A nonzero value selects rate 0x9428 while ffff24a3.bit2 remains clear; the set latch selects rate 0x9426.
note: A whole-program p-code census of all 2315 functions found only these two writes and the limiter read, with no computed-address candidates. No countdown exists: the stock byte remains 100, and ffff24a3.bit2 alone changes the fast-versus-normal rate after initialization.

semantics: Full-byte gate for the OFF->ON transition in 0004f662.
Scheduler snapshot of normalized dual-channel accelerator-pedal quantity ffff2672. FUN 00047a56 compares this sample with activation/release thresholds 00008fdc/00008fde.
note: The producer traces to A/D channels AN10 and AN17 through signed channel adjustment and minimum selection. It is not an engine-speed signal.

semantics: Current normalized dual-channel accelerator-pedal quantity. FUN 0006ec68 clamps two adjusted analog channels, selects their minimum with mode handling, optionally rate-limits it, and writes this word; scheduler 00020dfe snapshots it to ffff266e.
note: This internal normalized count is not either individual sensor voltage.

semantics: Exact JK08A UDS DID 0x120D source and first accelerator-pedal sensor diagnostic value. FUN 000a7040 accepts ROM16[0x8ffc]=60..ROM16[0x8ff8]=964 counts and dispatches P2123/P2122 outside that window.
note: The acceptance window is 0.30..4.82 V at 5 mV per count and brackets the factory band of 0.5..1.0 V released and 4.2..4.8 V depressed. Target recordings hold the released word near 151 counts and reach 940 counts at full stroke. The diagnostic display unit is V at 5 mV per count; JK08A.diagnostics.md derives that scale.

semantics: Exact JK08A UDS DID 0x120E source and second accelerator-pedal sensor diagnostic value, referred to the sensor-1 scale. FUN 000a70f0 accepts ROM16[0x8ffc]=60..ROM16[0x8ffa]=1000 counts and dispatches P2128/P2127 outside that window.

FUN 00079ba4 maintains it with source ffff35ea; FUN 0007a804 selects ffff35ea instead of the bounded calculation for final word ffff35cc; FUN 0007b0a0 selects ffff35ea instead of ffff2a7a as its local input. Multipurpose configuration byte. Bit 6 enables accumulation of qualified misfire sample count ffff3834 in FUN 0003cf24 and gates four branches in detection core 00085a70. An exact-byte whole-program p-code pass over all 2315 JK08A functions found 12 accesses in eight functions. The only resolved write is FUN 000d093c preserving the byte and ORing bit 4. A broader source-boundary pass over ffff4000..ffff42ff found no base-relative, pointer-derived, or constant-address write capable of producing bit 6.

semantics: Bit 3 selects one of the byte-identical floor curves 0x12908/0x12918 in 00046938.

Multipurpose bitfield. Bit 0 is an alternate enable input to FUN 000bc9e4 and forces scheduled value 1000 in ATU-II one-shot scheduler 0002c13c. Every failed prerequisite clears both bits. Bit 7 gates snapshot matching, auxiliary monitor state, detection-core accumulation, a five-channel helper, and all three revolution windows. Memory task 000cd85c is the only setter of bit 0: it executes or #1 at 000cdd4e (cmp/eq #3 at 000cdd40) for request 3 of manufacturer diagnostic service 0xa0, whose handler 000306f8 copies the request byte ffff8005 into ffff40be at 000309ca and sets pending flag ffff41de bit 0 at 000309d6; scheduler task 0002e8d2 runs the memory task with that request while the flag is set.

semantics: Multipurpose state byte. On the stock-selected transmission path, FUN 00077892 sets bit 1 exactly when ffff418f.bit4 is set, current gear index ffff1082 differs from target gear index ffff1083, and aggregate inhibit ffff4253.bit6 is clear; otherwise it clears bit 1. FUN 0007584e uses bit 1 as a forced-neutral override after recovery selection: set writes 0x7fff to ffff19d8 and copies shared signed request ffff19c6 into ramp ffff19da before auxiliary-output evaluation.

Bit 1 requires ffff418f.bit4, the scheduler latch of TCM field ffff3a2e == 3 from CAN 0x174 byte 4; whether the TCM transmits that value is a live-capture question, so the stock-lifecycle state of bit 1 depends on that field. Other bits and consumers belong to independent state.

semantics: Multipurpose state byte. FUN 00077892 recomputes bit 6 as a transmission-transition inhibit aggregate. It clears bit 6 only when ffff424c.bit3 is set, ffff415c is zero, ffff41a5.bit2 is set, ffff4200.bit0 is set, ffff4201.bit7 is set, and signed ffff34ba is at least 0x2710; every failed prerequisite sets bit 6.

semantics: Inter-cycle latch for P030 counting-readiness bit ffff41d2.bit1. Let F = ffff244f.bit5. In stock JK08A, ROM8[00008afc].bit3 is set: while F is clear, FUN 00082c8a refreshes the latch with ROM8[00008499] = 0xb4 when ffff422d.bit4 is set or with the all-zero map 0x12026 result when it is clear, and clears bit 1. While F is set, the latch is retained and bit 1 is set exactly when the retained value is zero. Normal startup clears both this latch and ffff422d.bit4; all seven direct runtime writers of ffff422d preserve bit 4, so the latch remains zero throughout the stock application-code lifecycle.

The 0xb4 branch remains structurally present but is not reached under the proven stock application-code lifecycle.

semantics: Output of inhibit curve 0x12CBE, a duplicate of 0x1263A in an inhibit role, together with adjacent ffff444c/ffff444d; read by 00085a70.

Second misfire revolution-track inhibit and output of curve 0x12CBE, a duplicate of 0x1263A in an inhibit role. A nonzero value freezes counter ffff40a2 in FUN 000872d0; zero admits its increment. The same byte is consumed by detection core 00085a70 and helper 00085020.

semantics: Shared misfire revolution-track inhibit and output of curve 0x12CBE, a duplicate of 0x1263A in an inhibit role. A nonzero value freezes counters ffff409e and ffff40a0 in FUN 000872d0; zero admits both increments. The same byte is consumed by detection core 00085a70 and helper 00085020.

semantics: Word whose high byte is the input of 1D curve 0x129D2 in 000b997c.

ATU-II engine-event mode selector. FUN 00029588 dispatches values 0, 4, 6, 7, 8, and 9; selector 9 controls the P030 ICR0A interval path. FUN 00028dc8, FUN 0002a36a, FUN 0002a5cc, FUN 0003e04e, FUN 000c2c58, and FUN 000c2d76 use the same selector in timer scheduling, capture arithmetic, or mode conversion.

A broader ffff128c..ffff13ff pass and review of its 107 candidate writes plus seven constant-address calls found no writer capable of reaching offset 0x126. The initialization source and physical names of the selector modes remain unresolved.

semantics: One-bit current-cylinder mask for the high byte of POPCR. On the enabled APC path it selects the PULSxROE reset action associated with GR11B; engine inhibit ffff4198 bit 1 clears it.

semantics: Internal developer-immobilizer state-machine flags. Bits 1/2 contribute to engine-inhibit generation in FUN_000bc9e4; FUN_000bbc88, FUN_000bc388, and FUN_000bc82e update the state.

Multipurpose status byte. Bit 1 is the developer-immobilizer engine inhibit generated by FUN_000bc9e4; when set, drivers 00029588 and 0002af38 block the per-cylinder mask and ATU-II/APC engine-event configuration.

Multipurpose status byte. Bit 0 contains NATS registered channel 0 and is managed by FUN_000937dc. In the misfire component, bit 1 gates group-0 snapshot capture; even reporter argument 0 sets it after capture. Global expiry FUN 0007c57a and group-0 cleanup FUN 0007c8fa clear it with the retained payload.

semantics: Multipurpose status byte. Bit 6 contains NATS registered channel 1 and is managed by FUN_000937dc.

semantics: Multipurpose status byte. Bit 2 contains the NATS Lock state and is set by FUN_0008d724 after a counter threshold.

semantics: Internal developer-immobilizer state byte. Bit 0 reflects transitions of the main state machine; FUN_000bc82e normalizes state before calculating inhibit.
Internal developer-immobilizer state-machine word. Bit 2 is a direct input to FUN_000bc9e4; when ROM 0x8725 bit 0 = 0, FUN_000bc82e clears bit 2.
Root of the 32-bit ATU-II channel 0A input-capture register pair ICR0A. FUN 00029588 uses a longword read as the current capture for the selector-9 interval sample and previous-reference refresh.
note: The hardware register identity is exact. The TI0A pin source and the physical crank-angle cadence of selector-9 captures remain unresolved.

semantics: POPCR, the 16-bit Advanced Pulse Controller register. Bits 7:0 enable output 1 on the corresponding PULS pin at GR11A compare; bits 15:8 enable output 0 at GR11B compare. Current-cylinder masks ffff13bd and ffff13d1 select the low-byte and high-byte actions.
note: Register behavior is silicon-documentation ground truth. External driver polarity and the physical spark edge are not established.

semantics: Bank-1 bounded integrator state in 000a0ee8. The interpolated ramp-up step from map 0x1462a is added to the state, which is clamped to [floor..cap] and published as exact DID 0x1249.
note: Structured Nissan diagnostics identify DID 0x1249 as A/F ADJ-B1. Public sources disagree on signedness and scale, so the physical conversion remains unresolved. Counterpart 0x1463a as a decrement step is refuted because its symmetric trace was not completed.

semantics: Bank-2 bounded integrator state in 000a0ee8. It uses the same ramp-up step from map 0x1462a, is clamped to the same bounds, and is published as exact DID 0x124a.
note: Structured Nissan diagnostics identify DID 0x124a as A/F ADJ-B2. Public sources disagree on signedness and scale, so the physical conversion remains unresolved.

semantics: Saturating pass-event counter whose increment is enabled by ffff41da bit 4.
Base of six 16-bit coefficients under which 00086b0c calculates the irregularity metric: calculation occurs only when all six lie between 0x9452=32437 and 0x9454=33096, or 0x8000 +-1%.
Peripheral word to which flat 0x4c map 0x12d8a provides an additive correction.
Bit 0 participates in selecting the Y-axis input source together with ffff2468 bit 3.

Periodic scheduler pending flags. Interrupt handler 0002040c sets bit 7 every invocation, bit 6 every second invocation, bit 5 every fourth, and bits 4 and 2 every tenth. Dispatcher 000209d8 drains the corresponding task tables; main loop 00027e24 waits for bit 2 before running scheduler 00020dfe.
note: The relative divisors are exact. The hardware interrupt source and base frequency remain unresolved.

semantics: Engine-event scheduler pending flags. FUN 000208f8 sets bit 7 on every admitted current-cylinder event and bit 6 after each third event. Dispatcher 000209d8 uses bit 7 for the six-entry table at 00021948 and bit 6 for the three-entry table at 00021960, whose second entry is misfire revolution-phase dispatcher 0007c494, then clears each serviced bit.
note: The modulo-3 event relation corresponds to one crankshaft revolution on the V6 and closes the physical cadence of FUN 000872d0.

semantics: Previous ATU-II channel 0A input-capture value for selector mode 9. FUN 00029588 subtracts it from current ICR0A, takes the absolute value, then refreshes it from fffff434 on the same selector mode because ROM8[00008bdc] and ROM8[00008bdd] both equal 9.
note: The first selector-9 capture initializes the reference. Every later selector-9 invocation produces an interval between consecutive ICR0A captures before refreshing it.

semantics: Bit 7 is the valid-previous-capture latch for the selector-9 interval path. FUN 00029588 tests it before producing an interval sample and sets it when ffff84d4 is refreshed.
note: The latch establishes first-capture seeding versus subsequent interval production. Its startup value and uses of other bits remain outside this claim.

semantics: Bit 7 is a coalescing pending flag for an interval between consecutive selector-9 ICR0A captures. When ffff13b2 equals stock ROM8[00008bdc] = 9 and ffff84f1.bit7 is set, FUN 00029588 stores abs(ICR0A - ffff84d4) at ffff1dac and sets this bit. The same invocation refreshes ffff84d4 because ROM8[00008bdd] also equals 9. FUN 0003cf24 clears the bit after consuming and shifting the sample.
note: Stock JK03A and JK08A both use selector bytes 9/9. Static code does not establish how many selector-9 captures occur per crankshaft revolution or unit time.

semantics: Modulo-3 engine-event phase counter. FUN 000208f8 increments it on every admitted current-cylinder event, resets it at three, and sets ffff84ba bit 6 at the reset point.
note: Three current-cylinder events equal one crankshaft revolution on the V6.

semantics: Bit 7 is the master enable for the entire map-read path in 0003c4a0 and 0002c59c.

Multipurpose status byte. Bit 7 gates dynamic-threshold movement in rotational-speed request limiter 0007584e: a set bit permits calibrated down/up steps 0x9430 and 0x9436. Bit 6 independently gates debounce counter ffff1846 in DTC monitor 000aacc0 and permits the ffff2b73 >= 5 P030 inhibit branch in misfire coordinator 00082c8a. Scheduler 00020dfe copies tick-flag byte ffff84c4 into it at 00020ee6 and reloads ffff84c4 from ffff84bb at 00020ef0; base-tick handler 0002040c ORs 0x80 into ffff84c4 at 00020734 every 1.024 ms, so bit 7 is set on every scheduler pass, and FUN 000904c2 counts ffff1998+b once per 10.24 ms pass while it is set.
note: Stock limiter rates are zero, so bit 7 cannot move the stock threshold. The wave 2 claim that bit 6 selects the base mode in 00055098 is refuted. Bit 7 is the scheduler-pass tick; the physical meaning of bit 6 remains unresolved and must not be merged with it.

semantics: Result of comparing the output of map 0x12362 in 00060fb4.
Init guard in 0009b816.
Mode selector in 0009b816.
Reset gate in 0009b816.
Result of comparing the output of map 0x15182 in 0009cdd8.
Base of a six-element signed 16-bit additive correction array written by FUN_0004e614 and added to the parity-selected base pulse in FUN_0004eba2.
note: The code establishes its additive role in the compensated pulse calculation; the physical decomposition of the correction remains unresolved.

semantics: Base of a six-element signed 16-bit subtractive correction array. FUN_00052de8 accumulates a bounded correction into the selected element, FUN_000571c0 can clear selected elements, and FUN_0004eba2 subtracts the element when ROM8[00008d92] bit 3 is set.
note: Stock value ROM8[00008d92]=0x7a enables the subtraction. The physical decomposition of the correction remains unresolved.

semantics: Bank/parity-0 unsigned base pulse written by FUN_0004ead4 from precursor ffff18c0, STFT ffff22dc, LTFT ffff2302, extra term ffff2a24, neutral-offset word ffff2310, injector opening time ffff2436, and the ffff22e6-selected stock trim branch. FUN_0004eba2 selects it for channel indices 0, 2, and 4.
note: One count is 10 us. Parity reuse is exact; physical bank-to-cylinder ordering is unresolved.

semantics: Bank/parity-1 unsigned base pulse written by FUN_0004ead4 from the adjacent bank inputs and selected by FUN_0004eba2 for channel indices 1, 3, and 5.
note: One count is 10 us. Arithmetic mirrors ffff191c. Physical bank-to-cylinder ordering is unresolved.

semantics: Bank-1 intake-cam edge phase byte. Capture handler 0002a5cc copies running phase ffff22d2 here at 0002a75e while event state ffff13c8 is 2, 4, or 6. The running phase is 20*ffff13b2 + floor(20*interval / ffff22bc) - 60 (selector below 8) or - 20 (selector 8 and above) through signed divider 00021bbc, clamped at zero, where interval is the 16-bit difference between GR1F capture fffff44e and crank reference count ffff158a stored at ffff22c8. The pass requires ffff84ff bit 7 set and edge count ffff1391 equal to 1 and first shifts the previous values into ffff22ce and ffff22d0. FUN_000bd9f0 subtracts the byte from rest reference ffff4799 to form actual position ffff2442.
note: One count is 0.5 crank degrees: ffff22bc is 10 crank degrees and the selector step is 20 counts, the same arithmetic as exhaust edge phase ffff1200. The selector offsets differ from the exhaust segment mapping, so the intake phase axis has its own origin; the stock rest value ROM8[0000831c]=140 is the phase of selector 8 at zero interval. The SH7059 hardware manual identifies 0xFFFFF44E as ATU-II channel 1A GR1F.

semantics: Bank-2 intake-cam edge phase byte. Capture handler 0002a36a copies running phase ffff22d3 here at 0002a496 while event state ffff13c8 is 1, 3, or 5. The running phase is 20*ffff13b2 + floor(20*interval / ffff22bc) - 60 (selector below 8) or - 20 (selector 8 and above) through signed divider 00021bbc, clamped at zero, where interval is the 16-bit difference between GR1E capture fffff44c and crank reference count ffff158a stored at ffff22ca. The pass requires ffff84ff bit 7 set, ffff8504 bit 7 clear, and edge count ffff1390 equal to 1, and first shifts the previous values into ffff22cf and ffff22d1. FUN_000bd9f0 subtracts the byte from rest reference ffff479a to form actual position ffff2443.
note: One count is 0.5 crank degrees: ffff22bc is 10 crank degrees and the selector step is 20 counts, the same arithmetic as exhaust edge phase ffff1200. The selector offsets differ from the exhaust segment mapping, so the intake phase axis has its own origin; the stock rest value ROM8[00008321]=140 is the phase of selector 8 at zero interval. The SH7059 hardware manual identifies 0xFFFFF44C as ATU-II channel 1A GR1E.

semantics: Bank-1 intake-cam edge interval word. Capture handler 0002a5cc stores GR1F capture fffff44e minus crank reference count ffff158a at 0002a6d0 and divides 20 times the same difference by ffff22bc for running phase ffff22d2.
note: Channel 1A counts phi'/32 = 3.2 us (TCR1A = 5 in 0002718a, PSCR1 = 1 in 000274ac), so the word is a time between the crank reference and the intake-cam edge.

semantics: Bank-2 intake-cam edge interval word. Capture handler 0002a36a stores GR1E capture fffff44c minus crank reference count ffff158a at 0002a41e and divides 20 times the same difference by ffff22bc for running phase ffff22d3.
note: Channel 1A counts phi'/32 = 3.2 us, so the word is a time between the crank reference and the intake-cam edge.

semantics: Previous bank-1 intake-cam edge phase byte. Capture handler 0002a5cc copies ffff22cc here at 0002a6ec on every processed capture, after moving the earlier value to ffff22d0 at 0002a6e4.
note: Same 0.5-crank-degree unit as ffff22cc.

semantics: Previous bank-2 intake-cam edge phase byte. Capture handler 0002a36a copies ffff22cd here at 0002a43a on every processed capture, after moving the earlier value to ffff22d1 at 0002a432.
note: Same 0.5-crank-degree unit as ffff22cd.

semantics: Second-previous bank-1 intake-cam edge phase byte. Capture handler 0002a5cc copies ffff22ce here at 0002a6e4 on every processed capture.
note: Same 0.5-crank-degree unit as ffff22cc.

semantics: Second-previous bank-2 intake-cam edge phase byte. Capture handler 0002a36a copies ffff22cf here at 0002a432 on every processed capture.
note: Same 0.5-crank-degree unit as ffff22cd.

semantics: Bank-1 intake-cam running edge phase byte. Capture handler 0002a5cc writes it at 0002a746 on every processed GR1F capture as 20*ffff13b2 + floor(20*ffff22c8 / ffff22bc) - 60 (selector below 8) or - 20 (selector 8 and above), clamped at zero, and copies it to ffff22cc at 0002a75e only while event state ffff13c8 is 2, 4, or 6.
note: One count is 0.5 crank degrees; see ffff22cc.

semantics: Bank-2 intake-cam running edge phase byte. Capture handler 0002a36a writes it at 0002a47e on every processed GR1E capture as 20*ffff13b2 + floor(20*ffff22ca / ffff22bc) - 60 (selector below 8) or - 20 (selector 8 and above), clamped at zero, and copies it to ffff22cd at 0002a496 only while event state ffff13c8 is 1, 3, or 5.
note: One count is 0.5 crank degrees; see ffff22cd.

semantics: Base of the six-element transformed injection-pulse array. FUN_0004eba2 passes each raw ffff23c8 element through FUN_0005b7ec and writes the result at index 2*i. With stock coefficients the transform is max(x,sat_u16(floor((13656*x+425000)/16384))). Scheduler copier 00020dfe snapshots the array to ffff2348, from which FUN_00054d3e fills scheduled-duration array ffff224e. FUN_000521a8 takes the maximum across all six elements.
note: The numeric transform is exact and is the final minimum-pulse floor before the hardware. One count is 10 us, the same unit as ffff23c8.

semantics: Unsigned common additive and masked-channel override word. FUN_00056fc0 writes clamp_u16(max(0, arithmetic_shift7((175-uint8(ffff1108))*92)+70)). FUN_0004ead4 adds it to both normal bank bases, FUN_0004eba2 selects it directly when the current channel bit is set in ffff22e0, and FUN_00051a98 adds it to every mask-gated channel word.
note: The word is the injector opening time in 10 us counts: 70 counts, 0.70 ms, at battery snapshot ffff1108 = 175, moving 92/128 counts per byte, and spanning 0.66..0.82 ms over the recorded byte range 157..180 under the source-bound 0.08 V/count conversion. Scheduler 0002c13c substitutes its snapshot ffff23aa for an inhibited channel and subtracts it when a pulse is already in flight.

semantics: First intake-cam reference byte. FUN_000bccdc initializes it from ROM8[0000831c], FUN_000bdf5c conditionally updates it, and FUN_000bd9f0 subtracts capture byte ffff22cc from it.
note: The reference is a rest edge phase in the 0.5-crank-degree unit of ffff22cc; the stock value 140 is the phase of selector 8 at zero interval.

semantics: Second intake-cam reference byte. FUN_000bccdc initializes it from ROM8[00008321], FUN_000bdf5c conditionally updates it, and FUN_000bd9f0 subtracts capture byte ffff22cd from it.
note: The reference is a rest edge phase in the 0.5-crank-degree unit of ffff22cd; the stock value 140 is the phase of selector 8 at zero interval.

semantics: Base of a six-element 16-bit working array maintained by FUN_00052de8, FUN_000571c0, and per-channel difference producer FUN_0005727a.
note: The code establishes the shared six-channel state; its physical quantity remains unresolved.

semantics: Duplicate signed result published by FUN 00070d82 at the end of periodic-table index 20 from limiter aggregate ffff243a and controller result ffff19c0. Index-21 FUN 00079030 reads it together with identical publication ffff2438.
note: The duplicate storage and scheduler order are exact; its independent storage purpose is unresolved.

semantics: Signed result published by FUN 00070d82 at the end of periodic-table index 20 from limiter aggregate ffff243a and controller result ffff19c0, then consumed by index-21 FUN 00079030.
note: FUN 00070d82 writes the same value to ffff19c2. This is a shared controller boundary rather than a proven hardware command.

semantics: Stationary-limiter readiness countdown. FUN 0004f324 loads 100 on first eligible entry and after every readiness-accumulator update. Interrupt handler 0002040c decrements it as part of byte range ffff256a..ffff25f3 every tenth base interrupt.
note: One count is exactly 204800/Pphi seconds. Passive target-CAN timestamps establish Pphi=20 MHz, so 100 counts are 1.024 seconds and the three high-RPM expiries needed for readiness total 3.072 seconds.

semantics: Exact UDS DID 0x120f runtime word and bank 1 throttle-position sensor 1 value. Pointer table 0x2289c maps the DID to this address; FUN 000a7418 accepts ROM16[0x9550]=60..ROM16[0x954e]=964 counts and dispatches P0223/P0222 outside that window.
note: The acceptance window is 0.30..4.82 V at 5 mV per count and brackets the factory terminal criteria of more than 0.36 V released and less than 4.75 V depressed. The diagnostic display unit is V at 5 mV per count; JK08A.diagnostics.md derives that scale.

semantics: Exact UDS DID 0x1210 runtime word and bank 1 throttle-position sensor 2 value. Pointer table 0x2289c maps the DID to this address; FUN 000a75c0 accepts ROM16[0x9550]=60..ROM16[0x954e]=964 counts and dispatches P0123/P0122 outside that window.
note: The factory documentation states that the sensor 2 signal is converted inside the ECM, and bank 2 stage 0003e4cc performs that conversion as 0x0400 minus the ten-bit sample, so the published word rises with throttle opening like sensor 1. The diagnostic display unit is V at 5 mV per count; JK08A.diagnostics.md derives that scale.

semantics: Exact UDS DID 0x124b runtime word. Pointer table 0x2289c maps the DID to this address; reviewed Nissan diagnostics identify the parameter as TP SEN 1-B2 voltage.
note: Bank 2 sensor 1 working word ffff2758 carries the same quantity for range monitor 000a7418. The diagnostic display unit is V at 5 mV per count; JK08A.diagnostics.md derives that scale.

semantics: Exact UDS DID 0x124c runtime word written by paired-sensor conditioning FUN 0003e4cc as 0x0400 minus ten-bit sample ffff363c. Reviewed Nissan diagnostics identify the parameter as TP SEN 2-B2 voltage.
note: The complement inverts the sensor about the 1024-count full scale, which is 5.12 V at 5 mV per count; the factory criteria for the paired sensors, more than 0.36 V on one and less than 4.75 V on the other, span the same 5.11 V. The diagnostic display unit is V at 5 mV per count; JK08A.diagnostics.md derives that scale.

semantics: Exact one-byte response source for UDS DID 0x111f. FUN 0003eb84 maintains the runtime byte, FUN 000bcd44 reads it during initialization, and the service 0x22 pointer table publishes it directly. Scheduler 00020dfe copies it to previous-pass snapshot ffff2772, the coordinate of the exhaust-VTC gain curve. With ROM8[00008616] bit 0 set, as in stock JK08A, FUN 0003eb84 filters ADC sample ffff1d5c through 0003a5e0 into ffff1f92 and raw byte ffff117b, converts the byte through curve 00012c6e into ffff1f94, and publishes it here at 0003ecae: directly while ffff4183 bit 7 is set, otherwise rising at once and falling only after a drop of two or more counts; a raw byte outside 3..241 or a stored P0197, P0198, or P0196 record sets ffff4182 bit 7 and publishes 0xff. With the bit clear the function publishes zero.
note: Curve 00012c6e is byte-identical to shared thermistor table 00012dea and is read through the same implicit-axis primitive, and the ECU declares the 00012dea code as deg C+50 through J1979 Mode 01 PIDs 0x05 and 0x0F, so deg C = raw-50 is established by code. The factory engine oil temperature sensor reference of 4.4, 3.5, 2.2, 0.9, and 0.6 V at -10, 20, 50, 90, and 110 deg C gives -8.5, 20.5, 52, 94, and 113.5 deg C through the curve at 20 mV per input count. Target recordings hold raw 141 beside a diagnostic reading of 90 deg C. The identification of DID 0x111f as engine oil temperature is a diagnostic-binding claim in JK08A.diagnostic-bindings.csv. The sensor path is selected by the set configuration bit (tst #1 at 0003eb96 branches to the zero store while the bit is clear).

semantics: Exact UDS DID 0x130a runtime status byte. FUN 0002e2e8 sets bit 4 when ffff24d2 bit 3 is set and ffff4255 bit 3 is clear; the DID record supplies support mask 0x10. Reviewed Nissan diagnostics identify bit 4 as THRTL RELAY.
note: This is the reported throttle-control-motor relay condition. It does not identify the physical relay-output pin.

semantics: First selected nonnegative word in the second-bank paired-sensor branch. FUN 0003e63c selects a corrected source under mode flags, and FUN 0003b520 consumes the result through inverse pair 0x13202/0x155a0.
note: The paired-feedback role is exact. The diagnostic sensor-number assignment of this selected internal word is not established.

semantics: Base of the five-byte decoded ASCD steering-switch sample window ffff2701..ffff2705. FUN 000cf020 accepts a new stable code only when all five bytes are equal.

semantics: Support mask paired with DID 0x130D value ffff2a83. FUN 000d093c initializes it to 0x00, 0x3F, 0x31, or 0x7F from ROM8[0x8B28].

semantics: Support mask paired with DID 0x130E value ffff2a84. FUN 000d093c initializes it to 0x00, 0x3F, or 0x04 from ROM8[0x8B28].

semantics: Exact UDS DID 0x130D ASCD status byte. FUN 000cf020 packs output bit 3 from stable switch code bit 3, bit 2 from code bit 4, bit 1 from code bit 1, and bit 0 from ffff41ae bit 7.

semantics: Stable one-hot ASCD steering-switch code accepted by FUN 000cf020 after five equal decoded samples. Exact diagnostic code maps 0x02 to CANCEL, 0x08 to SET/COAST, and 0x10 to RESUME/ACCEL. A target-vehicle capture of CAN frame 0x239 byte 4 identifies 0x20 as released/all buttons off; 0x00 was not observed and is treated as invalid by the injected selector.
note: This is a decoded state, not a simultaneous-button bitfield. MAIN/ASCD on state is represented separately by ffff41ae bit 7. The combined SET-held plus CANCEL gesture still requires a target-vehicle capture.

semantics: Previous stable ASCD steering-switch code. FUN 000cf020 copies ffff2a85 here before accepting a new five-sample state.

semantics: Base of a two-byte bank-indexed rear O2 monitor metric. FUN 00089d92 dispatches P0139/P0159 when this byte or the parallel ffff26eb byte is below calibrated limit 0x80.

note: A whole-program p-code scan found reset/initialization stores but no direct runtime producer; the producer is pointer-mediated or unresolved. The physical scale is not established.

semantics: Base of a two-byte bank-indexed catalyst-monitor limit array. FUN 000a2ee4 writes the interpolated uint8 result of table 0x11fb6, and FUN 000a2f56 dispatches P0420/P0430 only when unsigned ffff314d[bank] is below this limit.

semantics: Rear O2 heater command-state bitfield. Bit 0 supplies the bank-1 state and bit 1 supplies the bank-2 state to FUN 000a25fa and the DID 0x130b status-byte builder FUN 0002e2e8.

semantics: Base of a two-byte bank-indexed rear O2 heater monitor-state array. FUN 0008b93a tests the selected byte before fault dispatch and reloads it from ROM8[0x8ab2]=5 on the in-range path.
note: The decrement source, cadence, and physical time represented by one count remain unresolved.

semantics: Shared uint16 sample word used throughout the EVAP monitor subsystem. Its high byte feeds the vent-control, purge-control circuit, pressure-sensor circuit, pressure range/performance, purge-flow, and leak-monitor state machines.
note: The monitor topology and byte selection are exact. Physical pressure conversion, sensor polarity, and units remain unresolved.

semantics: EVAP vent-control result byte. FUN 000aab54 sets bit 6 for path-A P0447; FUN 000aacc0 sets bit 7 for P0448. FUN 000abca2 dispatches descriptor indices 0x31 and 0x2f from those bits and clears each bit after handling.

semantics: Word metric produced by the 21-sample EVAP pressure-sensor range/performance monitor FUN 000ae1a8. A value greater than ROM16[0x92f8]=0x0c00 enters the exact P0451 fault dispatcher.

semantics: Saturating byte timer used by path-A P0447 producer FUN 000aab54. The path sets ffff247a bit 6 when this value is greater than ROM8[0x8370]=0x50 under its sample-difference gates.
note: The increment cadence and physical time represented by one count remain unresolved.

note: The baseline producer, physical scale, and valve-state interpretation remain unresolved.

semantics: Captured byte and timer state maintained by EVAP pressure-sensor circuit coordinator FUN 000ac994. FUN 000ac934 compares it below 0x16 for P0452 and at or above 0xfe for P0453 under common operating gates.

The exact P0442 branch dispatches when that byte is at or above ROM8[0x880c]=0xff under its operating gates; P0456-associated branches call the complementary state updater with descriptor index 0xd8.

semantics: State or countdown byte referenced by table-driven monitor entry 6 at ROM 0x23c14. FUN 000a6dc4 dispatches the entry's descriptor only when this byte reaches zero after all table conditions pass.

semantics: Latched inhibit byte for the P030 common readiness gate. Coordinator 00082c8a writes stock value 0x32 when ffff84c3.bit6 is set and unsigned ffff2b73 is at least 5; any nonzero value routes to clearing ffff4251.bits6/7.
note: A whole-program p-code pass over all 2315 functions found exactly this write and read, with no unresolved candidates and no statically resolved clear. It is therefore documented as a latch rather than a countdown; reset-time or pointer-mediated initialization remains outside the resolved lifecycle.

semantics: Mode byte used by table-driven monitor entry 6. FUN 000a6dc4 requires its low two bits to equal the entry constant 1 before the path-B P0447 state can advance.
note: The physical mode represented by value 1 remains unresolved.

semantics: Input word referenced by table-driven monitor entry 6. FUN 000a6dc4 requires (fffff754 & 0x0004) == 0 before the entry can dispatch path-B P0447 descriptor index 0xd7.
note: The peripheral or external source of this word is unresolved. The only caller skips entry 6 in stock JK08A.

semantics: Multipurpose diagnostic state byte. Within reporter 00084cd0, bits 0..4 select exact descriptor indices 0x0b..0x0f for P0305..P0301, respectively. Coordinator 00082c8a builds and clears these cylinder-selection bits.
note: The claim is limited to bits 0..4 in the misfire component. Uses of the remaining bits and uses by other diagnostic functions are not assigned semantics here.

semantics: Multipurpose diagnostic state byte. Within reporter 00084cd0, bit 7 selects exact descriptor index 0x0a for P0306 and bit 6 forces the exact P0300 descriptor index 0x10. Coordinator 00082c8a builds, tests, and clears these bits.
note: The claim is limited to bits 6 and 7 in the misfire component. Other bits and external uses remain unassigned.

semantics: Base of the common three-byte runtime diagnostic-record array. FUN 0007ebec initializes 0x157 records. Exact ROM descriptors occupy indices through 0x128; extension record 0x129 contains the byte1/byte2 OR summary of P0101/P0102/P0103 and P010B/P010C/P010D produced by 00097eb4. FUN 000259e4 tests bits 5 and 6 of a record third byte, 00025e20 tests byte1.bit7, and 0007c3b4 applies the critical-record predicate.
note: The bit operations and predicate polarities are exact. Internal status bits are not assigned UDS status-bit names.

semantics: Three-byte extension runtime record 0x129. FUN 0007ebec clears it during diagnostic initialization. FUN 00097eb4 writes byte1 and byte2 as the OR of exact P0101/P0102/P0103 and P010B/P010C/P010D record status bytes; FUN 0003c3ac publishes byte1.bit7 for the 2400 RPM fuel-inhibit contributor.
note: This extension slot has no ROM DTC descriptor of its own; its six exact source descriptors establish the group identity. The fuel path consumes only byte1.bit7.

semantics: Current coolant snapshot byte produced by FUN 0008092e as max(lookup_u8(00012dea, ffff1186)-10, 0). Misfire reporter 00084cd0 copies it into each retained operating-point group, and matcher 000847dc requires current and retained values to be on the same side of code 110. FUN 00035856 returns it for J1979 Mode 01 PID 0x05 at 00035bf8.
note: The same lookup result is exact raw coolant byte ffff1079 with deg C = raw-50. Therefore code 0 represents at most -40 deg C; for positive codes, deg C = code-40; matcher boundary 110 is 70 deg C. J1979 defines PID 0x05 as A-40 deg C, which fixes the same conversion.

semantics: CAN-derived vehicle-speed word. FUN 000c4506 assembles CAN 0x280 bytes 4 and 5 as big-endian uint16, treats 0xffff as invalid, divides by 10, and writes the word; FUN 0003a174 filters it into ffff115e.
note: J1979 PID 0x0D returns min(255, 2*ffff118e) with ffff118e = ffff115e/20, so the CAN word is km/h*100 and this word km/h*10.

semantics: Filtered vehicle-speed word. FUN 0003a174 applies a first-order filter to ffff113c and preserves the word for FUN 0003a254, which divides it by 20 into coarse byte ffff118e.
note: The unit follows from J1979 PID 0x0D as described at ffff118e.

semantics: Absolute throttle byte. FUN 0006f236 writes it and FUN 00035856 returns it unchanged for J1979 Mode 01 PID 0x11 at 00035de2.
note: J1979 defines PID 0x11 as A*100/255 percent, so the ECU declares the byte as absolute throttle position with 100/255 percent per count. CAN telemetry schema 2 streams it as absolute_throttle_raw.

semantics: Intake-air-temperature PID byte. FUN 0003d832 copies lane 0 of the pair ffff3f42 here at 0003d8c4, where FUN 0003d4a8 writes max(lookup(00012dea, uint8(ffff1d58 >> 2)) - 10, 0); FUN 00035856 returns the byte unchanged for J1979 Mode 01 PID 0x0F at 00035daa.
note: J1979 defines PID 0x0F as A-40 deg C, so the ECU declares the 00012dea transfer code as deg C+50 and AN1 lane 0 as the intake-air-temperature channel. DID 0x1106 byte ffff2837 is the same transfer code of the filtered lane-0 sample.

semantics: Two-lane unfiltered temperature PID pair. FUN 0003d4a8 writes element[lane] = max(lookup(00012dea, uint8(ffff1d58[lane] >> 2)) - 10, 0) through implicit-axis primitive 000263a0 at 0003d4da, or zero at 0003d4e6; FUN 0003d832 copies element 0 into PID byte ffff3f41.
note: The pair follows the lane layout of ffff1d58: element 0 for phase 1 and element 1 for phase 3. Only element 0 reaches J1979 PID 0x0F; element 1 has no found consumer.

semantics: Bank-1 A/F sensor working word written by FUN 00059d9a. FUN 00035856 divides it by 5 for J1979 Mode 01 PID 0x14 at 00035e08 and sends the quotient with the bank-1 trim byte through helper 000357dc.
note: J1979 defines PID 0x14 as A*0.005 V, which would make one count one millivolt; helper 000357dc refuses every oxygen PID while sensor-present byte ROM8[0x8936] is zero, as in stock JK08A, so the path is inactive.

semantics: Bank-2 A/F sensor working word written by FUN 00059e7c. FUN 00035856 divides it by 5 for J1979 Mode 01 PID 0x18 at 00035e7c, and helper 000357dc doubles the quotient with saturation before sending it with the bank-2 trim byte.
note: The doubled path would declare raw/500 V against raw/1000 V for bank 1; the path is inactive while ROM8[0x8936] is zero.

semantics: Distance accumulator longword. FUN 00035856 returns floor(ffff560c/2548) through unsigned divider 00021ce0 for J1979 Mode 01 PID 0x21 at 00035eca, or 0xffff once the accumulator reaches 0x09f3f60c.
note: J1979 defines PID 0x21 as kilometres travelled while the MIL is on, so one count is 1/2548 km. Ghidra cross-references place the writers in 0003a286, 0003a34a, 0003a436, and 0007cf14.

semantics: Base of three retained misfire calculated-load snapshot bytes: group 0 at ffff4a45, group 1 at ffff4a46, and group 2 at ffff4a47. Reporter 00084cd0 copies current PID 0x04 source ffff413e into the selected group; coordinator 00082c8a passes each byte to matcher 000847dc.
note: Physical percent is 100*A/255. The three diagnostic groups remain numbered because code provides no phase names.

semantics: Base of three retained misfire RPM/12.5 snapshot words at offsets 0, 2, and 4: group 0 at ffff4a70, group 1 at ffff4a72, and group 2 at ffff4a74. Reporter 00084cd0 copies current ffff11bc into the selected group; coordinator 00082c8a passes each word to matcher 000847dc.
note: Matcher tolerance is -30/+30 counts, or -375/+375 RPM, with lower saturation at 0 and the code-defined upper clamp at 255 counts.

semantics: Base of three retained misfire coolant snapshot bytes: group 0 at ffff4ac6, group 1 at ffff4ac7, and group 2 at ffff4ac8. Reporter 00084cd0 copies current ffff3fa4 into the selected group; coordinator 00082c8a passes each byte to matcher 000847dc.
note: Code 0 represents at most -40 deg C; positive code A represents A-40 deg C. Matcher boundary 110 is 70 deg C.

semantics: Multipurpose misfire status byte. Reporter 00084cd0 sets bit 2 when group 0 is captured and bit 0 when group 1 is captured. Its odd-argument path clears each marker when it clears that group's retained payload.
note: The claim is limited to group-retention markers in bits 2 and 0. Other bits and uses remain unassigned.

semantics: Multipurpose misfire status byte. Reporter 00084cd0 sets bit 7 when group 2 is captured and clears it when the odd-argument path removes group 2. Before each reporter call, coordinator 00082c8a sets selector bit 6, 5, or 4 for even group 0, 1, or 2 respectively; odd paths clear all three bits. Handler 0007dc32 tests the combined mask 0x70: a nonzero selector uses the record-bits3/6 branch, while zero uses the record-bits4/5 branch and sets ffff5b2c.bit3.
note: The operational selector mapping is exact. Code does not identify either polarity as a physical pass or fail phase and does not name groups 0..2.

semantics: Multipurpose misfire status byte. Bit 3 is the global odd-polarity result latch for exact P0306..P0300 runtime records. Reporter 00084cd0 sets it before and after odd-argument dispatch, and selector-free handler 0007dc32 sets it with record bits 4 and 5. Initializer 00082c8a clears it with all retained snapshot state. Reconciler 0008042c retains it only when the first P030 record carrying bit 5 or 6 has bit 5 set and bit 6 clear. Global expiry 0007c57a clears it at maintenance count 3, and common aging pass 0007cf14 clears it when any P030 record reaches its bit-5 aging condition.
note: The full static set, reconcile, consume, and clear lifecycle is code-proven. Odd-polarity is an operational argument label; physical diagnostic phase names and time cadence remain unresolved.

semantics: Multipurpose diagnostic summary byte. In FUN 0008042c, bit 3 summarizes the ordered P0306..P0300 runtime-record scan. It is set when the first encountered record with either third-byte bit 5 or bit 6 reaches the terminator and is cleared while records contain neither bit. Third-byte bit 6 has priority over bit 5 because it is tested first.
note: The summary rule is exact; its external diagnostic presentation and physical phase name remain unresolved.

semantics: Saturating retention-maintenance counter for the global P030 odd-polarity result latch. Reporter 00084cd0 clears it after every retained operating-point capture. While ffff5b2c.bit3 and the maintenance gates are active, FUN 0007c57a increments it and expires all retained P030 state when the value reaches 3.
note: The threshold is three invocations of the admitted maintenance path; one count has no assigned physical-time duration.

semantics: Scheduler snapshot of selected raw-temperature byte ffff1076, the engine coolant temperature latched at engine start. It equals raw coolant ffff1079 during a computed START SIGNAL interval with battery-voltage raw below 100 and holds the value of the last selection afterwards. P030 readiness requires at least 40, while FUN 000804ce latches ffff422f.bit4 when raw coolant snapshot ffff1071 exceeds this byte by at least 20.
note: The byte has the raw-coolant scale deg C = raw-50. The P030 threshold of 40 is a start temperature of -10 deg C, and the rise of 20 counts is the coolant rise of 20 deg C after engine start in factory driving pattern A.

semantics: Selected raw-temperature byte, the engine coolant temperature latched at engine start. FUN 000394b8 writes raw coolant ffff1079 while selector 0003967a returns 1 and previous-pass image ffff107e while it returns 0, which holds the last selection; scheduler 00020dfe snapshots it to ffff106e. FUN 0003d702 also uses it in its offset-selection condition.
note: RAM initialization clears transition latch ffff24be.bit6, so the first pass after it selects coolant once. A computed START SIGNAL interval with battery voltage below 8.00 V tracks coolant and ends with one more selection. The scale is raw coolant deg C = raw-50.

semantics: Selected normalized-temperature byte, the normalized coolant index latched at engine start. FUN 000394b8 writes normalized coolant ffff1077 while selector 0003967a returns 1 and previous-pass image ffff1080 while it returns 0, which holds the last selection; scheduler 00020dfe snapshots it to ffff1070.
note: The byte follows the selection and hold transitions of raw byte ffff1076 on the normalized coolant scale.

semantics: Previous-pass image of selected raw-temperature byte ffff1076. After the 69 entries of periodic table 00021834, dispatcher FUN 000209d8 copies ffff1072..ffff1079 to ffff107a..ffff1081 through block-copy helper 00022558 at 00020cba. FUN 000394b8 reads it on the hold branch of selector 0003967a, so the selected byte keeps its last coolant selection. Startup initializer FUN 00027c50 and clear services FUN 0002fc24 and FUN 00034b70 zero the byte inside their RAM spans.
note: The helper writes through its destination pointer, so the byte has no literal-address store. The zero of RAM initialization is replaced at the end of the first pass. The selector takes coolant once on that pass, before the hold branch first reads the image.

semantics: Previous-pass image of normalized coolant index ffff1077. After the 69 entries of periodic table 00021834, dispatcher FUN 000209d8 copies ffff1072..ffff1079 to ffff107a..ffff1081 through block-copy helper 00022558 at 00020cba. FUN 00038618 uses it as the interpolation input of ROM tables 0x12ADA and 0x12AEA on two state branches. Startup initializer FUN 00027c50 and clear services FUN 0002fc24 and FUN 00034b70 zero the byte inside their RAM spans.
note: The helper writes through its destination pointer, so the byte has no literal-address store. The zero of RAM initialization is replaced at the end of the first pass. Implicit nodes 0,32,...224 of both tables are -40,-20,...100 deg C on the normalized coolant scale.

semantics: Previous-pass image of selected normalized-temperature byte ffff1078. After the 69 entries of periodic table 00021834, dispatcher FUN 000209d8 copies ffff1072..ffff1079 to ffff107a..ffff1081 through block-copy helper 00022558 at 00020cba. FUN 000394b8 reads it on the hold branch of selector 0003967a, so the selected byte keeps its last coolant selection. Startup initializer FUN 00027c50 and clear services FUN 0002fc24 and FUN 00034b70 zero the byte inside their RAM spans.
note: The helper writes through its destination pointer, so the byte has no literal-address store. The zero of RAM initialization is replaced at the end of the first pass. The selector takes coolant once on that pass, before the hold branch first reads the image.

semantics: Bit 6 is the selected-temperature transition latch maintained by FUN 0003967a. Computed START SIGNAL ON with battery-voltage raw below 100 clears it and returns coolant. Outside that condition, a clear latch is set while coolant is returned once; subsequent calls with the latch set return 0, and FUN 000394b8 holds the selected pair through previous-pass images ffff107e/ffff1080.
note: The latch state machine is exact. At 0.08 V per count the clearing condition uses voltage below 8.00 V.

semantics: Scheduler snapshot of AN1-derived source byte ffff283a. The 0x104-byte FUN 00022558 call copies ffff277e..ffff2881 to ffff267a..ffff277d, so source offset 0xbc maps ffff283a to ffff2736. P030 counting readiness requires ffff2736 >= ROM8[00008b50] = 40; this is equivalent to ffff3f4c >= 40 on the zero-offset branch and ffff3f4c >= 55 on the 15-count branch.
note: A whole-program exact-address scan found 28 reads and no direct write; the block-copy contract resolves its producer. AN1 is exact at the MCU, but the ECM terminal, physical signal, and engineering scale remain unresolved.

semantics: Derived AN1 transfer-code byte written by FUN 0003d702 as max(ffff283c - offset, 0), where stock offset is either 0 or 15. Scheduler 00020dfe snapshots this byte to ffff2736 through a 0x104-byte block copy.
note: FUN 0003d7b4 transiently copies ffff2837 here before calling FUN 0003d702, which overwrites it in the same invocation. The final byte is therefore not assigned intake-air-temperature semantics.

semantics: Staging byte copied from AN1-derived running-min accumulator ffff3f4c by FUN 0003d832 and consumed by FUN 0003d702 as the minuend for derived byte ffff283a.
note: The operational source is exact. The ECM terminal, physical signal, and engineering scale remain unresolved.

semantics: Longword state maintained by FUN 00027530 in the closed set 0..4. States 2..4 project to ffff2451.bit5 and ffff244f.bit5 set; states 0/1 project to both bits clear.
note: The state machine is exact. Its physical operating-mode name remains unresolved.

semantics: Element 0 of the two-byte AN1-derived running-min accumulator. Normal startup seeds both elements to 255 through FUN 0002d120. On admitted updates FUN 0003d45c can only lower each element to the corresponding map-00012dea output at ffff2838/ffff2839. FUN 0003d832 copies element 0 through ffff283c into the P030 readiness chain.
note: The indexed runtime writer is code-proven by whole-program p-code analysis. Conditional clear services zero the accumulator but do not reseed it within those functions. The ECM terminal, physical signal, and engineering scale remain unresolved.

semantics: Multipurpose diagnostic status byte. Bit 4 selects the value loaded into P030 inter-cycle latch ffff42a8 while ffff244f.bit5 is clear: set selects ROM8[00008499] = 0xb4, clear selects the map 0x12026 result, which is zero in stock JK08A. Normal startup and recovery initializers clear the byte; all seven direct runtime writers preserve bit 4, so this selector remains clear under the stock application-code lifecycle.
note: A whole-program scan found 30 exact accesses and no unresolved candidates. The seven resolved direct runtime writer functions change only bits 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, or 6 and preserve bit 4. The physical meaning of bit 4 remains unresolved.

semantics: SH7058 A/D data register 1 (ADDR1), containing the left-aligned 10-bit conversion result for analog channel AN1. FUN 000280d8 reads the 16-bit register and shifts it right by six for the readiness-source acquisition path.

Startup and conditional recovery ranges clear the byte.

The declared airflow is the ECU's own model rather than a hardware measurement: the 2026-09-17 recordings put it near 5.8 g/s at idle and at a volumetric efficiency above 1.2 near 5200 RPM.

note: The x4 conversion is consumer representation rather than a physical map scale. The physical quantity is unresolved.

note: The paired outputs feed two-bank fuel-trim calculations, but the exact AFR engineering scale is not established by this trace.

note: The physical diagnostic quantity is unresolved.

note: The physical unit of the speed and Base Fuel Schedule composite is unresolved.

Second retained output of shared gate curve 000122d2, indexed by ffff11f0 in FUN 00041750. Later code consumes only zero versus nonzero.

note: Stock ROM8[000087f3]=32 makes C zero. The candidate physical conversion is x*0.1 Nm.

semantics: Saturated signed engine-torque state from FUN 000659ae after adding ffff2408 to centered map result ffff18ca and applying Q14 and Q8 calibrated multipliers.

The chain 00065b08, 00065cd8, 00065de4, 00065e2c carries this state to net torque ffff240c, which CAN packer 00079e70 divides by five and offsets by 800 for frame 0x180. The candidate physical conversion is x*0.1 Nm, equal to 0.5 Nm per CAN count with zero at count 800; a moving-load capture then spans -73.5..226 Nm.

semantics: Unsigned P0128 surface product. FUN 000b7b98 writes zero when aggregate inhibit mask ffff22e0 is nonzero; otherwise it writes uint8(coefficient)*lookup_u16(0000d40e, RPM, Base Fuel Schedule). FUN 000b6b5a is the only reader and subtracts half of a saturated three-term sum from half of this value before signed scaling.
note: The whole-program exact xref projection has one writer and one reader. Every stock cell of 0000d40e is zero, so this word is always zero in stock JK03A and JK08A; the surrounding monitor calculation remains live.

semantics: AN1-derived diagnostic temperature byte. FUN 0003d832 copies the first output of shared transfer table 00012dea here, and the exact UDS DID 0x1106 pointer entry returns this byte. J1979 Mode 01 PID 0x0F returns ffff3f41, the same 00012dea transfer code of the unfiltered lane-0 sample minus 10.
note: Homologous measured Nissan diagnostics identify DID 0x1106 as Intake Air Temperature with deg C=raw-50, and J1979 defines PID 0x0F as A-40 deg C, so the ECU itself declares the transfer code as deg C+50 and AN1 lane 0 as intake air temperature. The SH7058 AN1 channel is exact, while the ECM terminal and hardware conversion require validation.

semantics: Periodic snapshot of Intake Air Temperature source byte ffff2837. Scheduler FUN 00020dfe copies it through the 0x104-byte runtime block snapshot; P0128 accessors consume the snapshot as their ambient/intake-temperature input.
note: The exact copy offset is ffff2837-0x104=ffff2733. The homologous DID 0x1106 conversion is deg C=raw-50; the physical input requires hardware validation on JK08A.

semantics: Signed P0128 model-temperature state in 1e-6 deg C. FUN 000b6b5a seeds it as 1000000*uint8[ffff1071]-50000000, otherwise loads the retained integrated state ffff9df0, and passes it to three P0128 term accessors before adding scaled balance ffff3400.
note: Exact DID 0x1101 and the hard-coded -50 offset establish the temperature representation. When the model-ready gate is clear, the retained state is replaced by current coolant temperature after the calculation; otherwise the saturated integrated result is retained for the next pass.

semantics: Unsigned P0128 temperature-difference term. FUN 000b7768 writes floor(d*floor(lookup_u16(00014b0a)*ROM8[00008543]/256)/256), where d is the nonnegative model-temperature-minus-IAT difference in 0.01 deg C units. FUN 000b6b5a is the only reader and adds the term to ffff2d00 with uint32 saturation into ffff3220.
note: The whole-program exact xref projection has one writer and one reader. Every stock cell of 00014b0a is zero, so this term is always zero in stock JK03A and JK08A.

semantics: Nonzero P0128 normalization parameter from RPM/12.5 curve 00015bf0. FUN 000b784e writes the uint16 lookup when it is nonzero and writes one when it is zero; FUN 000b6b5a is the sole reader and passes the word to FUN 000b78da.
note: The whole-program exact xref projection has one writer and one reader. Every stock cell of 00015bf0 is zero, so the stock value is one in JK03A and JK08A. The physical meaning of the parameter is unresolved.

semantics: Unsigned vehicle-speed-selected temperature-difference term in the P0128 model. FUN 000b78da applies inverse weight 255-min(lookup_u16(00014cca),255), two calibrated divisions, and the nonzero ffff35a0 parameter before writing this uint32 word. FUN 000b6b5a is the only reader and adds it to ffff3228 with uint32 saturation into ffff3224.
note: The whole-program exact xref projection has one writer and one reader. Both speed-selected stock coefficients are zero, so this term is always zero in stock JK03A and JK08A even though map 00014cca supplies full inverse weight.

semantics: Conditional P0128 parameter from RPM/12.5 curve 00015c80. FUN 000b784e writes the uint16 lookup when trunc0(P0128_model_microdegC/1000000) >= uint8(ROM[00008c8c])-50 and writes one otherwise. FUN 000b6b5a passes the word as H to FUN 000b7a3c.
note: The whole-program exact xref projection has one writer and one direct reader. Every stock cell of 00015c80 and every point of its axis are zero, so stock H is either zero or one. The physical meaning of this parameter remains unresolved.

semantics: Four-state runtime selector written by FUN 00048400 with values 0 through 3. FUN 00048754 compares and snapshots the selector, while FUN 000b6b5a passes it to FUN 000b7a3c, which selects one of four P0128 term coefficients.
note: The writer's reachable assignments are exactly 0, 1, 2, and 3. Code proves the bounded selector and its operational use but does not identify the physical subsystem represented by the four states.

semantics: Unsigned state-weighted inverse-weight term in the P0128 model. FUN 000b7a3c derives temperature-difference base B, parameter-ratio coordinate q, inverse map weight w, and four-state coefficient K, then writes K*floor(H*floor(B*w/255)/2500). FUN 000b6b5a is the only reader and adds this term to ffff2f98 with uint32 saturation into ffff3224.
note: The whole-program exact xref projection has one writer and one reader. Stock ROM8[00008a30] is zero, so B and ffff3228 are always zero in JK03A and JK08A. The physical heat-transfer interpretation remains unresolved.

semantics: Ten-bit meter CAN payload field used by the fuel-level monitor. FUN 000c456c assembles it from payload byte 1 and the top two bits of byte 2; FUN 0003dac6 scales it by 39680/1024 before filtering and map 00014bca.
note: Exact P0460/P0461 result-state gates and the homologous factory M&A-to-ECM CAN path establish the fuel-level context. The voltage, percentage, and tank-volume conversions remain unresolved.

semantics: Slow filtered fuel-level monitor coordinate. FUN 0003dac6 seeds it directly from the scaled CAN field on initialization and otherwise applies FUN 0003da98 to held word ffff3e26 with coefficient ROM8[00008315]=1, or 1/256 of the new sample. The value is the live coordinate for map 00014bca when the P0460/P0461-related result-state gates are clear.
note: The reset path writes zero. The engineering conversion remains unresolved.

semantics: Current output of EVAP fuel-level coordinate/sentinel curve 00014bca. FUN 0003dac6 writes the two lookup paths here; scheduler FUN 00020dfe copies this word to previous-cycle snapshot ffff272a within the 0x104-byte runtime block.
note: Every stock map cell is 0xffff, so this word is always 0xffff in JK03A and JK08A. Exact-address p-code has two writes and no direct readers; liveness continues through the block snapshot.

semantics: Previous-cycle snapshot of EVAP fuel-level coordinate/sentinel result ffff282e. Scheduler FUN 00020dfe copies it through the 0x104-byte runtime block. Four EVAP functions read it at seven sites: signed high-byte checks use 0xffff as -1 sentinel, while FUN 000b2096 uses unsigned high byte 255 as the coordinate of coefficient maps 0001259a/000125a2/000125aa.
note: Whole-program p-code analysis completed all 2315 functions with zero failures and found exactly these seven reads. In stock JK03A and JK08A the value is always 0xffff.

semantics: Selected DFCO stage-1 entry-delay byte. Coordinator 0004ed88 copies the high byte returned by 0004fe9c here before passing the complete word to state machine 000503e0.
note: The normal stock branches select 40, 60, or 75 counts. Passive target-CAN timestamps establish 409.6, 614.4, or 768.0 ms.

semantics: Selected DFCO stage-2 entry-delay byte. Coordinator 0004ed88 copies the low byte returned by 0004fe9c here before passing the complete word to state machine 000503e0.
note: Normal stock branches select zero. A configuration override branch can select 10 or 20 counts.

semantics: Selected uint16 multiplier used by Base Fuel Schedule producer 0003b75c after Q7 Fuel Compensation Main byte ffff1160. FUN 0003be3c selects this word from calculated working values or stock ROM16[0x90ee]=0x020c according to runtime state; it is not the 0xA29A result.
note: FUN 0003b75c forms T=sat_u32(4*ffff1062*ffff115c) before the stock P-T schedule branch. Physical quantity and engineering scale remain unresolved.

semantics: Common Q14 gain written by alternating-pass builder 00053698 as floor(uint8(ffff160d)*ROM16[0x9332]/256), with ROM16[0x9332]=13972. Pulse precursor 0004e974 uses it in signed helper 0002657c(v,ffff165e,-2), equivalent to trunc_toward_zero(v*ffff165e/16384).
note: The arithmetic scale is exact. The physical compensation identity remains unresolved.

semantics: Common injection-pulse precursor written by FUN 0004e974 as max(170,clamp_u16(trunc_toward_zero((H+int16(ffff2300))*ffff165e/16384))), where H is the selected BFS-derived term scaled by ffff22e6 over 131072.
note: One count is 10 us, so the ROM16[000094e8] floor of 170 is 1.70 ms. ffff24a1.bit0 records whether this result was raised to the minimum.

semantics: Bank-0 injection-pulse precursor written by FUN 0004e974. It applies bank multiplier ffff40b6 over 0x6400 to the selected BFS-derived term, adds signed transient word ffff2300, applies Q14 gain ffff165e, clamps to uint16, and lower-bounds the result at 170. FUN 0004ead4 consumes it for parity base ffff191c.
note: The unit is inherited from the pulse words it feeds: one count is 10 us, so the ROM16[000094e8] floor of 170 is 1.70 ms. The code proves bank indexing but not physical bank-to-cylinder ordering.

semantics: Bank-1 companion of injection-pulse precursor ffff18c0. FUN 0004e974 uses adjacent bank multiplier ffff40b8 and writes this word for FUN 0004ead4 to form parity base ffff191e.
note: Arithmetic mirrors ffff18c0. Physical bank-to-cylinder ordering is unresolved.

semantics: Rate-limited working fuel-multiplier value written by FUN 000556ec before final publication. It remains intact when full inhibit mask ffff22e0=0x3f forces published ffff22e6 to zero.
note: The internal rate and bound behavior is code-visible; physical units remain unresolved.

semantics: Commanded mixture word: Q14 fuel-multiplier command against the stoichiometric base schedule, 0x4000 = closed-loop stoichiometric target, commanded equivalence ratio = x/16384. Stage 0005594a of coordinator 00057608 is the sole stock runtime writer: it takes max(ffff123a, ffff123c), forces 0x4000 while engine-speed byte ffff2700 < 32 or countdown ffff2531 is nonzero, and caps the word at ROM16[000094ec] when ffff4252 bit 1 is set. FUN 000556ec scales min(65535, ffff231a + ffff240a) by this word over 16384, and 0004ead4 selects the open-loop branch when published product ffff22e6 exceeds 0x4000. Alternate writer 00055596 is excluded by stock ROM8[00008b42] bit 0 = 0 and ROM8[00008b34] bit 4 = 0. The exact service-0x22 table publishes the high byte as DID 0x1134.
note: Three 2026-08-26 vehicle recordings agree with the code: the streamed word is always a multiple of 128 within 16384..19072, settled values match the 0000a9aa lookup in 98.3..100 percent of records, and both STFT words stay at neutral 0x6400 in every record with a command above 0x4000. Commanded lambda = 16384/x. The gasoline AFR scale 1881.6/(x/128) of the public HR A2L is a candidate.

semantics: Exact service-0x22 DID 0x1116 response byte. Homologous measured diagnostics identify the DID as manifold absolute pressure.
note: The physical source, engineering conversion, and distinction from DID 0x112a remain unresolved.

semantics: Exact service-0x22 DID 0x1129 response byte. Homologous measured diagnostics identify the DID as atmospheric pressure.
note: The physical source and engineering conversion remain target-validation candidates.

semantics: Manifold-pressure word. FUN 00035856 returns floor((uint16[ffff16d2]*118 + 98304)/65536) for J1979 Mode 01 PID 0x0B at 00035cfc, and exact service-0x22 DID 0x112a returns the high byte. Homologous measured diagnostics identify the DID as manifold absolute pressure.
note: J1979 defines PID 0x0B as kPa, so the word represents kPa*65536/118 above 1.5 kPa and the DID byte about 0.461 kPa per count plus 1.5. The producer and the distinction from DID 0x1116 remain unresolved.

semantics: Exact service-0x22 DID 0x1118 response byte. Homologous measured diagnostics identify it as heated oxygen sensor 1 bank 1.
note: The byte is present in CAN telemetry schema 2 as front_oxygen_sensor_b1_raw. Its physical conversion remains unverified on JK08A.

semantics: Exact service-0x22 DID 0x1119 response byte. Homologous measured diagnostics identify it as heated oxygen sensor 1 bank 2.
note: The byte is present in CAN telemetry schema 2 as front_oxygen_sensor_b2_raw. Its physical conversion remains unverified on JK08A.

semantics: Bank-1 filtered diagnostic word written by FUN 00059d9a and published by exact service-0x22 DID 0x1225.
note: Structured Nissan diagnostics identify the DID as A/F sensor 1 bank 1. The physical conversion remains a target-validation candidate.

semantics: Bank-2 filtered diagnostic word written by FUN 00059e7c and published by exact service-0x22 DID 0x1226.
note: Structured Nissan diagnostics identify the DID as A/F sensor 1 bank 2. Public source conversions conflict, so no physical scale is assigned.

semantics: Signed transient additive pulse term. FUN 00052902 writes clamp_s16(trunc_toward_zero(uint8(ffff150a)*int16(ffff1a66)/256)) or zero under a runtime gate. FUN 0004e974 adds it before common Q14 scaling for both bank precursors and the common precursor.
note: Scheduler ordering makes it a current-pass input. Physical transient qualifier and units remain unresolved.

semantics: Discrete state 0 through 5 produced by 00053574 from ffff1083 and auxiliary gates. Timing-state selector 0004afdc uses state 3 together with ffff2458.bit7 to choose constant ROM8[000086a2] instead of a timing table.
note: The state values and constant-selection predicate are exact. The complete physical operating-mode names of states 0 through 5 remain unresolved.

semantics: Bank-0 offset-neutral correction used by FUN 0004ead4 after the primary trim multiplication. Startup function 000593ac writes 0x8000; a whole-program p-code census found no later application-code writer, so the correction is neutral in the analyzed application.
note: Unresolved indirect hardware activity remains outside the static census.

semantics: Bank-1 companion of offset-neutral correction ffff2310. Startup writes 0x8000 and no later application-code writer was resolved; FUN 0004ead4 consumes it for parity base ffff191e.
note: Static lifecycle and neutral effect mirror ffff2310.

semantics: Feature lifecycle word initialized to exactly 0x4000 by 000593ac and read by timing-state selector 0004afdc. The selector can reach feature table 000121a6 only when this unsigned word is strictly below 0x4000.
note: A whole-application p-code census found one writer and one reader with no unresolved candidates. The stock lifecycle value fails the selector comparison at equality.

semantics: Saturated fuel-base accumulator written by FUN 000554ae as clamp_u16(int32(ffff15f8)+0x4000+uint16(ffff230c)+uint16(ffff15da)). FUN 000556ec adds conditional term ffff240a before Q14 scaling.
note: Physical units remain unresolved.

semantics: Timing-state transition countdown. FUN 0004afdc reloads it from ROM8[000086a3]=85 whenever current upstream DFCO bit ffff2458.bit5 is clear; the periodic timer handler decrements it. Warm transition table 0001219e requires the bit set and this timer nonzero.
note: One count is exactly 204800/Pphi seconds. Passive target-CAN timestamps establish Pphi=20 MHz, so the maximum 85-count selection window is 870.4 ms.

semantics: Scalar byte derived by FUN 000521a8 from the maximum of all six transformed pulse words ffff23d4..ffff23de, ffff241c, and a speed-dependent factor.
note: Physical role remains unresolved; this is not evidence of a pulse-array connection to ATU-II.

semantics: Second scalar byte derived by FUN 000521a8 from the same transformed-pulse maximum path, after bounded division and a mode override.
note: Physical role remains unresolved.

semantics: Conditional uint16 term written by FUN 000554f8 from map 0x154b0 on axis 0x13b28, capped at 3768; disabled paths write zero. FUN 000556ec adds it to ffff231a before Q14 scaling.
note: The Cranking Base Fuel Schedule name and engineering scale remain candidate.

semantics: Closed DFCO state-machine state written and consumed by 000503e0. States 0 through 4 mean idle, first entry delay, second entry delay, full cut, and exit delay. Table 0002371c maps them to masks 00, 00, 15, 3f, and 15.
note: Zero stock stage-2 and exit delays normally make states 2 and 4 transient within one invocation.

semantics: Coarse vehicle-speed snapshot captured by DFCO state machine 000503e0 when its output mask first becomes nonzero and cleared when the mask becomes zero.
note: Combined producer analysis gives approximately 2 km/h per count; the exact engineering conversion remains candidate.

semantics: Adjusted lower/full-restore RPM threshold written by 00050018 from coolant-indexed table 00012818 after runtime floors and offsets.
note: At speed below 4 it is the lower class-3 boundary. At speed 4 or above, every stock-flag branch returns full-restore class 3 at or below its effective lower boundary and class 0 only strictly above it.

semantics: Adjusted low-speed upper/intermediate-restore RPM threshold written by 00050018 from coolant-indexed table 0001298c after runtime floors and offsets.
note: At speed below 4, the band above ffff16aa and at or below this threshold returns class 2. Every moving branch reachable under stock compile-time flags ignores this value.

semantics: Current one-hot injector-event channel mask. Handler 0002be40 writes it from the active event and DFCO state machine 000503e0 uses it as the seed for six-channel rotation.
note: Channel order is code-proven; physical cylinder order remains unresolved.

semantics: Active DFCO rotating-release event count. State machine 000503e0 loads it from pending count ffff1938 after the release delay expires. Injector-event handler 0002be40 decrements it once per qualifying event.
note: Stock class values are zero or two events.

semantics: Pending DFCO rotating-release event count selected by state machine 000503e0 from byte table 0001269a.
note: The first three stock class values are 0, 2, and 2.

semantics: DFCO rotating-release class selected by state machine 000503e0. The stock branch maps runtime value ffff1517 below 4, equal to 4, or at least 5 to classes 0, 1, or 2.
note: An alternate configuration branch selects the class from rotational-speed and vehicle-speed products.

semantics: DFCO rotating-release scheduler countdown. State machine 000503e0 loads it from class table 0001269d and uses 0xff as an inactive sentinel.
note: The first three stock class delays are 0, 5, and 2 counts.

semantics: Live producer byte sampled by scheduler 00020dfe into current snapshot ffff2458. FUN 0006efbc is the only whole-program writer found for bit 5 and derives that upstream DFCO mode/eligibility bit from two Boolean gate groups. FUN 0002e0d4 publishes bit 5 as bit 0 of DID 0x1302 response byte ffff3342.
note: Other functions read or modify other bits of this shared byte. A structured Nissan profile names DID 0x1302 bit 0 CLSD THL POS, and the VQ35HR factory manual defines CLSD THL POS as the idle position computed by the ECM from the accelerator pedal position sensor signal.

semantics: Previous periodic snapshot of ffff2458 written by scheduler 00020dfe before ffff2458 is refreshed from producer ffff2459. FUN 0004fbe2 compares bit 5 with the current snapshot to distinguish rising-edge DFCO entry from a held request.
note: The edge-selection role is code-proven.

semantics: DFCO stage-1 entry countdown loaded by state machine 000503e0 and decremented by periodic handler 0002040c on every tenth base interrupt.
note: One count is exactly 204800/Pphi seconds; passive target-CAN timestamps establish 10.24 ms on JK08A.

semantics: DFCO stage-2 entry countdown loaded by state machine 000503e0 and decremented by periodic handler 0002040c on every tenth base interrupt.
note: Normal stock branches load zero and therefore collapse state 2 in the same invocation.

semantics: DFCO exit countdown loaded by state machine 000503e0 from 0005038a selection and decremented by periodic handler 0002040c on every tenth base interrupt.
note: All relevant stock exit-delay bytes are zero.

semantics: Wrap-corrected engine-event interval divided by 32, in 3.2 us counts of the phi'/32 ATU-II clock. Producers 00028af8 and 0002b768 update it; APC paths use it as event-timing state, and FUN 00038272 publishes ffff1196 = 32000000 / ffff11fc at 00038282, the RPM*5.12 engine-speed word, so the interval is 6250000/RPM counts and spans 120 crank degrees (three engine events per revolution).
note: The 3.2 us count follows PSCR1 = 1 (phi' = Pphi/2 = 10 MHz with Pphi = 20 MHz from CAN timestamps) and TCR1A = 5 (phi'/32); the 120-degree span follows the RPM/50 identity of ffff11e6 = ffff1196 >> 8 confirmed against the CAN engine speed on the car.

semantics: Signed Q8 timing-state word written by knock/high-detonation coordinator 000493e8. In the direct branch it is int16(ffff1380+((low7(0x9A1A)-low7(0x9B1A))<<8)); alternate branches slew-limit a selected Q8 state, apply a lower bound, and clamp positive output to zero.
note: The direct formula requires ffff2469.bit7 clear and ffff2467.bit6 set. It is not a universal interpretation of this word.

semantics: Low seven bits of active cold/hot timing-map sample ffff160f, published by 0004af38.
Nonnegative high-octane-reference difference max(ffff12e0-ffff12de,0) when ROM8[0x8b3f].bit1 is set; zero otherwise.
Low seven bits of cold/high-octane reference sample ffff1610, published by 0004af38.
Scaled transient threshold byte written by 0007b650 and consumed by 0007b7c0 as 32*value in a hysteresis comparison.
note: Code does not establish this byte as an applied ignition-retard amount.

semantics: Raw interpolated output of transient table 0x11f6a before runtime scaling in 0007b650.
One-bit current-cylinder mask for the low byte of POPCR. On the enabled APC path it selects the PULSxSOE set action associated with GR11A; engine inhibit ffff4198 bit 1 clears it.
note: The manual proves output-high action on compare. Cylinder-to-pin continuity and spark-edge polarity remain unverified.

semantics: APC command quotient in units of ten, written by 00028e7c and carried across normal-mode position events by 00028dc8 and 0002ab24.
note: This state proves that command decades are scheduled rather than discarded after the fractional compare calculation.

semantics: APC command remainder paired with decade ffff1558. FUN 00028e7c creates the modulo-ten value; normal scheduling can add 10 or 20 while carrying complete decades through later position events.
note: The current fractional compare is floor(ffff22bc*remainder/10); physical crank-angle units remain unverified.

semantics: Crank reference capture: the GR1E or GR1F word (fffff44c from caller 0002a51e, fffff44e from 0002a5cc) that 0002b768 stores at 0002b7cc for the current engine event. APC compare scheduling uses it as its base, and capture handlers 000c2c58 (000c2c86) and 000c2d76 (000c2da4) subtract it from the channel-4 cam captures to form the exhaust-cam edge interval. Channels 1A and 4 both count phi'/32 = 3.2 us (TCR1A and TCR4 = 5 in 0002718a, PSCR1 = 1 in 000274ac), so the difference is a time.
