note: The producer and consumers are exact. One count is 3.2 us, and one third of the engine-event interval ffff11fc corresponds to 40 crank degrees.

semantics: Active cold/hot timing-map sample written by 0004e1c0. It uses 0x991A cold, blends cold with the hot surface selected by ffff2466.bit6, or uses selected 0x9A1A/0x9B1A hot according to coolant. Bits 0..6 are timing state and bit 7 independently enables a knock-state path.
note: This is an intermediate state sample, not a direct final timing command.

semantics: Cold/high-octane reference timing-map sample written by 0004e1c0. It uses 0x991A cold, blends 0x991A with 0x9A1A in the coolant transition band, and uses 0x9A1A hot regardless of ffff2466.bit6.
note: This is an intermediate reference sample, not a second independently selected hot surface or a direct final timing command.

semantics: Fractional APC compare offset min(65535,floor(ffff22bc*remainder/10)) used by GR11A and GR11B schedulers.
note: The arithmetic is exact; physical angular units are unresolved.

semantics: Bounded timing-state byte produced by 0004bdc2 in crank degrees. The normal branch is clamp_s8(ffff23f1+ffff23bd-ffff23c5-ffff12dc-ffff15ea-128+ffff1a7d+ffff134a), which is base angle ffff23f1 plus (low7-64) plus (ffff1a7d-64) minus the unsigned retard terms; the alternate branch is clamp_s8(ffff1a7d+ffff23ee-ffff23c5-64). FUN 0004c136 can latch it into ffff2404.
note: One count is one crank degree of the J1979 PID 0x0E coordinate ffff11d4; every downstream coefficient is 1.

semantics: Reset-edge command offset produced by 0004e080. Source ffff237a is bounded to 0..114 and stock optional subtraction ROM8[0x8649] is zero, proving a stock offset range of 6..120. APC scheduler 0002a892 also uses the byte in mode gating.
note: An override target at most 117 yields a newly constructed secondary command at most 237. The physical dwell interpretation and scale require hardware validation.

semantics: Copy of the normalized captured interval quotient floor(event_interval/12) written by 0002b768.
note: The physical angular unit is unresolved.

semantics: Normalized captured interval quotient floor(event_interval/12) written by 0002b768 and multiplied by the APC command remainder over ten to form compare offsets. The event interval ffff11fc spans 120 crank degrees in 3.2 us counts, so the quotient is 10 crank degrees, one tooth of the crank wheel; capture handlers 000c2de0 and 000c2c58 read it at 000c2dfa and 000c2cc6 and divide 20 times the cam edge interval by it to form the 0.5-degree phase bytes ffff1200 and ffff1201.
note: The 10-degree scale follows the 3.2 us clock of the ATU-II captures (TCR1A = 5 in 0002718a, PSCR1 = 1 in 000274ac) and the RPM identity ffff1196 = 32000000 / ffff11fc of 00038272.

semantics: Second wrap-corrected event interval divided by 32, written by 00028b5c and refreshed from captures by 0002b768.
note: One count is 3.2 us (phi'/32 with PSCR1 = 1).

semantics: Signed timing-state byte written by 000493e8 as truncation toward zero of int16(ffff121a)/256 and consumed directly by engine-event correction builder 0004d99c.
note: For negative ffff121a the writer adds 0xff before extracting the upper byte, so this is not an unconditional high-byte copy.

semantics: Nonnegative active-map state max((ffff160f&0x7f)-ffff11af,0), written by 0004af38 and included linearly in the normal branch of 0004bdc2.
note: Crank-degree map adjustment before the 64 centering applied in 0004bdc2. One count is one crank degree of the J1979 PID 0x0E coordinate ffff11d4; every downstream coefficient is 1.

semantics: Bounded Q8 transition state written by nonlinear controller 00063f30. With stock ROM8[0x8710].bit5 set, 0004d99c consumes its high byte while building ffff12d6.
note: The value forms the multi-cycle selected-map state path. Physical units remain unresolved.

semantics: Periodic snapshot of ffff2406 used by 0004e080 and 0002af38 while constructing and maintaining the GR11B command offset. FUN 00020dfe copies 0x8c bytes from ffff23bc to ffff2330, mapping source offset 0x4a exactly to this byte.
note: Producer 0004c1e4 bounds ffff2406 and this snapshot to 0..114. The physical offset meaning remains unverified.

semantics: Latched timing-state byte written by 0004c136 from ffff1830 or ffff1831 and consumed by 00063f30 and 0004afdc.
note: The actuator-relevant path is through scheduler snapshot ffff2378 into 0004d99c; 00063f30 consumes the same byte for the Q8 transition state. One count is one crank degree of the J1979 PID 0x0E coordinate ffff11d4; every downstream coefficient is 1.

semantics: Multipurpose transient-state byte. FUN 0007b7c0 maintains bit 6 through a hysteresis comparison using scaled threshold ffff1393. Bit 4 is the cancel latch of the standstill exhaust override in FUN 000bfe88: set at 000c01c8 when ffff24d3 bit 4 is set while ffff246c bit 1 requests the override, cleared at 000c018c while ffff248b bit 2 is clear; while the latch is set the conditioner holds the previous ffff137e instead of the map target.
note: No direct connection from bit 6 to the final timing coordinate or APC registers is established. Other consumers may use different bits.

semantics: Periodic snapshot byte consumed by final timing-coordinate builder 0004dbe8. Scheduler 00020dfe copies it from ffff56b2 as part of a 0x66-byte block.
note: This byte is not a copy of ffff1513. FUN 0004dbe8 adds it to ffff12d6 only while ffff5b31 bits 1..5 are clear (warm coolant, RPM/25 within ROM8[0x8897]..ROM8[0x8896]=48..128, load ffff1048 within ROM8[0x8768]..ROM8[0x8767]=64..96); the value is bounded to ROM8[0x821d]..ROM8[0x821c]=-5..0 crank degrees at its source 0004aad0.

semantics: Source byte for periodic snapshot ffff564c. FUN 0004aad0 is its sole direct writer and publishes a bounded signed mode-dependent state.
note: Bounded to ROM8[0x821d]=-5..ROM8[0x821c]=0 crank degrees; the snapshot ffff564c enters the final coordinate ffff11d4 with coefficient 1 inside the ffff5b31 window.

semantics: TCNT11, the 16-bit free-running counter for Advanced Pulse Controller channel 11.
note: Register identity comes from the SH7058 hardware manual.

semantics: GR11A, the APC channel-11 compare register used for the output-high event selected by the low byte of POPCR.
note: Register behavior comes from the SH7058 hardware manual; physical spark-edge polarity is unverified.

semantics: GR11B, the APC channel-11 compare register used for the output-low event selected by the high byte of POPCR.
note: Register behavior comes from the SH7058 hardware manual; physical spark-edge polarity is unverified.

semantics: TSR11, the APC channel-11 status register. Command schedulers clear the applicable compare flag after programming GR11A or GR11B.
note: Register identity and flag behavior come from the SH7058 hardware manual.

semantics: Saturating transition counter maintained by FUN 0004f9c4 from current ffff244f.bit2 and previous ffff2453.bit2. Values below 60 permit entry to the transition-window fuel cut; values at or above 150 force release.
note: A current set bit loads 255, a previous-only set bit loads zero, and the continuing path increments with saturation.

semantics: Low-speed RPM exposure accumulator. FUN 0004f7e0 adds 12 per eligible pass at coarse speed <=4 and 2300..2900 RPM up to stock cap 24000; its principal decay path subtracts one.
note: FUN 0004f958 converts cap attainment into the 1800/1500 RPM inhibit state.

semantics: P0011/P0021 qualification counter. FUN 00050b3c increments it up to 255 while its software qualification and hardware ffff84c3.bit6 are active; loss of software qualification resets it, while a clear hardware bit freezes it.
note: A count of at least 10 permits exact runtime records 208 and 209 to set ffff2486.bit6.

semantics: Periodic snapshot byte copied from current state ffff2449 by scheduler 00020dfe. FUN 0004f736 consumes bit 7 as the dual-bank MAF diagnostic-summary state and requests full fuel inhibit at 2400 RPM or above.
note: Other bits have independent consumers.

semantics: Current multipurpose state byte. FUN 0003c3ac sets bit 7 to extension record 0x129 byte1.bit7, which is the OR of P0101/P0102/P0103 and P010B/P010C/P010D runtime status; scheduler 00020dfe snapshots it to ffff2448.
note: Other bits belong to independent state machines.

semantics: Multipurpose state byte. FUN 0004f958 uses bit 7 for sustained low-speed RPM inhibit after ffff1932 reaches 24000; it sets at 1800 RPM, retains through 1500 RPM, and feeds the global fuel mask.
note: Other bits belong to unrelated state machines.

semantics: Multipurpose status byte. FUN 00050a60 uses bit 5 to mark the internal-key-0x2ee0 requested-RPM source valid after rejecting values 0 and 0xff and associated fault states.
note: Other bits belong to independent state machines.

semantics: P0011/P0021 fuel-inhibit qualification byte in FUN 00050b3c. Bit 5 is the software operating-condition result; bit 6 sets after counter ffff1946 reaches ten and either exact runtime record 208 or 209 has byte1.bit5 set.
note: Bit 6 gates the final 3000/2800 RPM state in ffff2497.bit0.

semantics: Multipurpose state byte. FUN 000507ce uses bit 0 for an 1800/1600 RPM hysteresis state gated by ffff245d.bit6 and ffff2458.bit5.
note: Other bits belong to unrelated state machines.

semantics: Multipurpose state byte. Coordinator 000493e8 copies ffff160f.bit7 into bit 6 for knock-state eligibility logic. FUN 0004faac uses bit 3 as its engine-running inhibit state and requires bit 4 as an enable input. Direct runtime writers modify bits 0, 1, 2, 3, 6, and 7 while preserving bit 4.
note: Normal startup clears the containing [ffff1000,ffff261c) span and both recovery paths clear [ffff1000,ffff5cf4). A 2315-function p-code census and the recovered DMAC configuration find no path that can set bit 4, so it remains zero in the proven stock lifecycle.

semantics: Multipurpose state byte. Bit 1 is produced by FUN 0003ece8 and is one of three enable conditions for the status-gated engine-running fuel-inhibit contributor 0004faac.
note: The physical meaning of bit 1 remains unresolved.

semantics: Multipurpose state byte. FUN 00050a60 uses bit 7 for the CAN-derived requested-RPM-ceiling hysteresis state. Bit 6 is the exhaust-VTC active-test request: FUN 0002e466 sets it at 0002e5ec while service-0x30 Output Control IOLID 0x1d active flag ffff99c7 bit 4, ffff248b bit 0, and ffff244f bit 1 are set, vehicle-speed byte ffff110e is at most ROM8[000089f1]=2, and raw coolant ffff1071 lies in ROM8[000089f3]=110..ROM8[000089f2]=170, storing the requested offset ffff1706 = clamp(int8(ffff9940), ROM8[0000873e]=-20..ROM8[0000873f]=20) at 0002e612; it clears the bit at 0002e61c otherwise. Enable coordinator 000bf630 reads it at 000bf8dc as the bypass of the coolant-window term of ffff248b bit 2, and FUN 000bfe88 reads it at 000c04ca to add ffff1706 to the exhaust target.
note: Other bits belong to independent state machines. ffff9940 is the IOLID 0x1d value byte of service-0x30 handler 00030c4c (ffff9923 + n) and ffff99c7 bit 4 its active flag (array ffff99c4, bit n-1).

semantics: Vehicle-speed fuel-cut state byte. FUN 0004f19c uses bit 0 as the active 93/91 coarse-speed hysteresis state and returns it to the global fuel-inhibit coordinator.
note: Candidate conversion places the entry/release thresholds near 186/182 km/h; hardware validation remains required.

semantics: Activation-delay timer for zero-speed high-BFS/high-RPM contributor 0004f14e. A failed condition reloads immediate value 110; the contributor returns true only after expiry while all gates remain satisfied.
note: Its exact wall-clock scale remains tied to the unresolved periodic task timebase.

semantics: Delay timer used by side-effect-only low-speed BFS/RPM latch updater 0004f758. Expiry permits setting ffff41d4.bit0 under the function's speed, RPM, BFS, and status gates.
note: The latch then blocks later low-speed protection branches.

semantics: Periodic snapshot of decoded internal-key-0x2ee0 payload byte ffff2818. FUN 00050a60 interprets valid values as a requested RPM ceiling in RPM/50 units.
note: Values 0 and 0xff disable the dynamic ceiling in the consumer.

semantics: Runtime selector byte read by FUN 0003ece8 and captured by FUN 0004faac as min(7,value) for indexing stock table 000126f4.
note: Both eight-byte halves of the stock table are zero, so the selected threshold is always zero. Its producer is not assigned here.

semantics: Live decoded byte for internal dispatch key 0x2ee0. FUN 000c4ace writes the selected payload field; invalid handler 000c5d2e writes 0xfe; the periodic copier publishes snapshot ffff2714.
note: The internal dispatch key is not asserted to equal a raw physical CAN identifier.

semantics: Per-pass Power Balance mask cache. FUN 00050a06 copies diagnostic value ffff992f here while service-0x30 IOLID-0x0c is active; FUN 00050a34 returns it in place of the aggregate fuel mask.
note: The ETC auxiliary mask is ORed after this replacement.

semantics: Shared status byte. Bit 1 is returned directly by global fuel-inhibit contributor 0004faa0.
note: Normal startup clears the containing [ffff261c,ffff4514) span and both recovery paths clear [ffff1000,ffff5cf4). The full p-code census finds no store to the byte; its only unresolved base-ffff4184 store targets offsets 0x54 or 0x65. Recovered DMAC destinations are limited to ffff86cc..ffff87cb, so bit 1 remains zero in the proven stock lifecycle.

semantics: Multipurpose status byte. FUN 0004f758 can set bit 0 after its low-speed BFS/RPM delay; FUN 0004f9c4 requires that bit clear before entering its transition-window fuel cut.
note: Other writers and bits belong to independent state machines.

semantics: Multipurpose diagnostic status byte in the fuel-inhibit family. FUN 0007c166 recomputes bit 5 as the critical P0603/P0605/P2119/P1238 aggregate; FUN 00050920 stores the qualified 2525/2000 RPM inhibit state in bit 6. Bit 7 is the stock-inert lifecycle-zero direct subpath of composite contributor 000507ce.
note: Normal startup clears the byte inside [ffff261c,ffff4514), and both recovery paths clear it inside [ffff1000,ffff5cf4). A 2315-function p-code census found no unresolved writer. Runtime writers 0007c166, 00050920, and 0007f870 all preserve bit 7, and recovered DMAC destinations do not overlap the byte, so bit 7 remains zero in the proven stock lifecycle.

semantics: Multipurpose diagnostic status byte. FUN 0004f494 uses bit 3 as the 1900/1700 RPM hysteresis state for the P1217 engine-overtemperature fuel inhibit.
note: Other bits and consumers belong to independent diagnostic state machines.

semantics: P1217 engine-overtemperature diagnostic and fuel-inhibit state byte in FUN 0004f494. Bit 3 is the qualified diagnostic phase, bit 4 requests the diagnostic dispatch, and bit 5 is the final RPM-gated fuel-inhibit state.
note: Exact descriptor 00019378 is P1217 ENG OVER TEMP.

semantics: Multipurpose diagnostic readiness byte. FUN 000804ce sets bit 7 once RPM/12.5 reaches 0x20, or 400 RPM; FUN 00080b54 clears it during diagnostic reset. Bit 7 gates qualification-counter increment in FUN 0007d856.
note: A 2315-function p-code census found no unresolved writer. Other runtime writers preserve bit 7.

semantics: Multipurpose diagnostic readiness byte. FUN 000804ce sets bit 4 when raw coolant ffff1071 exceeds start-latched raw coolant ffff106e by at least 20 and sets bit 5 once raw coolant reaches 0x78. FUN 00080b54 clears both bits during diagnostic reset; both gate qualification-counter increment in FUN 0007d856.
note: A 2315-function p-code census found no unresolved writer. Other runtime writers preserve bits 4 and 5. Bit 4 is the coolant rise of 20 deg C after engine start and bit 5 the coolant temperature of 70 deg C of factory driving pattern A.

semantics: Critical-diagnostic qualification counter produced by FUN 0007d856 and consumed by 00050920. A clear ffff41ea.bit5 resets it; with that aggregate set, ffff422e.bit7 and ffff422f.bits4/5 permit saturating increment while loss of any readiness latch holds the prior count.
note: The fuel-inhibit branch qualifies when the counter is greater than stock threshold four and the critical aggregate remains set.

semantics: Diagnostic service-0x30 IOLID-0x0c value byte. FUN 00030c4c stores the requested Power Balance mask; FUN 00050a06 copies it to cache ffff2b2c while the IOLID is active.
note: A structured Nissan-family profile maps bits 1..32 to cylinders 1..6. Exact electrical channel order remains a hardware boundary.

semantics: Diagnostic service-0x30 active-bit byte. Bit 3 marks IOLID 0x0c Power Balance active and is consumed by FUN 00050a06.
note: Startup FUN 0002e76e clears the active-bit and value arrays.

semantics: Bounded APC reset-offset source term written by 0004c1e4. Stock ROM8[0x8b88]=6 supplies the lower bound and ROM8[0x8b87]=114 supplies the upper bound.
note: The numeric range is exact. The physical dwell interpretation remains unverified.

semantics: Map-derived APC reset-offset candidate written by 0004c1e4 after a capped product of lookup outputs from 0x1208e and 0x12096. The same function limits it to uint8 and compares it with ffff1874.
note: The exact physical quantity and map engineering scales remain unresolved.

semantics: Current APC reset-offset source selected by 0004c1e4 as min(ffff1874,ffff1875), with a diagnostic-state override to 24. Its proven stock range is 0..114. Periodic dispatcher 00020dfe copies it to ffff237a.
note: The copy uses matching offset 0x4a inside the 0x8c-byte ffff23bc -> ffff2330 snapshot.

semantics: Current crank/cam position-diagnostic mode byte. FUN 00099a48 can set bit 6 from the P0335 runtime-record pair when the P0340 and P0345 pairs do not select companion modes. Scheduler 00020dfe copies this byte to ffff24c9.
note: Other functions maintain independent bits. Bit 6 selects alternate behavior in both APC compare schedulers.

semantics: Periodic snapshot of current diagnostic mode byte ffff24cf. Bit 6 selects alternate paths in primary scheduler 0002a892 and secondary scheduler 0002acba; bit 5 selects the optional subtraction branch in 0004e080.
note: A late retard override must preserve the stock command while bit 6 is set. Stock ROM8[0x8649]=0 makes the bit-5 subtraction numerically neutral in JK08A.

semantics: Volatile currently defined dynamic local identifier. SID 0xac stores the accepted DLID here after building its pointer list, and SID 0x21 requires a requested dynamic LID above 0x80 to match this byte.
note: A fresh definition normally uses 0x81. The value and associated pointer list are runtime session state and are not persistent ROM configuration.

semantics: Active diagnostic response transmission mode copied from the TXM byte of SID 0x21. The service accepts only 0x04 and 0x06. The transmit-complete interrupt counts finite mode 0x04 and routes continuous mode 0x06 through the response-completion state-machine path.
note: Mode 0x06 remains active across responses; its NRS byte does not terminate the stream.

semantics: Finite diagnostic response counter maintained by transmit-complete interrupt 0002f12c for mode 0x04. It increments after each completed transmission and is cleared when it reaches requested count ffff8214.
note: Mode 0x06 bypasses this counter.

semantics: Requested number of responses copied from the NRS byte of SID 0x21. Transmit-complete interrupt 0002f12c compares it with ffff8213 only for mode 0x04.
note: The byte is stored for mode 0x06 but does not limit continuous transmission.

semantics: Diagnostic transport state maintained by 0002ea0a. On the reviewed continuous-response path, completion advances the state through 3 and 6; state 6 sets state 4 and calls service dispatcher 0002f928 to rebuild the response.
note: Other numeric states serve receive, timeout, and session paths and are outside this narrow claim.

semantics: Diagnostic transport flag byte. Transmit-complete interrupt 0002f12c sets bit 7 for mode 0x06; state machine 0002ea0a observes and clears that bit before redispatching the active service.
note: Other bits and writers belong to independent transport conditions.

semantics: Base of the volatile dynamic-local-identifier source-pointer array. SID 0xac writes one 32-bit pointer per output byte, and SID 0x21 traverses the array in index order and byte-dereferences each selected source.
note: The storage span to ffff9920 permits 64 pointer slots, while the 0xac parser guard limits a pure 0x83 definition to 62 output bytes. The array is not an atomic snapshot buffer.

semantics: Number of response-byte sources in the volatile dynamic-local-identifier pointer array at ffff9820. SID 0xac stores the parsed output count; SID 0x21 uses it as the traversal bound.
note: For a definition made only from arbitrary-address descriptor 0x83, the maximum accepted count is 62.

semantics: Saturating count of selected-channel knock-threshold exceedances accumulated by FUN 0004a238. The evaluator increments it when ffff24c2.bit6 is set and caps it at 0xff. Periodic coordinator 000493e8 consumes the count and clears it before the final FUN 00020dfe snapshot boundary.
note: A telemetry snapshot after FUN 00020dfe must use a pre-coordinator latch rather than read this byte directly.

semantics: Base of six one-based per-channel uint16 knock thresholds at ffff2144..ffff214f. FUN 00049ffc interpolates one of six rows of Knock Slice Map 0001108e by engine speed and writes ffff2144 + 2*(channel-1); FUN 0004a238 compares the selected threshold with its calculated metric.
note: The physical channel-to-cylinder order and engineering threshold unit remain unverified. ffff2142 is a separate event counter, not the first threshold word.

semantics: Six-position knock-threshold result bitmap maintained by FUN 0004a238. The selected one-based channel bit is set while its current comparison exceeds the threshold and cleared otherwise.
note: The bitmap represents current per-channel evaluator states rather than a proven interval OR. Physical cylinder order remains unverified.

semantics: Base of the 30 ten-byte stock HCAN1 software mailbox records corresponding to ROM table records at 0000975a. Record i is ffff3ab5+10*i; bytes 0 and 1 hold state and age, and bytes 2 through 9 hold the payload copied to physical mailbox i+1 by FUN 000c3746.
note: Only firmware type-3 records use the stock periodic serializer and submitter path.

semantics: HCAN1 interrupt register. Bit 8 is the mailbox-empty interrupt flag used by SLE1; stock ISR 000c7914 clears it by writing word 0x0100.
note: The flag is shared by every HCAN1 transmit mailbox whose mailbox activity interrupt is enabled.

semantics: HCAN1 TXPR1 transmit-wait register for physical mailboxes 16 through 31. Bit n corresponds to physical mailbox 16+n; bit 10 or mask 0x0400 therefore requests mailbox 26.
note: Writing one requests transmission; successful completion or acknowledged cancellation clears the bit in hardware.

semantics: HCAN1 TXACK1 successful-transmission register for physical mailboxes 16 through 31. Bit 10 or 0x0400 represents mailbox 26; stock SLE1 ISR 000c7914 handles only mailbox-28 bit 12 or 0x1000.
note: Bits are write-one-to-clear.

semantics: HCAN1 ABACK1 transmission-abort register for physical mailboxes 16 through 31. Bit 10 or 0x0400 represents mailbox 26; stock SLE1 ISR 000c7914 handles only mailbox-28 bit 12 or 0x1000.
note: Bits are write-one-to-clear.

semantics: HCAN1 MBIMR1 mailbox activity interrupt mask for physical mailboxes 16 through 31. Zero enables and one masks the corresponding mailbox interrupt. FUN 000c2fbe clears bits for firmware table types 2 and 4.
note: Bit 10 controls physical mailbox 26. MBIMR masks interrupt generation but does not suppress TXACK or ABACK state.

semantics: HCAN1 physical mailbox 26 control-field base. The standard identifier occupies the word at +0, the extended-identifier low word is at +2, and MBC/DLC control is at +4.
note: Stock record 25 is 05 00 00 00 and configures this mailbox inactive.

semantics: HCAN1 physical mailbox 26 eight-byte message-data base at control base +8.
note: The custom telemetry design assigns this otherwise stock-inactive payload field only after changing mailbox record 25.

semantics: SH7058 A/D data register 0 (ADDR0), containing the left-aligned 10-bit conversion result for analog channel AN0. JK08A connects this MCU input to an external analog multiplexer selected through PFDR bits PF13..PF15.
note: The hardware manual maps AN0 to MCU pin 86/H17. Exact firmware and diagnostic paths bind mux codes 000, 001, and 111 to coolant, battery voltage, and fuel temperature respectively; the ECM-side mux circuit and remaining positions are not assigned.

semantics: SH7058 Port F data register (PFDR). JK08A uses bits PF13..PF15 as the three-bit selector for the external analog multiplexer feeding AN0.
note: The cyclic sampler advances selector codes 000 through 111 and resets to 000. The direct reader replaces the same three bits with its caller-supplied selector.

semantics: Ten-bit AN0 external-mux sample for selector code 000. Cyclic sampler 000280d8 writes the phase-1 ADDR0 result here; direct acquisition 0002c4f8 also writes the result of 00028668(0,0) before coolant conversion.
note: The exact DID 0x1101 response path binds selector code 000 to engine coolant temperature.

semantics: Phase-2 AN0 external-mux sample for selector code 001. Cyclic sampler 000280d8 writes the ADDR0 result here after phase 1 selects PF13; battery-voltage publisher 00039a9e consumes it, and raw hysteresis updater 00038128 uses the pre-conversion word.
note: The exact DID 0x1103 response path through ffff1188 binds selector code 001 to battery voltage. No engineering scale is assigned directly to this pre-conversion word.

semantics: Multipurpose status byte whose bit 7 mirrors computed START SIGNAL ffff4185.bit6. FUN 00038d44 writes the mirror and diagnostic status packer 0002e0d4 maps it to ffff3342.bit1.
note: The exact DID 0x1302 response path identifies the destination bit as START SIGNAL. Other bits in this byte are outside this claim.

semantics: Exact first response byte for UDS DID 0x1302. FUN 0002e0d4 packs seven status bits; bit 1 is copied from ffff24ae.bit7 and therefore mirrors computed START SIGNAL ffff4185.bit6.
note: The exact support mask is 0x3f. A structured Nissan profile identifies DID 0x1302 bit 1 as START SIGNAL; the remaining packed bits retain their code-level sources without target physical names here.

semantics: Piecewise accelerator-pedal normalization written by 00075590 from snapshot ffff266e. It is 0 at input <=45, 1500 at input >=170, and floor((input-45)*1500/125) between those boundaries.
note: The normalized maximum is an internal count, not a percentage or voltage.

semantics: Signed accelerator-request precursor written by 00075590 after combining the normalized pedal contribution with bounded offsets, corrections, and mode-controlled limits.
note: This word is not a pure pedal percentage because its producer adds independent terms.

semantics: Conditionally scaled signed pedal-request word written by 00075306 from ffff18f2 through ffff19a2, ffff23fc, and ROM16[0x944e].
note: Zero is written when either runtime divisor is zero.

semantics: Mode-selected signed pedal-request word written by 00075396 from ffff19d4 or ffff19ba and consumed by 000753d4.
note: The selected alternate source remains an internal request quantity.

semantics: Direct Q15 normalization of pedal snapshot ffff266e written by 000753d4 using stock lower word ROM16[0x94e4]=0 and upper word ROM16[0x94e8]=170, then clamped to 0..32768.
note: The upper word address includes the SH scaled word displacement. This value bounds the 0x10b0e coefficient and is not an actuator target.

semantics: Raw Q15-like coefficient selected as max(lookup(0x10b0e),ffff18c8) by 000753d4. The stored word can exceed the 0xa000 cap applied by the subsequent arithmetic.
note: The physical TTEPTD interpretation remains candidate.

semantics: Signed compensated pedal-request word written by 000753d4 and normalized/inverse-converted by 00075540 to form ffff243c.
note: Stock 0x89fb.bit5 selects the compensation branch; clearing it would copy ffff19d0.

semantics: Direct APP inverse coordinate written by 00073432 from ffff243c+0x8000 through the current-RPM row of 0xe98e.
note: Its branch in 000730fc requires 0x870c.bit7. Stock value 0x44 leaves that branch disabled, so this is not the stock-active actuator coordinate.

semantics: Stock-active inverse coordinate written by 00073432 from shared signed request ffff19c6+0x8000 through the current-RPM row of 0xe98e.
note: 000730fc carries this already-arbitrated coordinate into the opening-area request path.

semantics: Unsigned opening-area-domain request written by 000730fc after shared-request arbitration, piecewise coordinate conversion, scaling by ffff1702 and ROM8[0x8d8f], and clamping through the first value of 0x13202.
note: The actuator path continues through ffff19b2. The opening-area physical unit and scale remain candidate.

semantics: Derived common opening-coordinate monitor written by 000710bc from inverse conversion of ffff183e/2 through 0x155a0/0x13202 followed by division by four.
note: It is not a channel target, measured TPS value, regulator effort, or PWM duty.

semantics: Saturated upper term written by 000476a0 as ffff122a*ROM16[0x92fc]>>13 and used to bound the idle/opening-area base ffff1340.
note: The operational bound is exact; physical units remain candidate.

semantics: Idle/opening-area base written by 000476d2 as min(sat_u16(lookup(0x1465a)+lookup(0x1469a)),ffff133e) and added to ffff183e by the normal 00072c3c target composition.
note: The raw base contribution is code-proven. The catalog ISC name and opening-area scale remain candidate.

semantics: Shared throttle target-area word. Normal 00072c3c writes clamp_u16(ffff183e+ffff1340-(ffff120e>>2)); alternate mode reconstructs it from final channel targets. It is consumed by common and per-channel target converters 0006f464 and 0006f48c.
note: The normal forward path is independent of the alternate feedback reconstruction.

semantics: Secondary shared target-area word written by 00072c3c as sat_u16(ffff183e+ffff2a1c) on the normal branch or from the same two-channel reconstruction on the alternate branch.
note: Its downstream physical role is narrower than the proven ffff19b2 actuator-target path.

semantics: Common target-opening coordinate written by 0006f464 from inverse conversion of ffff19b2/2 through 0x155a0/0x13202.
note: Unlike ffff40c6, this word is not divided by four. Physical degree scale remains candidate.

semantics: Base of internal throttle-target working storage. 0006f48c writes the inverse conversion of ffff1340/2 divided by four at the base and uses adjacent words for channel corrections and learned references.
note: Individual adjacent fields retain separate operational roles.

semantics: Per-channel throttle-target upper bound written by 0006f48c. The dynamic branch stores clamp(raw(0x12daa)*13,908,2908); the fixed branch stores 2908.
note: The catalog TVO unit and scale remain candidate.

semantics: Base of two uint16 per-channel throttle targets: channel 0 at ffff28bc and channel 1 at ffff28be. 0006f48c applies normal, mode, lower, upper, and DTC caps before publication.
note: Code channel-to-bank identity and physical degree scale remain unverified.

semantics: Base of the first two-word throttle-feedback estimate array written by six-sample acquisition stage 0003e75a and normalized by 0003ea9a.
note: Elements are at ffff38a8 and ffff38aa. External sensor and bank identities remain unverified.

semantics: Base of the second two-word throttle-feedback estimate array written by 0003e75a and normalized by 0003eade.
note: Elements are at ffff38e8 and ffff38ea.

semantics: Base of the first two-word normalized throttle-feedback candidate array written by 0003ea9a. Elements are ffff2660 and ffff2662.
note: The transform uses a 0x2000 center and saturates to uint16.

semantics: Base of the second two-word normalized throttle-feedback candidate array written by 0003eade. Elements are ffff2664 and ffff2666.
note: The transform uses a 0x2000 center and lower-clamps at zero.

semantics: Base of the two-word plausibility-selected throttle-feedback array written by 000cafbc. Elements are ffff3884 and ffff3886.
note: DTC record 0x57 governs code channel 0 and record 0x120 governs code channel 1.

semantics: Base of the two-word fault-selected throttle-feedback array written by 000cb078 and compared with the closed reference by 000cb140. Elements are ffff3888 and ffff388a.
note: Normal mode carries the plausibility-selected feedback; fault modes can substitute learned or fixed references.

semantics: Base of two uint32 feedback-reference magnitude terms written by 000cb140 at stride four and consumed by 000cb614.
note: Channel elements are ffff36a0 and ffff36a4.

semantics: Base of the two-byte feedback-reference direction array written by 000cb140 and consumed by 000cb614.
note: Elements are ffff369c and ffff369d.

semantics: Base of the two-word scaled channel-target array written by 000cb1ca as sat_u16(ffff28bc[channel]*16+0x2000).
note: Elements are ffff387a and ffff387c.

semantics: Base of the two-word selected regulator-target array written by 000cb224 and compared with the closed reference by 000cb2b6.
note: Elements are ffff3926 and ffff3928; fault modes can substitute alternate references.

semantics: Base of the two-byte target-reference direction array written by 000cb2b6 and copied to ffff392b/ffff392c by 000cb354.
note: Elements are ffff3900 and ffff3901.

semantics: Base of the two-word target-reference magnitude array written by 000cb2b6 and scaled by 000cb354.
note: Elements are ffff3902 and ffff3904.

semantics: Base of two uint32 scaled target-reference magnitudes written by 000cb354 at stride four and consumed by 000cb614.
note: Elements are ffff391c and ffff3920.

semantics: Base of the two-byte scaled target-reference direction array written by 000cb354 and consumed by 000cb614.
note: Elements are ffff392b and ffff392c.

semantics: Base of two uint32 throttle-regulator effort magnitudes written by 000cb614 at stride four and consumed by 000cc5f0.
note: Elements are ffff37b8 and ffff37bc. The consumer's immediate -0x20 is zero-extended to unsigned 0xe0 before addition to base ffff36d8.

semantics: Base of the two-byte throttle-regulator effort-direction array written by 000cb614 and consumed by 000cc6a2.
note: Elements are ffff369a and ffff369b; normal direction codes are -0x10 and 0x0f. Opening polarity remains unverified.

semantics: Base of two uint32 bounded throttle-regulator state words written by 000cb614 at stride four and capped by ROM32[0x96bc]=0x000d0000.
note: Elements are ffff2628 and ffff262c. They are state, not direct motor duty or a simple instantaneous error.

semantics: Base of two uint32 previous-pass throttle-regulator state snapshots copied from ffff2628/ffff262c and consumed by 000cb614.
note: Elements are ffff2630 and ffff2634.

semantics: Base of two uint16 throttle duty commands written by 000cc5f0: channel 0 at ffff374c and channel 1 at ffff374e. Each value is capped at the stock literal 490 before 000407c0 scales it to ATU-II timer counts.
note: This is the last RAM magnitude before the hardware-register publisher.

semantics: First two-bit throttle PWM direction mask written by 000cc6a2 and consumed by 000407c0 together with ffff385e.
note: Bits 0 and 1 correspond to code channels 0 and 1. Physical opening polarity remains unverified.

semantics: Second two-bit throttle PWM direction mask written by 000cc6a2 and consumed by 000407c0 together with ffff36dc.
note: The pair selects which complementary ATU-II register receives nonzero duty.

semantics: SH7058S ATU-II channel 6 PWM buffer register BFR6A. 000407c0 uses it as the first member of code-channel-0 complementary output pair.
note: The hardware manual maps BFR6A to TO6A/PB0, package pin 145. ECM-board continuity and polarity remain unverified.

semantics: SH7058S ATU-II channel 6 PWM buffer register BFR6B. 000407c0 uses it as the second member of code-channel-0 complementary output pair.
note: The hardware manual maps BFR6B to TO6B/PB1, package pin 146. ECM-board continuity and polarity remain unverified.

semantics: SH7058S ATU-II channel 6 PWM buffer register BFR6C. 000407c0 uses it as the first member of code-channel-1 complementary output pair.
note: The hardware manual maps BFR6C to TO6C/PB2, package pin 147. ECM-board continuity and polarity remain unverified.

semantics: SH7058S ATU-II channel 6 PWM buffer register BFR6D. 000407c0 uses it as the second member of code-channel-1 complementary output pair.
note: The hardware manual maps BFR6D to TO6D/PB3, package pin 149. ECM-board continuity and polarity remain unverified.

semantics: Code-channel-1 uint16 throttle target written by 0006f48c after normal, mode, lower, upper, and DTC caps. It is the second element of the array based at ffff28bc.
note: Code channel-to-bank identity and physical degree scale remain unverified.

semantics: Unsigned threshold subtracted from active low-seven-bit timing-map field ffff12de by 0004af38. The result is lower-clamped at zero into ffff23bd.
note: The cell is the scheduler 00020dfe snapshot of ffff11e7 inside the block copy ffff11d4..ffff120b -> ffff119c..ffff11d3; ffff11e7 is written by 0004e0c2 at 0004e10c as a follower of ffff2363 limited to ROM8[0x845d] counts per pass. One count is one crank degree of the map adjustment field.

semantics: Signed Q8 knock-state accumulator maintained by 000493e8. On one branch a quiet interval adds ROM16[0x8eaa]=13 and an interval with latched events subtracts ROM16[0x8eae]=307 multiplied by ffff2142, with signed 16-bit saturation.
note: Other coordinator branches can copy, force, filter, or zero this state.

semantics: Signed Q8 base term used by the direct hot-surface difference branch of 000493e8. The branch forms ffff121a=int16(ffff1380+((low7(0x9A1A)-low7(0x9B1A))<<8)).
note: The formula applies only under the direct-branch mode gates.

semantics: Signed Q8 state used by one high-detonation selector hysteresis branch in 000493e8. The branch sets ffff2466.bit6 at or below -1792 and clears it only above 8192.
note: Other gates can force either selector state.

semantics: Multipurpose state byte. Bit 6 enables the direct high-octane minus high-detonation Q8 map-difference branch in 000493e8 when ffff2469.bit7 is clear.
note: Other bits and consumers belong to separate calculations.

semantics: Multipurpose state byte. Bit 7 suppresses the direct high-octane minus high-detonation Q8 map-difference branch in 000493e8 when set.
note: Other bits and consumers belong to separate calculations.

semantics: First-bank composite byte built in P0101 range-performance monitor 0008152a from factors 0001236a, 00012ac2, and 00012868 plus per-bank opening-area weighting. It is an alternate comparison threshold and captured event value.
note: Stock 00008d92 bit 5 bypasses the model-byte comparison, so this byte affects only captured P0101 event context in the unmodified image.

semantics: Second-bank composite byte built in P010B range-performance monitor 00081d74 from factors 0001236a, 00012ac2, and 00012868 plus per-bank opening-area weighting. It is an alternate comparison threshold and captured event value.
note: Stock 00008d92 bit 5 bypasses the model-byte comparison, so this byte affects only captured P010B event context in the unmodified image.

semantics: Base of the two-byte bank-indexed MAF range-performance model array. FUN 00082604 writes ffff15bc for P0101 and ffff15bd for P010B; each bank monitor can compare its byte with ffff12eb/ffff12ec and captures it in event context.
note: The exact monitor identity is proven. The complete engineering conversion of the model byte remains unresolved.

semantics: Shared scratch byte containing the RPM-dependent factor from table 0001236a. Both P0101/P010B monitors overwrite it and consume it immediately in the same three-factor composition.
note: A whole-program RAM census found no reader outside the two monitor functions.

semantics: Shared scratch byte min(255, floor(M*A*B/16384)) in the P0101/P010B range-performance composition, where M comes from 0001236a and A/B from 00012ac2/00012868.
note: A whole-program RAM census found no reader outside the two monitor functions.

semantics: Captured first-bank P0101 event-context copy of composite diagnostic byte ffff12eb.
note: This is the stock terminal consumer of the 0001236a-dependent first-bank value.

semantics: Captured second-bank P010B event-context copy of composite diagnostic byte ffff12ec.
note: This is the stock terminal consumer of the 0001236a-dependent second-bank value.

semantics: Previous bank-1 exhaust-VTC duty word. FUN 000c2040 copies ffff1aac here at window offset 0x828 of base ffff128c before recomputing the current word, and reads it back as the rate-limit reference.
note: The array shares the four-slot geometry of ffff1aac and uses the same two bank indexes.

semantics: Previous bank-2 exhaust-VTC duty word. It is the bank-indexed companion of ffff1ab4 in the same four-slot array.
note: Slots 3 and 4 of this array are unused for the same reason as ffff1ab0 and ffff1ab2.

semantics: First cell of the two-cell intake-VTC solenoid duty command. FUN 000beace reads it at offset 0x84 of base ffff2330 and programs ATU-II channel-7 buffer register fffff592 with raw*ROM8[00008dfc]*39/80.
note: Cycle register fffff58a holds 125*ROM8[00008dfc], so percent = raw*39/100 and full scale 255 is 99.45 percent. No statically resolvable store writes this cell; its producer reaches it through a base that constant propagation does not recover.

semantics: Second cell of the two-cell intake-VTC solenoid duty command. FUN 000beace reads it at offset 0x85 of base ffff2330 and programs ATU-II channel-7 buffer register fffff590 with the same conversion.
note: Bank order follows the adjacent-pair convention of ffff2442/ffff2443; it is not established by a diagnostic identity.

semantics: First cell of the two-cell intake-VTC duty monitor pair. FUN 000bdee4 reads it at offset 0x84 of base ffff23bc and requires both cells to be zero while intake target ffff2326 is neutral 0x80 before it lets delay counter ffff2534 expire and set bit 5 of ffff246b.
note: CAN telemetry schema 2 streams the pair as CVTC duty B1 and B2. Its observed 0..78.5 percent range under the ffff23b4 conversion matches the intake command; the two pairs are not proven identical by code.

semantics: Second cell of the two-cell intake-VTC duty monitor pair, read by the same cam-at-rest condition in FUN 000bdee4.
note: Both cells must be zero for the condition, so the check confirms that no intake bank is commanded rather than testing one bank.

semantics: CYLR7A, the ATU-II channel-7A cycle register. FUN 000cd75c programs it with 125*ROM8[00008dfc] as the intake-VTC PWM period.
note: Register identity comes from the SH7058S hardware manual channel-7 register list.

semantics: CYLR7B, the ATU-II channel-7B cycle register, programmed with the same intake-VTC PWM period as CYLR7A.
note: Register identity comes from the SH7058S hardware manual channel-7 register list.

semantics: CYLR7C, the ATU-II channel-7C cycle register. FUN 000cd75c programs it with 125*ROM8[00008dfd] as the exhaust-VTC PWM period; FUN 000c2152 reprograms it on the alternate path.
note: Register identity comes from the SH7058S hardware manual channel-7 register list.

semantics: CYLR7D, the ATU-II channel-7D cycle register, programmed with the same exhaust-VTC PWM period as CYLR7C.
note: Register identity comes from the SH7058S hardware manual channel-7 register list.

semantics: BFR7A, the ATU-II channel-7A buffer register that carries the intake-VTC duty into DTR7A at the cycle boundary. FUN 000beace writes the converted value of ffff23b5, or fixed 1238 counts on the hardware-control path.
note: Fixed 1238 counts is 30 percent of cycle register fffff588.

semantics: BFR7B, the ATU-II channel-7B buffer register for the second intake-VTC output. FUN 000beace writes the converted value of ffff23b4, or fixed 825 counts on the hardware-control path.
note: Fixed 825 counts is 20 percent of cycle register fffff58a. The fixed values apply only while saturated engine-speed byte ffff11ea is positive; otherwise both channels are driven to zero.

semantics: BFR7C, the ATU-II channel-7C buffer register that carries the exhaust-VTC duty into DTR7C. FUN 000c2152 writes the converted value of ffff1aae.
note: Register identity comes from the SH7058S hardware manual channel-7 register list.

semantics: BFR7D, the ATU-II channel-7D buffer register for the first exhaust-VTC output. FUN 000c2152 writes the converted value of ffff1aac.
note: Register identity comes from the SH7058S hardware manual channel-7 register list.

semantics: Ramped commanded-mixture word of stage 0005594a, Q14, addressed as ffff120e + 0x2c. With ffff84c3 bit 7 set the stage forms a down step of ROM8[0000849b] * 8 = 304 toward 0x4000 and an up step of ROM8[0000849c] * 8 = 384 toward ffff15eb << 7 from previous-pass snapshot ffff1278, with kick-off ROM8[00008b9c] << 7 = 0x4100 and floor ROM16[0000929c] = 0x4000 on band entry. State byte ffff1410 selects the branch: 1 writes 0x4000, 4 and 5 write the target directly, 2, 3, and 6 ramp until ffff2485 bit 5 reports the target reached. The result is capped at ffff15eb << 7 and ffff2485 bit 5 = (word == ffff15eb << 7). Scheduler 00020dfe copies it to ffff1278.

Scheduler snapshot of ramped commanded-mixture word ffff123a. FUN 00020dfe copies the 0x3e-byte block ffff120e..ffff124b to ffff124c..ffff1289 every pass, so 0005594a reads the previous-pass value here, as ffff124c + 0x2c, as the ramp origin.

Second commanded-mixture word of 0005651c, Q14, addressed as ffff120e + 0x2e. Gates ffff2474 bit 7 (load ffff102c >= ffff12e7) and ffff2493 bit 2 (vehicle speed ffff110e <= ROM8[000087d9]) select a ramp from snapshot ffff127a toward ROM16[00008f86] = 0x4000 with the same ROM8[0000849b]/ROM8[0000849c] steps as ffff123a. Stock constants keep the word at 0x4000, so max(ffff123a, ffff123c) in 0005594a always returns ffff123a.
Scheduler snapshot of second commanded-mixture word ffff123c through the 0x3e-byte block copy ffff120e -> ffff124c in FUN 00020dfe; 0005651c reads it as the ramp origin.
Load threshold byte of 0005651c: output of implicit map 00011ede on ffff11b3, flat 254 in stock, compared with ffff102c to form ffff2474 bit 7.

Commanded-mixture request byte of stage 0005594a: 8 while the warm gate ffff24a4 bit 5 is clear (coolant ffff1071 with 3-count hysteresis below ROM8[00008cf8] = 115), 1 when target byte ffff15eb equals 128, otherwise 2..7 from the engine-speed band flags of ffff2493 (ffff11ae against ROM8[000087d4] = 44 and ROM8[000087d3] = 72, i.e. 2200 and 3600 rpm, with 4-count hysteresis and the ROM8[000087d7]/ROM8[000087d8] pair), wide-open latch ffff2468 bit 3, and ffff2485 bit 6 (ffff10be >= ROM8[000087d5] = 254).

Commanded-mixture ramp state byte 1..6 of stage 0005594a, derived from request byte ffff1411 through per-state pass counters, and the branch selector for ramped word ffff123a: 1 holds 0x4000, 4 and 5 write the target directly, 2, 3, and 6 ramp.

Stoichiometric hold countdown of stage 0005594a: reloaded with ROM8[000087d6] = 2 while engine-speed byte ffff2700 < 32 (400 rpm), decremented once per pass otherwise; while nonzero the commanded mixture ffff22e8 is forced to 0x4000. Initialization path 000593ac also writes it.

Flat 200 output of implicit map 0001214e on ffff11b3 (rpm/25), written by 0005594a and compared in the same pass with throttle-opening byte ffff3528 for wide-open latch ffff2468 bit 3. No external reader.

Throttle-opening byte written by 00054eb8 as min(255, uint16 ffff40c6 * 0x505b >> 16), the common opening-coordinate monitor scaled by 0.3139; one count is about 0.35 degrees of throttle valve opening under the candidate 0.0275-degree scale of axis 000155a0. Stage 0005594a compares it with the flat 200 of map 0001214e, about 70 degrees, for wide-open latch ffff2468 bit 3; 00052f00 also reads it.
note: The degree figures inherit the candidate status of the 000155a0 scale; the code chain ffff40c6 -> ffff3528 -> ffff2468 bit 3 is exact.

semantics: Interval-derived engine-speed byte. FUN 0003df2c divides 41666 by interval quotient ffff22bc through signed divider 00021bbc, saturates the quotient to 255, keeps the last three results in ffff3e34..ffff3e36, and publishes their median; when diagnostic-mode snapshot ffff24c9 bit 5 is set it copies saturated engine-speed byte ffff11ea instead. The substitute fixes the representation as rpm/12.5; the dividend corresponds to 120-degree crank events on a 3.2 us timer tick. Scheduler 00020dfe copies it to ffff2700.
note: The rpm/12.5 representation is code through the ffff11ea substitute; the timer tick and event angle are the consistent candidate.

semantics: Scheduler snapshot of interval-derived engine-speed byte ffff2804 (rpm/12.5): the 0x104-byte FUN 00022558 call in 00020dfe copies ffff277e..ffff2881 to ffff267a..ffff277d. Stage 0005594a forces commanded mixture ffff22e8 to 0x4000 and reloads countdown ffff2531 while the byte is below 32 (400 rpm); 0008152a, 00081d74, 00098e48, and 000990c4 also read it.
Newest of the three interval-derived engine-speed samples ffff3e34..ffff3e36 shifted by FUN 0003df2c before each new quotient; the median of the three is published as ffff2804.

Bank-1 exhaust-VTC control-mode byte at window offset 0x890 of base ffff128c. FUN 000c1dec moves it between 0 (off), 1 (active), and 2 (ramp-down) under ffff248b bits 0/2 and bit 0 of ffff1246; FUN 000c2040 selects the duty output by it. Mode 2 returns to 0 when published duty word ffff1aac reaches zero or ffff248b bit 0 clears.
note: Mode 0 forces controller state ffff1aa4 to zero; mode 2 ramps the published duty word down by ROM8[00008de1]/256 of the previous word per pass.

semantics: Bank-2 exhaust-VTC control-mode byte at window offset 0x891 of base ffff128c. FUN 000c1dec moves it between 0, 1, and 2 under ffff248b bits 0/2 and bit 1 of ffff1246; FUN 000c2040 selects the duty output by it.
note: Same transition table as ffff1b1c with the bank-2 duty word ffff1aae and enable bit 1.

semantics: Exhaust-VTC bank-enable byte, bits 0 and 1 for banks 1 and 2. FUN 000bfe88 ORs both bits in at 000c0604 while demand flag ffff24a7 bit 3 is set, and clears them at 000c08a6 and 000c0906 after the release counters ffff1951/ffff1952 reach ROM8[00008cbc] and common counter ffff1953 exceeds ROM8[00008cc1]. FUN 000c1152 updates the error word only for an enabled bank, FUN 000c1dec requires the bank bit for mode 1, and FUN 000c2040 holds the request while the bit is set in mode 2.
note: On each clear, a set bit of ffff1284 together with engine speed ffff11ae inside ROM8[00008e15]..ROM8[00008e14] also sets the bank bit of ffff1c7e.

semantics: Previous-pass snapshot of exhaust-VTC bank-enable byte ffff1246. Scheduler 00020dfe copies it through the 0x3e-byte block ffff120e..ffff124b -> ffff124c..ffff1289 at 00020f7c, so bits 0 and 1 hold the enable state of the previous scheduler pass. FUN 000bfe88 reads them as the ffff1c7e arming condition, FUN 000c1152 at 000c1320, and FUN 000c2040 at 000c20b2 as the condition for copying ffff1aac+2b to ffff1ab4+2b while the bank is disabled, which selects the pass on which the enable bit falls.
note: The copy length 0x3e is the delay-slot immediate of the 00022558 call at 00020f7c and the destination base ffff124c is the pool word at 00021164.

semantics: Coolant-selected exhaust-VTC target byte before conditioning. FUN 000bfe88 writes it at 000c055c from the cold/fallback and warm/main bytes ffff1c5f and ffff1c5d and compares it with ROM8[00008dcb]+128 to form demand flag ffff24a7 bit 3. Initializer FUN 000bced0 writes its reset value.
note: Stock entry threshold is 142 counts, with hysteresis 2 while the demand flag is set. The slew stage at 000c045a..000c04b4 bounds the increase of the conditioned byte over the previous ffff1c90 to ROM8[0000830a]=4 times ffff11c0 while ffff2482 bit 1 marks a byte at or above previous-pass value ffff125a, and to ROM8[000084f3]=20 times ffff11c0 otherwise; the step is stored to ffff1995. Captured override ramps of 4 counts per tick correspond to ffff11c0=1.

semantics: Bank-1 exhaust-VTC release counter. FUN 000bfe88 increments it with saturation while ffff1ad9 bit 0 is armed, zeroes it when actual position ffff2324 reaches ROM8[00008de6]+128, and requires it to reach ROM8[00008cbc] before clearing enable bit 0 of ffff1246.

Bank-2 exhaust-VTC release counter. FUN 000bfe88 increments it with saturation while ffff1ad9 bit 1 is armed, zeroes it when actual position ffff2325 reaches ROM8[00008de6]+128, and requires it to reach ROM8[00008cbc] before clearing enable bit 1 of ffff1246.

Common exhaust-VTC release counter. FUN 000bfe88 increments it with saturation while any bit of ffff1246 is set and demand flag ffff24a7 bit 3 is clear, clears the bank-enable bits once it exceeds ROM8[00008cc1], and zeroes it at 000c0920 after both bank counters reach ROM8[00008cbc].

Bank-1 exhaust-VTC error word at window offset 0x88c of base ffff128c. FUN 000c1152 writes it at 000c1dac as the 0..65535 clamp of saturating sum 000265c4, only while bit 0 of ffff1246 is set. FUN 000c1dec multiplies it by ROM16[00009212] on the stock ROM8[00008615] bit-3 branch.
note: The bank-2 word ffff1b1a shares the writer and the reader with coefficient ROM16[00009214].

semantics: Bank-2 exhaust-VTC error word at window offset 0x88e of base ffff128c. FUN 000c1152 writes it at 000c1dac with bank index 1 as the 0..65535 clamp of saturating sum 000265c4, only while bit 1 of ffff1246 is set. FUN 000c1dec multiplies it by ROM16[00009214] on the stock ROM8[00008615] bit-3 branch.

Bank-1 exhaust-VTC controller state longword at window offset 0x818 of base ffff128c. FUN 000c1dec stores it at 000c1ff4 as zero in mode 0 or as the gain-scaled, 0..0x04000000 clamped error product; FUN 000c2040 reads it at 000c205e and divides the upper bytes by battery byte ffff1108 to form duty request ffff1c70.
note: Stock branch: P = floor(floor(u16[ffff1b18]*0x22a2)*gain*2/625) with gain from curve 0001205a.

semantics: Bank-2 exhaust-VTC controller state longword at window offset 0x81c of base ffff128c. FUN 000c1dec stores it at 000c1ff4 with bank index 1; FUN 000c2040 reads it at 000c205e to form duty request ffff1c72.
note: Same arithmetic as ffff1aa4 with the bank-2 error word ffff1b1a and coefficient ROM16[00009214].

semantics: Exhaust-VTC gain byte. FUN 000c1dec writes it at 000c1ee2 as curve 0001205a over axis 00012850 at coordinate ffff2772 through byte wrapper 00026474, and multiplies the controller state by it. Initializer FUN 000bced0 writes its reset value.
note: Stock curve rises from 102 to 128 across the axis.

semantics: Previous-pass snapshot of engine-oil-temperature byte ffff2876, the DID 0x111f source. Scheduler 00020dfe copies it through the 0x104-byte block ffff277e..ffff2881 -> ffff267a..ffff277d at 00020fcc. FUN 000c1dec reads it at 000c1ece as the coordinate of exhaust-VTC gain curve 0001205a over axis 00012850, enable coordinator 000bf630 forms hysteresis flag ffff246c bit 3 from it against ROM8[00008dff]=110 at 000bf73e, and FUN 000bfe88 with eleven further functions read it. With ROM8[00008616] bit 0 set, as in stock JK08A, FUN 0003eb84 publishes the converted oil-temperature sample in ffff2876, so the coordinate follows the engine oil temperature and the gain is 102 up to raw 100 (50 degC) and 128 from raw 135 (85 degC).
note: Readers: 000658a4, 00099efe, 0009a0d4, 000bd20a, 000bdb66, 000bdc66, 000be32a, 000be5bc, 000be8f8, 000bec52, 000befb0, 000bf630, 000bfe88, 000c1dec. The representation follows ffff2876: deg C = raw-50, established by code on that row.

semantics: Bank-1 exhaust-VTC duty request word at window offset 0x9e4 of base ffff128c. FUN 000c2040 writes it at 000c20ae as the battery-compensated conversion of controller state ffff1aa4, capped at 1024, and continues with the register copy; no reader of the cell is established.
Bank-2 exhaust-VTC duty request word at window offset 0x9e6 of base ffff128c. FUN 000c2040 writes it at 000c20ae with bank index 1 from controller state ffff1aa8.

Bank-1 exhaust-cam tracking gap byte. FUN 0008f168 writes clamp_u8(ffff2327-ffff2324+128) at 0008f496; FUN 000904c2 compares it with 128-ROM8[0000894f]..128+ROM8[0000894d] to latch the P0014 pass bit or set the pending-fault bit. Initializer FUN 0007f30c writes its reset value.

Bank-2 exhaust-cam tracking gap byte. FUN 0008f168 writes clamp_u8(ffff2327-ffff2325+128) at 0008f4bc; FUN 000904c2 reads it with bank index 1 for the P0024 target-tracking judgement. Initializer FUN 0007f30c writes its reset value.

Bank-1 exhaust-VTC rest-position byte. FUN 0008f168 writes clamp_u8(ffff11c8-ROM8[0000831d]+128) at 0008f4ec; FUN 00090256 compares it with 128-ROM8[00008952]..128+ROM8[00008951] while the common target ffff2327 is neutral 0x80 and sets the P0014 result bit outside the window. Initializer FUN 0007f30c writes its reset value.
note: Source byte ffff11c8 has no direct writer in the export; its physical meaning is unresolved.

semantics: Bank-2 exhaust-VTC rest-position byte. FUN 0008f168 writes clamp_u8(ffff11c9-ROM8[0000831e]+128) at 0008f524; FUN 00090256 reads it with bank index 1 for the P0024 rest-position judgement. Initializer FUN 0007f30c writes its reset value.
note: Source byte ffff11c9 has no direct writer in the export; its physical meaning is unresolved.

semantics: Exhaust-VTC evaluation window byte. FUN 0008f168 writes it at 0008f57a as the staircase lookup ROM8[0000988a+8*row+col], where row counts axis 000119f8 points at or below engine-speed byte ffff11ae and col counts axis 00011a08 points at or below coolant byte ffff1071. A non-zero value is a prerequisite of the target-tracking enable.
note: All 64 stock cells of the 8x8 block 0000988a..000098c9 hold 60.

semantics: Exhaust-target change byte. FUN 0008f168 writes abs(ffff2327-ffff232d) at 0008f58e, where ffff232d is the retained copy of the common target. A value above ROM8[00008e43] extends the evaluation window ffff13a8, blocks the target-tracking enable, and zeroes sample counter ffff1998 in FUN 000904c2.

Effective exhaust-VTC evaluation window. FUN 0008f168 writes it at 0008f5aa as max(ffff13a8, ffff1413) while ffff1994 exceeds ROM8[00008e43] and as ffff1413 otherwise; FUN 000904c2 judges P0014/P0024 target tracking once sample counter ffff1998 exceeds it.

Bank-1 exhaust-VTC target-tracking sample counter, bank 2 at ffff1999. FUN 000904c2 increments it with saturation while ffff84c3 bit 7 is set, zeroes it while ffff1994 exceeds ROM8[00008e43], and judges the bank once it exceeds window ffff13a8. FUN 0008f168 zeroes it at 0008f5ca and reset helper FUN 0008fc6a clears it.
note: The meaning of ffff84c3 bit 7 as the sample condition is unresolved.

semantics: Exhaust-VTC neutral-target timer. FUN 0008f168 reloads it with ROM8[00008e40] at 0008f39e while it is non-zero and ffff4184 bit 7 is clear or common target ffff2327 equals 0x80; FUN 00090256 evaluates rest position only while it is zero, and the target-tracking enable also requires zero. Initializer FUN 0007ebec and reset helper FUN 0008fc6a write it.

Exhaust-VTC active-target timer. FUN 0008f168 reloads it with ROM8[00008e40] at 0008f428 while it is non-zero and ffff24aa bit 4 is clear or common target ffff2327 differs from 0x80; FUN 00090256 reads it at 000902aa. Initializer FUN 0007ebec and reset helper FUN 0008fc6a write it.

Judged latch of exhaust-VTC position sensor path A, bits 0 and 1 for descriptor indices 0x84 and 0x85 (P1078, P1084). FUN 00090086 sets the bank bit after its debounce of driver status ffff850c; FUN 0008f168 enables the helper only while the bit is clear and enable mask ROM8[000186f1] bit 7 or 6 is set, and calls dispatcher 0007d8b8 with the index while the bit is set. Reset helper FUN 0008fc6a clears it.

Judged latch of exhaust-VTC position sensor path B, bits 0 and 1 for descriptor indices 0x86 and 0x87 (P1078, P1084). FUN 0009018c sets the bank bit; FUN 0008f168 enables the helper only while the bit is clear and enable mask ROM8[000186f1] bit 5 or 4 is set, and calls dispatcher 0007d8b8 with the index while the bit is set. Reset helper FUN 0008fc6a clears it.

Judged latch of the P0014/P0024 rest-position pair, bits 0 and 1 for descriptor indices 0xd2 and 0xd3. FUN 00090256 sets the bank bit at 0009035c once the ffff43b6+b timer has expired; FUN 0008f168 enables the helper only while the bit is clear and ROM8[000186ff] bit 1 or 0 is set, and calls dispatcher 0007d8b8 with the index while the bit is set. Reset helper FUN 0008fc6a clears it.

Result bits of the P0014/P0024 rest-position pair. FUN 00090256 sets the bank bit at 00090340 when rest-position byte ffff16ba+b is outside 128-ROM8[00008952]..128+ROM8[00008951] and the ffff43c0+b timer has expired; FUN 0008f168 sets the stored fault of index 0xd2 or 0xd3 through 0008c2d2 while the bit is set and clears it through 0008c348 otherwise.

Judged latch of the P0014/P0024 target-tracking pair, bits 0 and 1 for descriptor indices 0xd2 and 0xd3. FUN 000904c2 sets the bank bit at 00090606 when the evaluation window ends with a pending gap fault and no latched pass; FUN 0008f168 enables the helper only while the bit is clear and ROM8[000186ff] bit 1 or 0 is set, and calls dispatcher 0007d8b8 with the index while the bit is set. Reset helper FUN 0008fc6a clears it.

Result bits of the P0014/P0024 target-tracking pair. FUN 000904c2 sets the bank bit at 000905fc together with ffff3583; FUN 0008f168 sets the stored fault of index 0xd2 or 0xd3 through 0008c2d2 while the bit is set and clears it through 0008c348 otherwise. A latched pass instead clears the stored fault directly from FUN 000904c2.

Judged latch of the P0078/P0084 magnet retarder circuit pair, bits 0 and 1 for descriptor indices 0x43 and 0x44. FUN 00090642 returns without judging while the bit is set or the published duty word ffff1aac+2b is zero; FUN 0008f168 calls dispatcher 0007d8b8 with the index while the bit is set. Reset helper FUN 0008fc6a clears it.
Result bits of the P0078/P0084 magnet retarder circuit pair. FUN 00090642 sets the bank bit; FUN 0008f168 sets the stored fault of index 0x43 or 0x44 through 0008c2d2 while the bit is set.

Bank-1 previous-pass snapshot of exhaust-cam edge phase byte ffff1200. Scheduler 00020dfe copies it through the 0x38-byte block ffff11d4..ffff120b -> ffff119c..ffff11d3 at 00020f6c. Monitor 0008f168 forms rest-position byte ffff16ba = clamp_u8(ffff11c8 - ROM8[0000831d] + 128) from it at 0008f4ec, FUN 000bfc2e reads it per bank at 000bfc78, FUN 00090bd2 at 00090c36, and FUN 000bfad4 and FUN 00090884 read it directly. FUN 000bfad4 forms rest-edge deviation ffff1376 = 128 + clamp(ROM8[0000831d] - ffff11c8, -40..40) from it at 000bfb4a and learns rest edge ffff479b from that, and FUN 000bfc2e forms deviation d0 = clamp_u8(ffff11c8 - ffff479b + 128) at 000bfcaa.
note: One unit is 0.5 crank degrees: 000c2d76 forms the byte as 20*segment + 20*interval/ffff22bc, where ffff22bc is 10 crank degrees. The bank assignment follows monitor index 0, which routes to descriptor 0xd2 (P0014, bank 1).

semantics: Bank-2 previous-pass snapshot of exhaust-cam edge phase byte ffff1201, copied by scheduler 00020dfe in the same 0x38-byte block as ffff11c8. Monitor 0008f168 forms rest-position byte ffff16bb = clamp_u8(ffff11c9 - ROM8[0000831e] + 128) from it at 0008f524; FUN 000bfc2e, FUN 00090bd2, FUN 000bfad4, and FUN 00090884 read it through the same bank-indexed paths. FUN 000bfad4 forms rest-edge deviation ffff1377 from it at 000bfb98, and FUN 000bfc2e forms its deviation from learned rest edge ffff479c at the channel-indexed site 000bfcaa.
note: The bank assignment follows monitor index 1 and descriptor 0xd3 (P0024). One unit is 0.5 crank degrees.

semantics: Bank-1 exhaust-cam edge phase byte. IMI4D capture handler 000c2d76 (continuation body 000c2de0) writes it at 000c2e60 as 20*segment + floor(20*interval / ffff22bc) through signed divider 00021bbc, where segment maps event selector ffff13b2 (values above 7 minus 5, 7 to 0, lower values plus 5) and interval is the 16-bit difference between capture GR4D and crank reference count ffff158a. The update runs only while cylinder index ffff11de is 1, 3, or 5 and driver status ffff850c bit 5 is clear, after shifting the previous values into ffff1202 and ffff1204. Scheduler 00020dfe copies the byte to ffff11c8.
note: Ghidra lists the handler as 000c2d76 and 000c2de0 because the segment-index branch splits the body; the interval is also stored as a word at ffff1a80 and the segment at ffff16f2, both reached through window base ffff128c. The phase is a crank-relative timing of the cam sensor edge in 0.5-degree units (ffff22bc is 10 crank degrees), and the stock rest value ROM8[0000831d]=88 places the calibrated rest edge 44 crank degrees after the event origin, 8 units into segment 4.

semantics: Bank-2 exhaust-cam edge phase byte. IMI4C capture handler 000c2c58 writes it at 000c2d2c as 20*segment + floor(20*interval / ffff22bc) through signed divider 00021bbc, with the same segment mapping of ffff13b2 as bank 1 and interval as the 16-bit difference between capture GR4C and crank reference count ffff158a. The update runs only while cylinder index ffff11de is 2, 4, or 6 and driver status ffff850c bit 6 is clear, after shifting the previous values into ffff1203 and ffff1205. Scheduler 00020dfe copies the byte to ffff11c9.
note: The interval word is stored at ffff1a82 and the segment at ffff16f2 through window base ffff128c. One unit is 0.5 crank degrees.

semantics: Engine-event cylinder index byte written by 00029588, 0002b768, and 00099a48. IMI4D handler 000c2d76 updates the bank-1 exhaust-cam edge phase ffff1200 only for values 1, 3, and 5, and IMI4C handler 000c2c58 updates the bank-2 phase ffff1201 only for values 2, 4, and 6.
note: The cylinder numbering follows the handlers bank split; its physical firing-order identity is not established here.

semantics: Exhaust-VTC driver status byte maintained by edge-count monitor 000c22dc from engine-event driver 00029588. Bits 5 and 6 are the per-bank edge-count anomaly flags: set while the bank-1 (bank-2) edge count ffff4072 (ffff4073) of the last capture window is zero with arm byte ffff4120 bit 0 (1) set or at least two with arm byte ffff4121 bit 0 (1) set, and cleared on a count of one or while both arm bits are clear. Bits 3 and 1 (bank 1) and 4 and 2 (bank 2) are the ten-window results: set when no-edge counters ffff408c/ffff408d or extra-edge counters ffff408e/ffff408f reach ROM8[00008e21]=10. Bit 7 is the reset request raised by monitors 00090086 and 0009018c when a bank is armed and cleared by 000c22dc at 000c23f6 after it zeroes the counters. Bits 5 and 6 inhibit the bank-1 and bank-2 edge-phase updates in capture handlers 000c2de0 and 000c2c58 and the actual-position update in 000bfc2e, and enable coordinator 000bf630 requires both clear for ffff248b bit 0. Writers in the export are 0000284e, 0008fc6a, 00090086, 0009018c, and 000c22dc.
note: Bank-1 counts are judged while cylinder index ffff11de is 2, 4, or 6 and bank-2 counts while it is 1, 3, or 5, after the corresponding capture window has closed. Monitors 00090086 and 0009018c judge P1078/P1084 from the indicator byte ffff850d rather than from the result bits.

semantics: State byte shared by several writers; enable coordinator 000bf630 owns bits 2 and 3. Bit 2 is the coolant window, set at 000bf864 while ffff24a9 bits 3 and 6 are both set. Bit 3 is the oil-temperature hysteresis flag: oil-temperature snapshot ffff2772, plus 3 while the bit is set, is at least ROM8[00008dff]=110, stored at 000bf758 and 000bf75a. Scheduler 00020dfe copies ffff246a..ffff246c to prior-cycle ffff246d..ffff246f at 0002105a. Bit 1 is the standstill exhaust-override predicate written by FUN 000bfe88 at 000c017e: operational enable ffff248b bit 2, engine-speed window flags ffff24ab bits 0 and 1 (1800..4000 RPM), standstill flag ffff24ac bit 7 (coarse speed ffff110e at or below ROM8[00008e3c]=2), and ffff244f bit 2 all set. While it is set and cancel latch ffff2478 bit 4 is clear, the conditioner replaces the map target with ROM8[00008e36]+128=168 (+20 degCA) at 000c019e..000c01b8 independently of surfaces 0000b33a, 0000b2fa, and 0000ab4a.
note: Other bits are written by 00043aee, 00048400, 00048754, 000556ec, and 000bfe88. Bit 3 sets once the oil temperature reaches raw 110 (60 degC) and is a required term of the operating enable ffff248b bit 2 together with latch ffff248c bit 7 clear.

semantics: Latch byte of enable coordinator 000bf630. Bit 6 sets at 000bf880 on the rising edge of coolant-window bit ffff246c bit 2 against prior-cycle ffff246f while ffff2458 bit 5 is clear, and clears at 000bf884 while that bit is set. Bit 7 sets at 000bf8c6 on the rising edge of oil-temperature flag ffff246c bit 3 against ffff246f bit 3, and clears at 000bf894 while ffff2458 bit 5 and low-speed flag ffff24aa bit 7 are both set. Bit 6 blocks the coolant-window term of ffff248b bit 2, and bit 7 clear is a required term of that bit while ROM8[00008616] bit 0 is set, as in stock JK08A.
note: FUN 000bf630 is the only writer of bits 6 and 7: 0004c4cc and 0004c9d2 write bits 4 and 5, 0004c536 bits 0 to 2, and 0004c6ba bit 3. Bit 6 stays set from the rising edge of the coolant window until ffff2458 bit 5 clears it; that bit is the scheduled copy of ffff2459 bit 5, the CLSD THL POS status of DID 0x1302 bit 0, so the latch releases on the first pass with the accelerator pedal at its idle position.

semantics: Multipurpose state byte written every pass by FUN 0007724c from TCM field ffff3a2e: value 3 sets bits 3 and 4, value 5 sets bits 3 and 5, value 6 sets bits 3 and 6, value 7 sets bits 3 and 7, and every other value clears bits 3..7. FUN 000c4460 recomputes bit 2 from an independent status bit. Scheduler FUN 00020dfe latches the byte into ffff418f.
note: FUN 0007724c is the first call of FUN 00079de4 (pointer 00079e18), entry 58 of the 69-entry table at 00021834 that dispatcher 000209d8 drains on ffff84b9 bit 4. Reader FUN 0002e0d4 is independent.

semantics: TCM status field from CAN 0x174: payload byte 4 shifted right by five (bits 5..7), published by decoder FUN 000c47ea. Invalid-message fallback FUN 000c5cb2 writes zero. Sole consumer FUN 0007724c maps values 3, 5, 6 and 7 to bits of ffff419b.
note: The meaning of the three-bit field is not established; captured shift sequences record byte 3 only, so the values the TCM transmits in byte 4 remain a live-capture question.

semantics: Engine-speed word RPM*5.12. FUN 00038272, reached from 00038260, stores floor(32000000 / ffff11fc) at 0003829c through unsigned divider 00021ce0 from the 3.2 us event interval; FUN 000384fe forms RPM/50 byte ffff11e6 as min(255, ffff1196 >> 8), which scheduler 00020dfe copies to ffff11ae.
note: The constant 32000000 = 6250000 * 5.12 binds the 3.2 us count (312500 counts per second, three events per revolution) to 5.12 units per RPM. The on-car CAN engine speed confirms ffff11e6 = RPM/50.

semantics: Exhaust-VTC active-test offset. FUN 0002e466 stores clamp(int8(ffff9940), ROM8[0000873e]=-20..ROM8[0000873f]=20) at 0002e612 while it sets request bit ffff249c bit 6; FUN 000bfe88 reads it at 000c04da while the bit is set and adds it to the exhaust target.
note: ffff9940 is the value byte of service-0x30 Output Control IOLID 0x1d (ffff9923 + n in handler 00030c4c). The unit of the offset follows the exhaust target byte.

semantics: Active-test state of the VTC channel enabled by ffff248b bit 1. FUN 0002e466 writes bit 4 at 0002e50a as ffff248b bit 1 and ffff244f bit 1 set with vehicle-speed byte ffff110e at most ROM8[000089f1]=2 and raw coolant ffff1071 in ROM8[000089f3]=110..ROM8[000089f2]=170, and bit 0 at 0002e522 as service-0x30 IOLID 0x19 active flag ffff99c7 bit 0 together with bit 4, storing offset ffff1704 = clamp(int8(ffff993c), ROM8[0000873e]=-20..ROM8[0000873f]=20) at 0002e54c.
note: The second bank of the same channel is ffff41fb bit 7 from IOLID 0x1a with offset ffff1705 (0002e576, 0002e59e). The consumers of the bits are outside the exhaust-VTC review.

semantics: Active-flag byte of service-0x30 Output Control IOLIDs 0x19..0x20 (array ffff99c4, bit n-1 of IOLID n): bit 0 is IOLID 0x19, bit 1 IOLID 0x1a, and bit 4 IOLID 0x1d. Handler 00030c4c maintains the array, FUN 0002e466 reads the byte at 0002e50e for the VTC active tests, and startup 0002e76e zeroes ffff99c4..ffff99d3.
note: The value bytes of the same requests are ffff9923 + n (ffff993c, ffff993d, ffff9940 for IOLIDs 0x19, 0x1a, 0x1d).

semantics: Value byte of service-0x30 Output Control IOLID 0x1d (ffff9923 + n), written by handler 00030c4c. FUN 0002e466 reads it at 0002e5f0 as the requested exhaust-cam offset and stores its clamp in ffff1706.
note: Startup 0002e76e zeroes ffff9924..ffff99a3.

semantics: Scheduler tick-flag byte. Base-tick handler 0002040c ORs 0x80 into it at 00020734 every 1.024 ms; scheduler 00020dfe copies it to ffff84c3 at 00020ee6 (load at 00020ee0) and reloads it from ffff84bb at 00020ef0.
Reload source of tick-flag byte ffff84c4: scheduler 00020dfe loads it at 00020eec and stores it into ffff84c4 at 00020ef0. The export holds only reads of the byte (000209d8, 00020dfe).
note: With no writer in the export the byte holds its initialization value, so ffff84c3 carries bit 7 from the base tick on every pass.

semantics: Bank-1 exhaust-cam edge count of the current capture window. IMI4D handler 000c2de0 increments it with saturation at 000c2e8e while arm byte ffff4120 bit 0 or ffff4121 bit 0 is set; edge-count monitor 000c22dc judges it while cylinder index ffff11de is 2, 4, or 6 (one edge is normal, zero or two or more raise ffff850c bit 5) and zeroes it at 000c24aa outside that window and at 000c2374 on reset request.

Bank-2 exhaust-cam edge count of the current capture window. IMI4C handler 000c2c58 increments it with saturation at 000c2d5a while arm byte ffff4120 bit 1 or ffff4121 bit 1 is set; edge-count monitor 000c22dc judges it while cylinder index ffff11de is 1, 3, or 5 (one edge is normal, zero or two or more raise ffff850c bit 6) and zeroes it at 000c28ce outside that window and at 000c23f0 on reset request.

Bank-1 no-edge window counter of edge-count monitor 000c22dc: incremented with saturation while the bank-1 edge count ffff4072 is zero with arm byte ffff4120 bit 0 set; at ROM8[00008e21]=10 the monitor sets result bit ffff850c bit 3. Zeroed on reset request unless the result bit is set.

Bank-1 extra-edge window counter of edge-count monitor 000c22dc: incremented with saturation while the bank-1 edge count ffff4072 is two or more with arm byte ffff4121 bit 0 set; at ROM8[00008e21]=10 the monitor sets result bit ffff850c bit 1. Zeroed on reset request unless the result bit is set.

Bank-2 no-edge window counter of edge-count monitor 000c22dc: incremented with saturation while the bank-2 edge count ffff4073 is zero with arm byte ffff4120 bit 1 set; at ROM8[00008e21]=10 the monitor sets result bit ffff850c bit 4. Zeroed on reset request unless the result bit is set.

Bank-2 extra-edge window counter of edge-count monitor 000c22dc: incremented with saturation while the bank-2 edge count ffff4073 is two or more with arm byte ffff4121 bit 1 set; at ROM8[00008e21]=10 the monitor sets result bit ffff850c bit 2. Zeroed on reset request unless the result bit is set.

Exhaust-cam edge-count indicator byte of 000c22dc: bit 6 (bank 1) and bit 7 (bank 2) mark a capture window with no edge, bit 4 and bit 5 a window with two or more edges. The monitor sets them together with ffff850c bits 5 and 6 and clears them on a normal window or reset request (000c231c, 000c2344, 000c239c, 000c23c4). Monitors 00090086 and 0009018c read bits 6/7 and 4/5 to reload or run down timer ffff43be + b and judge P1078/P1084.

Scheduler copy of path-A arm byte ffff4178 (block ffff4124..ffff417b -> ffff40cc..ffff4123 at 0002132c). Capture handlers 000c2de0 and 000c2c58 count edges while bit 0 or 1 of it or of ffff4121 is set, and edge-count monitor 000c22dc reads bit 0 at 000c23fc and bit 1 as the no-edge arm of banks 1 and 2.

Scheduler copy of path-B arm byte ffff4179 (block ffff4124..ffff417b -> ffff40cc..ffff4123 at 0002132c). Capture handlers 000c2de0 and 000c2c58 count edges while bit 0 or 1 of it or of ffff4120 is set, and edge-count monitor 000c22dc reads bit 0 at 000c2406 and bit 1 as the extra-edge arm of banks 1 and 2.

Path-A (no-edge) arm byte of the exhaust-cam edge-count monitor, bit b for bank b. FUN 00090086 sets the bit at 000900d2 or 000900f4 while its enable is set and clears it at 00090168 (enable clear) or 00090182 (judged latch ffff3580 set); reset helper 0008fc6a clears the byte. Scheduler 00020dfe copies it to ffff4120 at 0002132c.

Path-B (extra-edge) arm byte of the exhaust-cam edge-count monitor, bit b for bank b. FUN 0009018c sets or clears the bit at 000901d8, 000901fa, 0009022c, and 00090246 by the same rules as 00090086 for ffff4178; reset helper 0008fc6a clears the byte. Scheduler 00020dfe copies it to ffff4121 at 0002132c.

Bank-1 learned rest edge of the exhaust cam. FUN 000bfad4 stores clamp_u8(ROM8[0000831d] - ffff1376 + 128) at 000bfbf8, which equals edge-phase snapshot ffff11c8 within the +/-40 band, when ffff2495 bit 3 is clear, ffff24a8 bits 7 and 4 are set, and ffff246b bit 4 has just fallen or is set with ffff2535 zero; it sets ffff2475 bit 1 at 000bfc20 with the store. FUN 000bfc2e subtracts it from the three edge-phase snapshots at 000bfcaa, 000bfcd6, and 000bfd02 to form actual-position byte ffff2324.
note: One unit is 0.5 crank degrees. The on-car value with the cam at its stop is a RAM read that is not recorded.

semantics: Bank-2 learned rest edge of the exhaust cam. FUN 000bfad4 stores clamp_u8(ROM8[0000831e] - ffff1377 + 128) at 000bfc1c under the same gate as ffff479b, and FUN 000bfc2e subtracts it from the bank-2 edge-phase snapshots through the channel-indexed sites to form actual-position byte ffff2325.
note: One unit is 0.5 crank degrees.

semantics: Bank-1 rest-edge deviation 128 + clamp(ROM8[0000831d]=88 - ffff11c8, -ROM8[00008834]..+ROM8[00008834]) formed by FUN 000bfad4 at 000bfb4a while ffff246b bit 4 is set; a deviation at the bound sets ffff2495 bit 3 at 000bfb2a. FUN 000bced0 initializes it to 0x80 at 000bcfb6.

Bank-2 rest-edge deviation 128 + clamp(ROM8[0000831e]=88 - ffff11c9, -ROM8[00008834]..+ROM8[00008834]) formed by FUN 000bfad4 at 000bfb98 while ffff246b bit 4 is set, with the same bound flag as ffff1376. FUN 000bced0 initializes it to 0x80 at 000bd04a.

Request byte of memory task 000cd85c. Handler 000306f8 of manufacturer diagnostic service 0xa0 (dispatched by 0002f928 at 0002fa78) copies an accepted request code from ffff8005 into it (000309ca for codes 1, 2, and 3) and sets pending flag ffff41de bit 0 at 000309d6; scheduler task 0002e8d2 passes the byte to 000cd85c at 0002e8f4 while the flag is set, the task resets it to zero after a pass (000cdb1e, 000cdb7e, 000cdbca, 000cdd16), and initialization path 0002e81a zeroes it at 0002e890. Request 1 runs the ROM sum, request 2 the compare, and request 3 sets ffff4251 bit 0 at 000cdd4e.
note: The immediate codes 0x82, 0x84, 0x88, 0x92, 0x93, 0x94, and 0x98 are stored at their own sites and answered inside the handler. The tester-side meaning of the codes is not established.
