semantics: Previous-pass copy of bank-1 actual exhaust-cam timing byte ffff2324, made by scheduler 00020dfe in the 6-byte block ffff2324..ffff2329 -> ffff232a..ffff232f at 00021310. FUN 000bfc2e reads byte[ffff2324 + 6 + ch] at 000bfd74 as the filter state of the new output.
note: ffff232b is the bank-2 copy of ffff2325 in the same block.

semantics: Bank-1 snapshot of the second-newest exhaust-cam edge phase ffff1202, copied by scheduler 00020dfe in the 0x38-byte block ffff11d4..ffff120b -> ffff119c..ffff11d3 at 00020f6c. FUN 000bfc2e forms deviation d1 from it at 000bfcd6.
note: ffff11cb is the bank-2 snapshot of ffff1203.

semantics: Bank-1 snapshot of the third-newest exhaust-cam edge phase ffff1204, copied by scheduler 00020dfe in the 0x38-byte block ffff11d4..ffff120b -> ffff119c..ffff11d3 at 00020f6c. FUN 000bfc2e forms deviation d2 from it at 000bfd02.
note: ffff11cd is the bank-2 snapshot of ffff1205.

semantics: Filter coefficient x of the actual exhaust-cam timing bytes. FUN 000bfc2e stores interp(00012f7e over axis 00012f6e by RPM/50 byte ffff11ae) at 000bfc70; stock holds 0xcd at 800 RPM and 0xff from 1600 RPM, so the output passes 255/256 of each new sample above 1600 RPM.

Per-bank judgement timer of the exhaust-VTC position-sensor monitors (ffff43be + b). FUN 00090086 reloads it with ROM8[00008e23]=100 at 0009016a and 0009017a while indicator ffff850d bit 6 + b is clear or its enable is clear, reads it at 0009010e, and sets judged latch ffff3580 bit b at 0009011c when it has reached zero with the indicator set; FUN 0009018c applies the same rules with ffff850d bit 4 + b and ffff3581.
note: The decrement source of the timer is not identified in the export.

semantics: Base ignition angle written by 0004ae6c: a divider-based angle from ffff17b8, ffff14dc, ffff1630, ROM8[0x884d]=128, ROM8[0x8b6c]=14, and RPM/12.5 word ffff11bc, stored as r-14 when r<0x8e and 127 otherwise. The normal branch of 0004bdc2 adds the centered map adjustment and subtracts the retard terms from it.
note: One count is one crank degree of the final coordinate ffff11d4 by the coefficient-1 chain. The physical meaning of the divider inputs remains unresolved.

semantics: Unsigned retard sum written by 0004bb6a as clamp_u8(ffff22fe+ffff22f8-(ffff1657>>4)). Both compositor branches of 0004bdc2 subtract it.
note: Zero is neutral; one count is one crank degree of retard in the final coordinate.

semantics: Unsigned retard term written by 0004bbac as max(curve(ffff11b3)->ffff12da - curve(ffff106f)->ffff12d9, 0). The normal compositor branch of 0004bdc2 subtracts it.
note: Zero is neutral; one count is one crank degree of retard in the final coordinate.

semantics: Unsigned bounded ramp written by 0004bbee from ffff1048 and ffff22e8 with ROM8[0x87ca..0x87d2] steps, using intermediates ffff15eb..ffff15ee. The normal compositor branch of 0004bdc2 subtracts it.
note: Zero is neutral; one count is one crank degree of retard in the final coordinate.

semantics: Optional additive term of the normal compositor branch of 0004bdc2, calculated by its embedded 8x8 lookup as min(255,floor(min(255,interp2d)*u16(ffff1900)*u8(ffff134c)/500000)) and nonzero only when ffff41ab.bit6 is set and min(ffff28b8,ffff28ba)>=ROM16[0x9012]=7350.
note: One count is one crank degree of advance in the final coordinate.

semantics: Previous-pass snapshot of latched timing state ffff2404, written by scheduler 00020dfe inside the 0x8c-byte block copy ffff23bc..ffff2447 -> ffff2330..ffff23bb. FUN 0004d99c adds it to the negated retard request ffff11d6 while forming ffff12d6, and 0004dbe8 reads it in an override mode.
note: One count is one crank degree of the final coordinate.

semantics: Previous-pass snapshot of bounded correction ffff23e2, written by scheduler 00020dfe inside the 0x8c-byte block copy. FUN 0004d99c adds it while forming ffff12d6.
note: Stock maps 0x1239a and 0x123a2 are zero, so the value is 0 in the stock image.

semantics: Bounded signed correction written by 0004cadc as clamp_s8(clamp(v, -ROM8[0x8a9c], ROM8[0x82e9])) with stock bounds -15..0. Scheduler 00020dfe snapshots it into ffff2356.
note: Stock source maps 0x1239a and 0x123a2 are zero; one count is one crank degree of the final coordinate.

semantics: Retard request written by 00062e10: 0 when (ffff4242&0x30)!=0, otherwise min(max(hi(ffff2336),hi(ffff235e)),127) while ffff24cb.bit5 is clear and the ffff2025-adjusted variant otherwise. FUN 0004d99c negates it into ffff11d6.
note: ffff2336 and ffff235e are the scheduler snapshots of Q8 states ffff23c2 and ffff23ea. Positive values retard the final coordinate by one crank degree per count.

semantics: Signed retard term written by 0004d99c: -ffff11f9 when ffff24c5.bit5 and ffff24cb.bit2 are clear, otherwise min(ffff22fa-hi(ffff23c2), -ffff11fa) on the knock branch enabled by ROM8[0x8710].bit5. It is added to snapshot ffff2378 while forming ffff12d6.
note: One count is one crank degree of the final coordinate.

semantics: Knock-branch companion of ffff11d6 written by 0004d99c as min(ffff22fa, -ffff11fa). Scheduler 00020dfe snapshots it into ffff11a0 for the 00063f30 difference path.

Clamped timing sum written by 0004dbe8 as clamp(ffff12d6+gated ffff564c, ROM8[0x8221]=-7, ROM8[0x821e]=50), where the ffff564c term is included only while ffff5b31 bits 1..5 are clear. The rate limiter and mode bounds of the same function derive ffff11d4 from this sum.
note: One count is one crank degree of the J1979 PID 0x0E coordinate.

semantics: Nonvolatile timing offset restored by 000686b8 from the high byte of configuration record 0x74 and stored by 00068040 from ffff56b2 when the ffff41ab.bit7 latch is set. FUN 0004aad0 selects it as the ffff56b2 source when neither ffff424c.bit4 nor bit5 is set and it lies within -5..0.
note: One count is one crank degree of the final coordinate within the ffff5b31 window.

semantics: Bank 2 throttle-position sensor 1 runtime word. FUN 000a7418 monitors it as channel index 1 against ROM16[0x9550]=60..ROM16[0x954e]=964 counts.
note: The exact ROM descriptor catalog resolves dispatcher indices 0x111 and 0x112 to P2133 and P2132, throttle-position sensor 1 bank 2 high and low input. The word shares the count domain and the scale of ffff2756.

semantics: Bank 2 throttle-position sensor 2 runtime word. FUN 000a75c0 monitors it as channel index 1 against ROM16[0x9550]=60..ROM16[0x954e]=964 counts.
note: The exact ROM descriptor catalog resolves dispatcher indices 0x113 and 0x114 to P0228 and P0227, throttle-position sensor 2 bank 2 high and low input. The word shares the count domain and the scale of ffff275e.

semantics: Ten-bit sample of the on-chip A/D result register at fffff82e. FUN 000280d8 shifts the aligned conversion result right by six and writes this word on every pass.
note: FUN 0003e4cc subtracts the sample from 0x0400 into publication word ffff2862, the same inversion it applies to ffff363c.

semantics: Ten-bit sample of the on-chip A/D result register at fffff82c. FUN 000280d8 shifts the aligned conversion result right by six and writes this word on every pass.
note: FUN 0003e4cc subtracts the sample from 0x0400 into UDS DID 0x124c word ffff2864, which the factory parameter list names TP SEN 2-B2.

semantics: Publication word written by FUN 0003e4cc as 0x0400 minus ten-bit sample ffff363a. The dynamic local-identifier table at 0x24e9c is its only other reference.
note: No service 0x22 identifier maps to this word. It shares the transform and the scale of ffff2864.

semantics: Signed offset-corrected first channel of paired-sensor stage 0003e4cc. It is min(ffff2862 - ffff561a, 0x7fff) with a -0x8000 floor.
note: The learned offset removes the closed-position reading, so the corrected value is zero-referenced while keeping the 5 mV per count scale.

semantics: Signed offset-corrected second channel of paired-sensor stage 0003e4cc. It is min(ffff2864 - ffff561c, 0x7fff) with a -0x8000 floor.
note: The learned offset removes the closed-position reading, so the corrected value is zero-referenced while keeping the 5 mV per count scale.

semantics: Learned closed-position offset of the first paired throttle channel. FUN 0003e4cc subtracts it from complement word ffff2862 before writing corrected value ffff285e.
note: The offset is in the same count domain as the channel it corrects. The writer of the learned value is outside the reviewed set.

semantics: Learned closed-position offset of the second paired throttle channel. FUN 0003e4cc subtracts it from complement word ffff2864 before writing corrected value ffff2860.
note: The offset is in the same count domain as the channel it corrects. The writer of the learned value is outside the reviewed set.

semantics: Accumulator of the MAF coefficient calibration sequence. FUN 000662f6 adds eight ffff1a3e samples into it, each required to lie within ROM8[0x8d3e]*4=856..ROM8[0x8d3f]*4=944 counts.
note: FUN 0006635c divides ROM8[0x8d40]=225 shifted left by twenty by this sum, so the sequence returns stock coefficient 0x8000 at an average of 900 counts, which is 4.50 V at 5 mV per count and the centre of the 856..944 acceptance window.

semantics: Base of the six-element scheduled injection-duration array read by ATU-II one-shot scheduler 0002c13c. FUN_00054d3e fills all six words before each call site in 00029588, 0002be40, and 00054a44: from snapshot ffff2348 lower-bounded at ffff2390 while running, from ffff23aa while stopped or inhibited, from ffff238a on the zero-mode path, and from the ffff2386..ffff2392 start words on modes 1, 2, and 4.
note: One count is 10 us. This is the main of the two duration arrays reaching DCNT8A..DCNT8F; the other is ffff1568.

semantics: Scheduler snapshot of transformed injection-pulse array ffff23d4, produced by the 140-byte ffff23bc -> ffff2330 copy in 00020dfe. FUN_00054d3e copies each word into scheduled-duration array ffff224e after lower-bounding it at ffff2390.
note: One count is 10 us. The snapshot carries the values produced by the preceding scheduler pass.

semantics: Scheduler snapshot of minimum-pulse word ffff241c, produced by the same 140-byte ffff23bc -> ffff2330 copy. FUN_00054d3e substitutes it for any channel whose snapshot duration is below it.
note: One count is 10 us. FUN_000521a8 applies the unsnapshotted word ffff241c as the same lower bound when it derives scalar bytes ffff23bf and ffff23f0.

semantics: Base of the six-element mask-gated injection-pulse array written by FUN_00051a98. For channel i the stock branch forms base = arithmetic_shift6(uint8(ffff152c)*uint8(ffff1527)), adds or subtracts uint8(ffff15d8) by ffff2484.bit0, adds 0x32 when bit i of uint8(ffff1574) is set, scales the sum by int16(ffff142e+2*i) over 1024 and by uint16(ffff165e) over 8192 with uint16 saturation, and adds uint16(ffff2436).
note: One count is 10 us, the same unit as ffff23c8; the additive ffff2436 term is the injector opening time.

semantics: Base of the six-element transformed mask-gated injection-pulse array. FUN_00051a98 passes each ffff155c element through FUN_0005b7ec and writes the result at index 2*i. FUN_00051f1e passes this array with channel mask ffff1220 to ATU-II one-shot scheduler 0002c13c.
note: One count is 10 us. This is the second of the two duration arrays reaching DCNT8A..DCNT8F; the other is ffff224e.

semantics: PSCR1, the ATU-II prescaler register serving channels 0 to 5, 8, and 11. Prescaler initialization 000274ac writes 1, so the prescaler output is phi' = Pphi/2.
note: The written value is exact. Pphi = 20 MHz follows from the base scheduler cadence 204800/Pphi measured against passive target-CAN timestamps.

semantics: DCNT8A, the first of the sixteen ATU-II channel-8 one-shot down-counters. Channel initialization 0002718a clears DCNT8A through DCNT8P. Scheduler 0002c13c adds sat_u16(800*duration/256) to DCNT8A+2*i for injector channel i with interrupts masked around the read-modify-write.
note: With PSCR1 = 1 and TCR8 = 0x55 the counters run at Pphi/64 = 312.5 kHz, so one step is 3.2 us and one duration count of 10 us is 3.125 steps.

semantics: DSTR, the ATU-II channel-8 down-count start register. Channel initialization 0002718a clears it. Scheduler 0002c13c sets bit i to start the one-shot for injector channel i; a bit that is still set marks a pulse in flight, in which case the scheduler first subtracts injector opening time ffff23aa from the new duration.
note: Bits 0 to 5 correspond to DCNT8A through DCNT8F. The physical terminal order of the six outputs requires hardware validation.

semantics: TCR8, the ATU-II channel-8 timer control register. Channel initialization 0002718a writes 0x55, so CKSELA in bits 2:0 selects phi'/32 for DCNT8A..DCNT8H and CKSELB in bits 6:4 selects the same rate for DCNT8I..DCNT8P.
note: With PSCR1 = 1 the injector down-counters run at Pphi/64. The value is a single exact byte write on the initialization path.

semantics: Signed engine-torque state after the spark-efficiency factor. On the stock ROM8[00008710].bit5 branch FUN 00065b08 writes trunc0(s16[ffff18cc]*(256-F(clamp_u8(s8[ffff23f1]-s8[ffff11a2])))/256), where ffff11a2 is the scheduler latch of clamped timing sum ffff11da.
note: F(z)=interp_u8(00011d24,axis 0001199e,z) rises from 0 at zero retard to 179 at 40 counts, with F(3k)=k*k over the first seven breakpoints, so the factor removes torque as timing is retarded from base angle ffff23f1.

semantics: Signed net engine-torque state. FUN 00065cd8 writes sat_i16(trunc0(s16[ffff18ce]*(6-n)/6)-u16[ffff2408]-u16[ffff14e2]), where n is the byte returned by FUN 00065d42 and stored at ffff16a2.
note: FUN 00065d42 returns 6 when fuel-output inhibit mask ffff22e0 equals 0x3f and at least 3 when it equals 0x15, so n counts inhibited cylinders and (6-n)/6 is the contributing fraction. Subtracting base term ffff2408 and correction ffff14e2 converts the map-side state to a net value.

semantics: First-order filtered net engine-torque state. FUN 00065de4 writes trunc0((s16[ffff18d0]*w+s16[ffff18d2]*(256-w))/256) with w=ROM8[000087ed], adding one count when the result equals the previous value below the input.
note: Stock w=255 leaves one part in 256 of the previous value.

semantics: Unsigned accessory-load torque sum. FUN 00065f9c runs FUN 00065e98, FUN 00065efa, and FUN 00065f42, then writes sat_u16(u16[ffff1818]+u16[ffff196e]+u16[ffff1838]), or zero while byte ffff11b3 is zero.
note: The identities of the three load terms are not established.

semantics: Signed net engine torque after accessory loads. FUN 00065e2c writes sat_i16(s16[ffff18d2]-u16[ffff2410]). Scheduler FUN 00020dfe latches it to ffff2380 inside the 140-byte copy ffff23bc->ffff2330 at 00021318, and CAN packer 00079e70 converts the latch to word ffff3f96 of frame 0x180.
note: FUN 00065e54, entry 96 of the 124-entry periodic table at 0002196c, runs the chain 00065b08, 00065cd8, 00065de4, 00065f9c, 00065e2c. This is the static path from Engine Torque Map 00010b8e to the CAN frame.

semantics: Signed net engine torque of the parallel channel. FUN 00065860 runs FUN 000655b4, FUN 0006570c, and FUN 00065764, then writes sat_i16(s16[ffff18d8]-u16[ffff2410]). Its scheduler latch ffff2382 feeds word ffff3f98 of frame 0x160.
note: The channel evaluates the spark-efficiency factor at latched timing-state byte ffff2404 instead of live timing latch ffff11a2. In a vehicle capture it stays level through gear changes while ffff240c dips.

semantics: Limited signed request clamped for CAN. FUN 00079030 writes clamp(min(lower-path request, upper-path request), s16[ffff413a], s16[ffff4138]); the scheduler latch ffff4106 feeds word ffff3fa0 of frame 0x160.
note: The word shares the divide-by-five CAN packing of net engine torque ffff240c, which places the signed request coordinate of FUN 00079030 in the torque domain.

semantics: Pre-limiter signed request clamped for CAN. FUN 00079030 writes clamp(s16[ffff2438], s16[ffff413a], s16[ffff4138]); the scheduler latch ffff4108 feeds word ffff3f90 of frame 0x180.
note: In a vehicle capture this word equals the limited request of frame 0x160 except during five request-limiter intervals, where the limited word is lower.

semantics: CAN actual-torque word for frame 0x180 byte 2 and byte 3 bits 7..4. FUN 00079e70 writes 4095 while ffff4221.bit2 is set and otherwise clamp(trunc0(s16[ffff2380]/5)+800, 0, 4094), where ffff2380 is the scheduler latch of ffff240c.
note: One CAN count is five raw torque counts and count 800 is zero torque. A moving-load vehicle capture spans 653..1252 with an idle median of 820.

semantics: CAN requested-torque word for frame 0x180 byte 3 bits 3..0 and byte 4. FUN 00079e70 writes clamp(trunc0(s16[ffff4108]/5)+800, 0, 4094), where ffff4108 is the scheduler latch of ffff4160.
note: A moving-load vehicle capture spans 773..1293.

semantics: CAN limited-request word for frame 0x160 byte 0 and byte 1 bits 7..4. FUN 00079e70 writes clamp(trunc0(x/5)+800, 0, 4094) with x=s16[ffff4106], the scheduler latch of ffff415e. While ROM8[0000870c].bit7 and ffff4248.bit1 are both set, x is max(s16[ffff4106], s16[ffff410a]), where ffff410a latches transmission request candidate ffff4162.
note: Stock ROM8[0000870c]=0x44 has bit 7 clear, so the transmission candidate does not enter this word.

semantics: CAN parallel actual-torque word for frame 0x160 byte 1 bits 3..0 and byte 2. FUN 00079e70 writes 4095 while ffff4221.bit2 is set and otherwise clamp(trunc0(x/5)+800, 0, 4094) with x=max(min(s16[ffff23a8], s16[ffff2382]), s16[ffff2374]), the scheduler latches of ffff2434, ffff240e, and ffff2400.
note: A moving-load vehicle capture equals word ffff3f96 outside gear changes and stays above it during them.

semantics: CAN-scaled friction-and-load word. FUN 00079e70 writes clamp(trunc0((u16[ffff237c]+u16[ffff2384])/5)+800, 0, 4094) from the scheduler latches of base term ffff2408 and accessory sum ffff2410.
note: None of the nine stock transmit serializers reads this word.

semantics: Start-latched fuel-temperature byte. FUN 00039788 writes current fuel-temperature byte ffff1074 at 000397d8 while gate 00039902 returns 1 and previous-pass image ffff107b while it returns 0, which holds the last selection; scheduler 00020dfe snapshots it to ffff106b.
note: Gate 00039902 repeats the state machine of coolant selector 0003967a with latch ffff24bd.bit5: a computed START SIGNAL interval with battery-voltage raw below 100 tracks the current byte, and the first pass outside it selects the current byte once.

semantics: Previous-pass image of start-latched fuel-temperature byte ffff1073. After the 69 entries of periodic table 00021834, dispatcher FUN 000209d8 copies ffff1072..ffff1079 to ffff107a..ffff1081 through block-copy helper 00022558 at 00020cba. FUN 00039788 reads it at 000397d4 on the hold branch of gate 00039902. Startup initializer FUN 00027c50 and clear services FUN 0002fc24 and FUN 00034b70 zero the byte inside their RAM spans.
note: The helper writes through its destination pointer, so the byte has no literal-address store. The zero of RAM initialization is replaced at the end of the first pass.

semantics: Previous-pass image of fuel-temperature byte ffff1074. After the 69 entries of periodic table 00021834, dispatcher FUN 000209d8 copies ffff1072..ffff1079 to ffff107a..ffff1081 through block-copy helper 00022558 at 00020cba. Fall-rate limiter 00039874 compares transfer code ffff1f89 with it at 00039882. Startup initializer FUN 00027c50 and clear services FUN 0002fc24 and FUN 00034b70 zero the byte inside their RAM spans.
note: The helper writes through its destination pointer, so the byte has no literal-address store. The zero of RAM initialization is replaced at the end of the first pass.

semantics: Previous-pass image of engine-coolant-temperature byte ffff1079. After the 69 entries of periodic table 00021834, dispatcher FUN 000209d8 copies ffff1072..ffff1079 to ffff107a..ffff1081 through block-copy helper 00022558 at 00020cba. Fall-rate limiter 00039588 compares coolant transfer code ffff1187 with it at 00039598. Startup initializer FUN 00027c50 and clear services FUN 0002fc24 and FUN 00034b70 zero the byte inside their RAM spans.
note: The helper writes through its destination pointer, so the byte has no literal-address store. The zero of RAM initialization is replaced at the end of the first pass.

semantics: Engine-coolant transfer code. FUN 00039550 stores lookup(00012dea, ffff1186) through implicit-axis primitive 000263a0 at 0003957e while ROM8[0x8b42] has bit 7 or bit 0 set and constant 0x82 otherwise. Fall-rate limiter 00039588 reads it.
note: Stock ROM8[0x8b42] = 0xe0 selects the lookup. Constant 0x82 is 80 deg C under deg C = raw-50.

semantics: Step counter of the engine-coolant fail-safe ramp. FUN 000395ae clears it while ffff2451 bit 5 is clear. While the bit is set, every expiry of countdown ffff24f7 increments it with saturation at 255 and reloads the countdown with 6. The substitute coolant byte is min(90 + counter, 130).
note: Periodic handler 0002040c decrements countdown array ffff24d4..ffff24f8 every 1000 base interrupts, or 1.024 s at the 10.24 ms scheduler pass. Forty steps take 245.8 s and move the substitute from raw 90 to raw 130. The factory fail-safe table gives 40 deg C at ignition ON or START and 80 deg C after about four minutes, which is deg C = raw-50 at one deg C per count.

semantics: Bit 6 is the stored-fault summary of DTC attribute bit 8: FUN 0008c24e sets it at 0008c266 while FUN 0008c396(0x0100) finds a descriptor record whose attribute word has bit 8 set and whose runtime record ffff5718 + 3*index has byte 1 bit 7 set, and clears it at 0008c268 otherwise. A set bit blocks exhaust-VTC operating enable ffff248b bit 2 in 000bf630, rest-edge learning gate ffff24a8 bit 7 in 000bf9b0, and the enable argument of 00090a84. Bit 7 is written by 00079a98, bit 0 by 0009a348, and bit 4 by 000cc94e.
note: Attribute bit 8 is carried by 36 stock descriptor records: twenty P0605 records and P0120, P0643, P1123, P1127, P1129, P1233 (two), P1236, P1238, P1290, P2100, P2101 (two), P2103, P2118, and P2119.

semantics: Bits 7, 2, and 0 are the stored-fault summary of DTC attribute bit 10: FUN 0008c272 sets all three at 0008c28c while event byte ffff48e0 is nonzero and clears them otherwise. A set bit 7 blocks exhaust-VTC operating enable ffff248b bit 2 in 000bf630. Bit 1 is written by 00097018, bits 4 and 5 by 000abca2, bit 6 by 000ae5a4 and 000b29b8, and bit 3 by 000aee06, 000b29b8, and 000b3284.
note: The class holds the six mass-airflow records, so bit 7 follows a stored P0101, P0102, P0103, P010B, P010C, or P010D fault.

semantics: Event byte of DTC attribute bit 10. FUN 0008c2d2 writes 1 at 0008c326 when the record it stores has attribute bit 10 set; stage 3 of summary pass 0008c65c writes 0 once FUN 0008c396(0x0400) finds no record of the class with byte 1 bit 7 set. FUN 0008c272 projects a nonzero value onto ffff41d1 bits 7, 2, and 0.
note: Attribute bit 10 is carried by the six mass-airflow records P0101, P0102, P0103 (indices 0xba..0xbc) and P010B, P010C, P010D (indices 0x07..0x09).

semantics: Bits 0 and 1 are the per-bank judged flags of FUN 00090d54, the P1080/P1086 path (descriptor records 0x88 and 0x89). With ffff4184 bit 7 and ffff24ab bit 3 set, the function sets bit b once timer ffff25f0 + b has expired while cam edge phase snapshot ffff11c8 + b is at or below ROM8[00008e32]=254, and then reports the record through 0007d8b8 once timer ffff25f2 + b has expired. FUN 00090e02 clears both bits. Either bit blocks exhaust-VTC operating enable ffff248b bit 2 in 000bf630.
note: Family entry 00090e5e calls 00090d54 only under ROM8[000186f2] bits 5 and 4; stock JK08A holds 0x07, so the function never runs and both bits stay clear.

semantics: Bits 0 and 1 are the per-bank flags of FUN 00090bd2, a third P0014/P0024 path. With ffff24a7 bit 4 set, conditioned target ffff2327 at 0x80, the bank bit of ffff48df set, and duty word ffff1aac + 2b zero, the function sets bit b while cam edge phase snapshot ffff11c8 + b exceeds the high byte of reference word ffff5578 + 2b by at least ROM8[0000895e]=254 and clears it below that; once timer ffff2539 + b has expired it stores record 0xd2 or 0xd3 through 0008c2d2 and 0007d8b8. FUN 00090e02 clears both bits. Either bit blocks exhaust-VTC operating enable ffff248b bit 2 in 000bf630.
note: Family entry 00090e5e calls 00090bd2 only under ROM8[000186f1] bits 3 and 2; stock JK08A holds 0xf0, so the function never runs and both bits stay clear. The difference is stored in ffff16bd + b.

semantics: Flag byte of the exhaust-VTC coordinators. FUN 000bf630 maintains bits 4 and 2 as the 900 RPM engine-speed flags with 700 RPM release. FUN 000bf9b0 writes bit 7 as the rest-edge learning gate: set at 000bfa3c while electrical enable ffff248b bit 0, coolant flags ffff24a9 bits 3 and 6, and engine-speed flag ffff24aa bit 0 (ffff11b2 at most ROM8[00008e1b]=80, 1000 RPM with release above 1200 RPM) are set and driver status ffff850c bits 5 and 6, predicate 00025e4e, and inhibit ffff41be bit 6 are clear, and cleared at 000bfa8a otherwise. Learner 000bfad4 requires bits 7 and 4 to store the learned edges.
note: Bits 5 and 3 are inputs of the target-tracking pair of monitor 0008f168.
